description.en: Community plugin index aggregated from multiple public DeepSeek Harness plugin indexes, refreshed daily.
description.zh: 由多个公开 DeepSeek Harness 插件索引合并去重而成的社区插件源，每日自动更新。

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only…
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: Message-level rollback, single-message deletion, and replay-based restore for DSH sessions; operations are append-only surface replacements, with confirmation…
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级回滚、单条删除与重放式恢复；操作以 append-only surface replace 实现，带确认提示和运行中会话保护。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Read-only lazy session viewer: lists sessions with stat only, then decompresses just the tail Zstandard frames to inspect recent events; includes search,…
description.zh: 只读会话惰性查看器：仅 stat 列出会话，再只解压尾部 Zstandard 帧查看最近事件；独立 /lazyview 面板支持搜索、统计和导出。需 Node.js 24+。

description.en: Cross-session full-text search over persisted DSH session logs: builds an incremental message-level index and returns sessionId, seq, and a short excerpt;…
description.zh: 跨会话全文搜索：对持久化 DSH 会话日志建立增量消息级索引，返回 sessionId、seq 与摘录；提供 agent 工具和独立面板。需 Node.js 23.5+。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic,…
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key…

description.en: Long sessions get expensive, and the platform compacts the context on its own. This plugin adds an occupancy badge (hover to see how it is computed), writes a…
description.zh: 长会话越跑越贵，平台到点还会把上下文压掉。这个插件做三件事：在会话标题旁显示当前上下文占了多少，鼠标停上去能看到这个数是怎么来的；过 45% 时往工作目录的 HANDOVER.md 写一份交接草稿，记下改过哪些文件、花了多少钱、最近几轮在聊什么；到 60% 提醒你一次该收尾了。平台压缩发生时，它把压缩前的数字记一行，事…

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the…
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and…
description.zh: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by…
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Windows notifications when a session turn ends, with optional foreground suppression and subagent filtering. Requires notification permission.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 会话回合结束时发送 Windows 通知，可设前台免打扰和子代理过滤，需允许系统通知。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode…

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will"…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API.…
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准…

description.en: ★ 196 │ Recall and consolidate project memory with handoff ledgers, planning notes and context tracking.
description.zh: ★ 196 │ 整理和检索项目记忆，保存交接记录、计划笔记与上下文状态。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed…
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop tray menu, patching the app's tray template in place and re-applying the patch after desktop updates.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端托盘右键菜单加一条「重启 DeepSeek Harness」，原地给应用打补丁，桌面端升级后自动补回。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks…
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Discord adapter that installs into a dsh web or desktop profile: @mentions and threads bind to sessions with streaming replies and live tool-activity rows,…
description.zh: 装进 dsh web / desktop profile 的 Discord 适配器：@提及与线程绑定会话，回复流式渲染并带实时工具活动行；九条斜杠命令覆盖工作区绑定、权限预设和模型选择；工具审批与提问在 Discord 与 web 端谁先答谁生效；guild 白名单默认拒绝。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34…
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, MiniMax and Alibaba Cloud Token…

description.en: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

description.en: Sorts the DSH sidebar workspace list: the workspace you last sent a prompt in rises above the first non-running one, with pin, drag-to-reorder, name filtering…
description.zh: DSH 侧栏工作区排序：刚发过消息的工作区升到「第一个非运行工作区」之上，另有置顶、拖拽排序、按名称筛选与一键整理；并可清理空工作区、把工作区文件夹连对话一起迁到新路径。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit…
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: ★ 3,797 │ Save completed conversations as Markdown memories and provide retrieval and long-term memory consolidation.
description.zh: ★ 3,797 │ 将完成的对话保存为 Markdown 记忆，提供检索和长期记忆整理。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Choose a separate provider, model and reasoning effort for the experimental DSH authorization reviewer while preserving native policy and conversation routing. Requires the host Auto review component; no DSH version range is declared.

description.en: ★ 0 │ Run single-turn or continuing questions in an independent subagent and display the results in the current conversation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在独立子 Agent 中进行单轮或连续问答，并把结果展示在当前对话中。

description.en: AI-native SDLC as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: task state machine and artifact chain, independent verification with structured verdicts, per-issue rework and…

description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将会话提问同步到终端、飞书卡片或网页等界面，采用最先收到的回答。

description.zh: ★ 3 │ 从飞书操作已有 DSH 会话，通过卡片查看轮次、回答问题、恢复任务或补充指令。

description.zh: ★ 0 │ 对 EOF、TLS 告警和流读取失败等临时网关错误进行限次重试。

description.zh: ★ 2 │ 为 DSH 网页搜索接入 Tavily。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or…

description.en: Lists this session's runtime errors — turn errors, tool failures, command failures and subagent failures — as copyable cards in a conversation tab.

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width…

description.en: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
description.zh: 给插件作者用：写完插件后跑一遍，自动体检整条发布链路，然后给出 GitHub + npm + 市场三步的可照抄命令。 DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM 里调 require()、缺 LICENSE 或 README 安装行、缺测试、裸包名 （granular token 收到无法诊断的 403）、版本已被 registry 占用、GitHub 仓库不存在。六个 agent 工具， 每条 finding 都带修复文案。只读，不调 LLM。

description.en: ★ 1,165 │ Manage CloudBase databases, storage, authentication and application deployment from DSH.
description.zh: ★ 1,165 │ 在 DSH 中管理 CloudBase 数据库、存储、身份认证与应用部署。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Runs the official creator skills for general, REST API and Huawei Cloud skills from a sidebar form, shows their progress live, scores the result out of 10 and sends it back for revision until it passes.

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated…
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: ★ 173 │ Search anime sources, inspect details and access playback links inside a conversation.
description.zh: ★ 173 │ 在会话中搜索动画来源、查看详情并使用播放入口。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and…
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported…

会话接管：只读拉取九家外部 agent（Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / ZCode / Pi / WorkBuddy / Cursor / Grok / Gemini CLI）的本地会话，蒸馏成六段交接卡，输入框「接力」按钮一键接管；/handoff 把当前会话寄存进…
description.en: Session takeover: read-only pull local sessions from nine external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI) into…
Right-sidebar session timeline: fishbone layout of every workspace session with native fork/handoff lineage, manual drag links, branch fan-outs,…
description.zh: 右侧栏会话时间线：以鱼骨布局展示工作区全部会话，含原生 fork/handoff 血缘、手工拖拽衔接、分支扇出、归档会话显示与逐轮详情浏览。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness, where the model writes the interface in DIL (Markdown, JSX-like tags, JavaScript). The host compiles it, and a sandboxed runtime renders interactive text and rich cards.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将模型编写的 DIL 界面编译为交互文字和卡片，在沙箱中运行。

description.en: ★ 92 │ A persistent agent team for long-running collaboration in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 92 │ 为长期任务保存 Agent 团队与协作状态。

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export;…
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索…

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX…
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds…
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和…

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google…
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI…

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications'…
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection;…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace…
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent…
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included),…
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare,…
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when…
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api…

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The…

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is…
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB…

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one…

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked…
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when…
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

Requires Windows and the official Ego CLI installed locally; screenshots are saved to the desktop. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.1.

description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen…
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Reusable roles for DSH's native Agent Team: per-role prompt, model and reasoning effort, model fallback chain, tool allowlist and Skills; the main agent starts members or continues the same member's conversation. Tool calls still follow host permissions and approvals; member traffic adds model cost. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.18.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 原生 Agent Team 管理可复用角色：按角色设置职责提示词、模型与推理强度、模型回退链、工具白名单和 Skills，由主代理启动成员或继续同一成员的对话。工具调用仍遵循宿主权限与审批；成员通信会产生额外模型费用。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22.18.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Record a discussion with /cardex; afterwards a curation model turns it into linked Markdown knowledge cards, a knowledge tree and an offline HTML graph, with backlinks to the original Q&A. Recorded text goes to the chosen model (default: the session model) and costs tokens; the knowledge base is written to a configurable folder (default ~/journal/cardex). Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话中用 /cardex 记录讨论，结束后由整理模型生成可关联的 Markdown 知识卡片、知识树和离线 HTML 图谱，并保留原始问答回链。记录内容会发送给所选模型（默认当前会话模型）并产生费用；知识库写入可配置目录（默认 ~/journal/cardex）。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Switch a session between Standard and Fast and adjust reasoning effort per model. Fast sets the priority service tier on matching Responses requests and forwards them, with their auth header, to the target endpoint the admin configures, so that target must be trusted; incomplete config rejects Fast requests. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话中切换 Standard / Fast 档位并按模型调整推理强度。Fast 为匹配的 Responses 请求设置 priority 服务档位，并连同授权头转发到管理员配置的目标端点，目标须可信；配置不完整时拒绝 Fast 请求。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Sends DSH approval, question and plan-confirmation reminders to a Feishu DM or group through a self-built Feishu app, and lets the model send a work summary when a long task ends; supports recipients, quiet hours and time zone. One-way only; needs your own Feishu app ID and secret. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过飞书自建应用把 DSH 的审批、提问和计划确认提醒发送到私聊或群聊，长任务收尾时可由模型发送工作摘要；支持接收方、免打扰时段和时区设置。仅单向通知，需自备飞书应用 ID 与 Secret。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Collects pinned sessions from every workspace visible in DSH's native view into one sidebar section, reusing the native rows, status and actions; follows native collapse and search, with a separate or shared scroll area. Client-only. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.19.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 DSH 原生视图中各工作区的置顶会话集中显示在侧栏，复用原有会话行、状态与操作；范围随原生折叠和搜索变化，可选独立滚动或随工作区列表滚动。纯前端插件。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22.19.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Collapses rarely used plugins' tool docs into a brief plus tool names, which the model can unwrap per plugin when needed (off by default; calls still follow host permissions). Also adds an editor for system, pinned-user and user-state prompts; full prompt composition needs the bundled host-support adapter applied by hand. For DSH PTC sessions. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把不常用插件的工具说明折叠为简介和工具名，需要时由模型按插件整体展开（默认关闭，调用仍遵循宿主权限）。另提供系统、用户固定、用户状态三类提示词编排界面；完整编排需手动接入随包的 host-support 适配层。适用于 DSH PTC 会话。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22。

description.en: ★ 46 │ Combine a calendar, hierarchical tasks, AI planning, execution reviews and desktop reminders.
description.zh: ★ 46 │ 组合日历、分层任务、AI 拆解、执行复盘与桌面提醒。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via…
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept…
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab…
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: a safe session-delete tool that copies the session directory, its projection cache and…
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「···」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：这是一个安全的会话删除工具（session-delete），删除会话前先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Browse, preview, apply and revert color themes in DSH, including a palette matched to the default DSH colors. Sends limited usage events.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在 DSH 中浏览、预览、应用和还原配色主题，包含与 DSH 默认配色一致的方案。会发送有限的使用统计。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Install eight DFY plugins at once: wallpaper, appearance, archive management, media, image generation, interactive visuals, task guard and Codex connection, each with its own switch.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 一次安装 DFY 的 8 个插件：壁纸、外观、归档管理、媒体内容、图像生成、交互可视化、任务守卫和 Codex 连接，可分别启停。

title.zh: 玄枢 · 中华传统智慧

description.en: ★ 65 │ A local-first consultation skill on traditional Chinese culture, with BaZi, Zi Wei, Liu Yao, feng shui and more computed by a local engine. For cultural reference, not prediction.
description.zh: ★ 65 │ 本地优先的中国传统文化咨询技能，八字、紫微、六爻、风水等由本地引擎计算，分层给出事实、文化解释和现实建议。仅供传统文化参考，不作预测。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex…
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi…
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action…
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是…

description.en: ★ 29 │ Official DingTalk connector for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 29 │ 通过钉钉连接 DSH 会话与消息。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Session-state notification plugin for the dsh web GUI: session completed/failed, question-asked, and permission-requested alerts with configurable built-in or custom sounds and browser notifications, plus a Notifications settings section
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 为会话完成、失败、提问和权限请求配置声音与浏览器通知。

description.en: Tracks DSH's file reads, image views, and code edits in WakaTime, including exact counts of lines added and deleted by AI. Keeps activity tracking running…
description.zh: 在 WakaTime 中记录 DSH 读取文件、查看图片和编辑代码的活动，并准确统计 AI 新增和删除的代码行数。DSH 回复期间持续记录活动，多个文件的记录批量上报，并在并行运行的 DSH 进程间统一控制各项目的上报频率。自动安装和更新 wakatime-cli。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Keep the flagship model in the conversation and let it dispatch scoped tasks to cheaper executor models you configure, then collect and review their reports. Pair with dsh-conductor-ui for the task board.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 让主力模型留在对话中，把范围明确的任务分派给你配置的低成本执行模型，再收集并审阅报告。任务看板需搭配 dsh-conductor-ui。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Web task board for Conductor in the right sidebar and a full page: executor and publisher roles, follow-ups, cancellation and per-session filtering. Requires @dippingorange/dsh-conductor.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ Conductor 的网页任务看板，提供右侧栏标签页和完整页面，支持执行者与发布者角色、追问、取消和按会话筛选。需先安装 @dippingorange/dsh-conductor。

description.en: ★ 59 │ Connect Qoder models with PAT credentials, regional account pools, check-ins, automatic rotation and credit display.
description.zh: ★ 59 │ 通过 PAT 接入 Qoder 模型，支持分区域账号池、签到、自动换号和积分显示。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was…
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: ★ 1 │ NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) player and AI DJ for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar page with in-app playback, QR sign-in, and agent tools that curate the queue.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在侧栏播放网易云音乐，支持扫码登录和由 Agent 整理播放队列。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：每个库对应一个本地文件夹，支持 UTF-8 文本、文本型 PDF 与图片 OCR 资料；每轮对话前用中文 n-gram 与 BM25 从本会话所选库中检索，回答带可在右侧阅读器打开原文的引用；并提供 kb_list、kb_search、kb_read、kb_stats、k…

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same…
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」插件：按轮次建立检查点（10 轮滑动窗口），同时回滚工作区文件与原位截断模型上下文，保持同一 session id。回退只能由人发起：/rollback 命令或每轮的 Web 回退按钮（被中断的轮次也可用），弹窗逐条列出受影响文件及其动作（恢复/找回/删除/跳过）。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider…
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: A file editor in the DSH web GUI right sidebar: open any text file, edit it, and save in place, with a version gate on every save — if the file changed on disk…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧栏的文件编辑器：打开任意文本文件即可编辑并原地保存，每次保存都带版本闸——编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖。文档预览多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮；另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制、剪切 /…

description.en: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host…
description.zh: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm…

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you…
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: Drive the DOTV infinite canvas from DeepSeek Harness: the agent lists your canvases and their nodes, adds text nodes, and runs image/video/audio generations —…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 DOTV 无限画布：agent 能列出画布与节点、加文本节点、跑图片/视频/音频生成 —— 走 DOTV 的公开 API，零运行时依赖、免构建。默认复用本机 `dotv` CLI 的登录态，也可以在插件设置里填 API key。跑生成消耗账号积分，跟在应用里做一样。

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the…
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及…

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).
description.zh: 通过你自己的 GitHub 私有仓库,在多台电脑间双向同步 DSH 会话、工作区对应关系、设置与托管补丁(API 密钥留在本机)。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Register an idle-aware restart of the DSH host with dsh_restart: it waits for agents (including subagents) to finish, ends the process after a quiet window, and can leave a one-shot note. Exit methods include systemd user unit, a configured shell command, SIGTERM or process.exit. The optional status route reports only counters. Requires Node >=22. Issue asked for 1.0.0; this review is of latest 1.5.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用 dsh_restart 登记一次空闲感知的宿主重启：等待所有 Agent（含子代理）结束后，经过安静窗口再结束进程，并可留下一次性提醒。退出方式包括 systemd 用户单元、配置的 shell 命令、SIGTERM 或 process.exit。可选状态接口只返回计数。需 Node >=22。议题写的是 1.0.0，本轮审查的是目前最新的 1.5.0。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Create one-time web forms for entering secrets into the DSH credential store or a file, with expiring links and cancellation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 生成一次性网页表单，将用户输入的密钥写入 DSH 凭据库或文件，支持链接过期与取消。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage skills from a DSH Web sidebar page: view, edit, rename, import, export and enable or disable user skills; bundled and plugin-provided skills have limited actions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH Web 侧栏查看、编辑、重命名、导入导出和启停用户技能；随包附带或插件提供的技能仅开放相应查看与导出操作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Register speech transcription providers for IM voice messages, using a configured model, an OpenAI-compatible API or a local command. Requires a transcription service or executable.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 IM 语音消息提供转文字服务，可复用已配置模型、连接 OpenAI 兼容接口或调用本地命令。需配置转写服务或可执行程序。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect local folders, S3-compatible storage, WebDAV and Yandex Disk, with encrypted section-based backups, a portable backup of the core configuration and your own executable backup scripts. Note: the storage_write tool can upload any local file to a configured storage without an approval prompt.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 接入本地目录、S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 和 Yandex Disk，支持按分区加密备份、可迁移的核心配置备份，以及自己编写的可执行备份脚本。注意：storage_write 工具可以不经审批把本机任意文件上传到已配置的存储。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Search and retrieve pages through configurable providers; provider API keys may be required and usage may incur charges.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 使用可配置的供应商搜索和读取网页；可能需要 API 密钥并产生费用。

description.en: Workspace-scoped MCP server loading for DeepSeek Harness: servers default to dynamic mode, so they are not mounted at boot and the model loads them on demand…

description.zh: 基于工作区资料的 Studio，复用 DSH 模型与共享成果服务，制作报告、演示文稿、表格、思维导图、测验、闪卡及音视频。Office 生成需 Python 3.12+ 及相关依赖，并配置 DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON；媒体渲染需 Chromium；本地语音转写另需 whisper.cpp 和模型。

description.en: ★ 352 │ Search DBLP and arXiv, retrieve BibTeX citations and access available paper full text.
description.zh: ★ 352 │ 检索 DBLP 和 arXiv，获取 BibTeX 引用及可用的论文全文。

description.en: Read-only IMAP search and attachments, plus SMTP sending under DSH permissions, with separate reading and sending switches and a credential-backed settings…
description.zh: 通过只读 IMAP 检索邮件与获取附件，按 DSH 权限发送 SMTP 邮件，提供独立收发开关和接入凭据存储的设置页。

description.en: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 本地语义记忆与过往对话检索，保留来源引用，支持编辑、保留、遗忘、撤销及 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.
description.zh: 可配置的 OIDC 登录与令牌授权模型接入，支持 LiteLLM 和显式启用的 oidc-llm 集成，提供独立 DSH Web 后端。

description.en: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a…
description.zh: 注册 Qoder 中国版与国际版的语言模型到 DSH，自动获取每个模型的费率，随错峰时段变化。并提供每天签到、用量胶囊与积分查询功能。需要本机Qoder的登录态，或浏览器登录一次。

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

description.en: Right-sidebar prompt shelf for DSH: store prompts as cards, click one to append it to the next message, keep selected cards injected into every turn of the…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏快捷指令库：把常用提示词存成卡片，点一下追加到下一条消息；打开「每轮注入」后按会话在每一轮自动附带；已发出的用户消息也能一键存回。开关按会话保存，数据以原子写入存在 ~/.dsh 下的 JSON 文件中。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live…
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking,…
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

description.en: Study workspace for DeepSeek Harness: imports your own PDF, DOCX, PPTX and Markdown materials plus lecture recordings, turns them into source-cited flashcards,…
description.zh: DSH 的学习工作台：导入自己的 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、Markdown 资料与课堂录音，生成带出处引用的卡片、测验与开放题，按 FSRS-6 安排间隔复习，自带网页面板。导入的录音需用自备的 SiliconFlow、Groq 或 Gemini 密钥转写；课堂实录可改用本机 SenseVoice…

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex…
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Permanently delete sessions from the sidebar after confirmation and show or hide archived sessions. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 在侧栏确认后永久删除会话，可显示或隐藏归档会话。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push /…
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s,…
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11…

description.en: Manage local novel projects, revision history and writing presets from a sidebar workbench.
description.zh: 在侧边工作台管理本地小说项目、修订记录和创作预设。

description.en: ★ 549 │ Download invoice attachments from QQ or 163 mail over IMAP, run OCR locally, file them by rule and produce an Excel summary. Requires Python 3.10+ on Windows x64 or Apple Silicon.
description.zh: ★ 549 │ 通过 IMAP 从 QQ 或 163 邮箱下载发票附件，本地 OCR 识别后按规则归档，并生成 Excel 汇总。需要 Python 3.10+，支持 Windows x64 和 Apple Silicon。

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the…
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Recall experience strategies before tasks and record evaluations from checks and later feedback.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在任务前召回经验策略，根据检查结果和后续反馈记录评价。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Route shell commands and file access into disposable, per-project Podman containers, with approval-aware privilege escalation.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 把命令执行和文件访问都放进按项目隔离的一次性 Podman 容器，并支持需审批的权限提升。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: ★ 10 │ DSH Cordis plugin: hooks the core model-request seam (agent/pre-step and agent/request) to force-compact a session's context and disable thinking per the 强制压缩配置 settings namespace.

description.en: ★ 2 │ DSH Cordis plugin: announces the moment an agent finishes (turns idle) by pushing a 'done' signal from the host half into the falling-ts-web-ding settings namespace that the browser half reads.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在 Agent 完成任务并进入空闲时，向网页界面发送完成提示音信号。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Inline annotations for DeepSeek Harness replies and sidebar documents, with a composer card and a right-sidebar list.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复和侧边栏文档加划词标注，聚合成输入框卡片并一键发给 AI，右侧边栏可查看列表。

description.en: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider…
description.zh: 模型速选器：在模型下拉框左侧添加按钮，弹出全量模型选择窗口（提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、读取用户配置的真实能力标签、推理徽章、最近使用与推理档位选择器），选中后立即回写原生下拉框并生效。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Rewrite the composer draft in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with work, code and design modes, and restore the original text with one click.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的输入栏改写提示词，提供日常办公、代码开发和设计创意三种模式，支持一键还原原文。

description.en: ★ 37 │ Track token and cache usage, account balances and billing, with exportable records.
description.zh: ★ 37 │ 追踪 Token 与缓存用量、账户余额和费用，并导出记录。

description.en: Compare Git/SVN versions across repositories and export Chinese Markdown release reports with optional approved model analysis.
description.zh: 比较多个 Git/SVN 项目的版本差异，导出中文 Markdown 发布报告，并可明确授权模型分析。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Declarative DAG runtime for DSH tool plans with bounded parallel execution, read-only retries, per-step checkpoints, cancellation, and conservative crash…
description.zh: DSH 工具计划的声明式 DAG 运行时，支持有界并行、只读重试、逐步落盘、取消及保守的崩溃恢复。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read-only Git and SVN change preview for DSH.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 面向 DSH 的只读 Git 与 SVN 变更预览。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action…
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: DSH plugin (fork of sj244/dsh-qq-bridge, MIT) that connects DSH sessions to QQ through OneBot/NapCat. Whitelist stays closed until filled in; @-mentions,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat）的插件（fork 自 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，MIT）。白名单默认全关；被 @、叫到昵称或被戳一定叫醒，其余消息按可调概率抽样。Cordis 插件 id 仍是 qq-bridge。它沿用上游的 Cordis…

description.en: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says…
description.zh: 让 Agent 真正看见编译后的页面：把任意一页渲染成图片，用 SyncTeX 把页面坐标或文字锚点解析成源码 file:line（并指出某条横线是宏包画的而不是正文画的——这正是朴素定位最容易出错的地方），把这一页与上一次构建做像素对比，逐页审计本次修改新引入的空洞，并检查图表编号是否仍然顺序正确。

description.en: Keyless web search with one web_tools entry and eight actions for multi-query search, date windows, packages, papers, repositories, platforms, page reading, cited research, cache search and engine health; fuses eight engines and ships a stdio MCP server for other agents.
description.zh: 免密钥网页搜索：一个 web_tools 入口、八个 action，覆盖多查询、日期窗口、包、论文、仓库、平台、正文读取、引用研究、缓存检索与引擎健康；融合八个引擎，并提供给其他 Agent 使用的 stdio MCP server。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Run board or list tasks through DSH sessions and sync their status in host-side storage.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过 DSH 会话执行看板或清单中的任务，把状态回写到宿主端共享存储。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Fish's all-in-one DSH plugin bundle, inserting plugin rows for 13 plugins in one click. Eleven are subpackages in this repo, such as approval-guide and git-graph-fish, and two are external add-ons.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 一键添加 Fish 插件合集中的 13 个插件，其中包含本仓库组件和外部配套插件。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Read-only filename and document-text search using Everything/es.exe and Anytxt. Requires these local engines; searches may include files outside the workspace. Diagnostic routes do not verify host identity; use only on a trusted local machine.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过 Everything/es.exe 和 Anytxt 只读搜索本机文件名与文档正文；需另行安装并运行对应引擎，搜索范围可包含工作区外文件。 诊断路由未校验宿主身份，仅限可信本机使用。

description.en: Adds a "用量" section to the DSH Settings page that shows your MiniMax Token Plan usage (5h and weekly windows with reset countdowns), per-model breakdown, and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页「用量」section 展示 MiniMax Token Plan 的 5 小时 / 周窗口用量（带重置倒计时）、单模型明细与视频赠送额度；通过 trusted plugin 调 `/v1/token_plan/remains` 拿 key，未配置 key 时整段 section 自动隐藏。MIT。

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Host-side TTS bridge for dsh that synthesizes speech over the Edge TTS protocol and serves MP3 on a same-origin route, for containers with no audio device.
description.zh: 宿主侧语音桥：用 Edge TTS 协议合成语音并以 MP3 同源提供，解决容器无声卡、WebView 念不出中文的问题。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free…
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start,…
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: AI quota and usage monitor for DSH: per-window balances, reset countdowns and burn rate for Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity (including the Gemini 4 Argon…
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 额度与用量监控：按额度窗口展示 Codex、Cursor、Google Antigravity（含 Gemini 4 Argon 独立额度池）与 OpenCode-Go 的剩余额度、重置倒计时与消耗速率。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills…
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown,…
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never…
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes…
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191…

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析，支持多市场行情、技术指标、新闻和基本面信息。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Permanently deletes a DeepSeek Harness conversation and all its local data: session log, derived caches, workspace index entries, spill files, and unreferenced attachments.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 永久删除会话及其本地数据，包括日志、缓存、工作区索引记录和不再引用的附件。

description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.zh: ★ 667 │ 将会话知识保存到 Markdown 认知图，提供召回与反思工具。

description.en: ★ 263 │ Fylar Office Editor integration for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile, powered by Fylar Office SDK
description.zh: ★ 263 │ 在 DSH 网页中接入 Fylar Office SDK 文档编辑器。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native…
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): drives the harness agent through long-lived multi-round sessions to write and run…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 AI 智能体驱动自动化测试平台：以长期多轮会话驱动 agent 编写并执行 Markdown 用例、产出 bug 报告、修复代码并复验，配套按项目串行的统一队列、开发看板与内置压测。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Restart or upgrade DSH, inspect runtime health, and manage backups and Linux permissions from a web panel.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 在网页面板中重启或升级 DSH、查看运行状态，并管理备份和 Linux 权限。

description.en: ★ 31 │ Agent-Native document handling for DSH — addressable blocks let an agent read and edit one section instead of the whole file. Ships the geml MCP server and the authoring and code-graph skills.
description.zh: ★ 31 │ 按内容块读取和编辑文档，内置 GEML MCP 服务及文档编写、代码关系图技能。

description.en: Runs the agent through GEML workflows: work items move through flow steps, practices are recorded at the step they belong to, and a board tab in the right…
description.zh: 用 GEML 流程带 agent 干活：工作项按流程一步步走，做法记在它所属的那一步，右侧栏的看板页签显示每件事走到哪了。同时挂上 GEML 的 MCP 服务和技能；项目里有固化流程时，监督器按流程当前状态把关工具调用。需要 Node.js 22+；GEML MCP 服务器在会话启动时经…
★ 54 │ 提取和检索 PDF 内容，通过内置阅读器配合会话阅读论文。
description.en: ★ 54 │ Transcribe and search PDFs, then read papers with a built-in viewer and conversation tools.
Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.
description.zh: 菜单栏应用不在插件里：需在 macOS 上用仓库 app/ 目录自行执行 swift build -c release 构建，插件只提供宿主桥。

description.en: Tiered cold storage for DSH sessions: idle sessions move out of the live root into an on-disk cold tier instead of being deleted, an FTS5 index over that tier…
description.zh: DSH 会话的分层冷存储：闲置会话移出实时根目录、转入磁盘冷层而不被删除；冷层上的 FTS5 索引让它们仍可检索，需要时可将会话恢复回实时根目录。默认为演练模式，在设置页关闭后才会真正移动会话。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key,…
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key…
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Append a passage from a browser-local EPUB/TXT/MD book below real reasoning or tool output when selected chat regions expand. Reading progress stays in the browser; novel text is not written to conversations. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 and Node >=22; EPUB is text-only and excludes DRM.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 展开选中的聊天区域时，在真实思考或工具输出下追加本地 EPUB/TXT/MD 小说，并保存各书进度；小说不写入会话数据。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Node >=22，依赖聊天 DOM；EPUB 只取文字，不支持 DRM。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: ★ 14 │ Add a generate_image tool backed by FAL, any OpenAI-compatible image API or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, with results shown inline and optional approval and budget limits.
description.zh: ★ 14 │ 提供 generate_image 工具，可接 FAL、OpenAI 兼容的图像接口或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，图片直接显示在对话中，可设置审批和预算上限。

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

description.en: Shows API-key and subscription quota limits in the DSH provider interface and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面与设置中显示 API Key 和订阅账户的额度限制。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click…
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness with native and OpenAI-compatible transports.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ollama Cloud 模型接入，支持原生及 OpenAI 兼容传输。

description.en: OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console 与 OpenCode Go 两个 provider。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: ★ 73 │ Provide switchable Russian localization for DSH and ecosystem plugins.
description.zh: ★ 73 │ 为 DSH 核心与生态插件提供可切换的俄语界面。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

description.en: Normalizes malformed token-usage samples so broken session histories remain loadable.
description.zh: 规范化异常的 Token 用量样本，使损坏的会话历史仍可加载。

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a…
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect the local lot-trader ledger to DSH: six read tools and five write tools (buy, add, close, dividend, account) with host approval for every write, plus a sidebar position board. On first use it downloads the trade engine from the author’s GitHub Releases and installs it only if the SHA-256 matches. Records trades; it does not place orders.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把本机 lot-trader 操盘账本接入 DSH：6 个读工具、5 个写工具（买入、加仓、平仓、记分红、建账户），写操作都走宿主审批，侧栏提供持仓看板。首次使用会从作者 GitHub Releases 下载 trade 引擎，SHA-256 校验通过才安装。只记账，不下单。

description.en: Runs Superpowers as an agent preset and gives each skill its own subagent model from a Settings table, so TDD, debugging and verification no longer all inherit…
description.zh: 把 Superpowers 作为 Agent 预设运行，并在设置表里为每个技能单独指定子代理模型，测试、系统调试与收尾验证不再全部沿用父会话的模型。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Create, import and manage personality presets, with global and per-conversation choices. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Estimate session and turn costs with model prices in USD or CNY and price sync from models.dev, OpenRouter, or DeepInfra.
description.zh: 估算会话和每轮费用，按模型设置 USD 或 CNY 单价，并从 models.dev、OpenRouter 或 DeepInfra 同步价格。

description.en: IDEA-style Git tool window for DSH: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/branch/author/date/path filters, staged and unstaged changes…
description.zh: DSH 里的 IDEA 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/分支/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、已暂存与未暂存变更和提交框、提交详情与逐文件行级 diff、贮藏与工作树管理、git 控制台日志，以及 AI 撰写提交信息。KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git（MIT）的…

description.en: Learn an ERP through the browser into private local knowledge, with a desktop Adapt ERP workspace (multi-site sessions, chat in the middle and the official…
description.zh: 通过浏览器学习 ERP 并沉淀为私有本地知识；桌面端提供「ERP 助手」工作区（多站点会话、中对话+右浏览器、写入前审批）。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduce context usage.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器，按需加载并筛选工具以减少上下文占用。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which…
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

description.en: Infinite canvas workspace in the DSH sidebar — arrange text, image, video and audio nodes, generate media with AI, and let agents drive every canvas operation…
description.zh: 无限画布右侧栏插件——在画布上编排文本、图片、视频、音频节点，用 AI 生成媒体内容，Agent 经 MCP 工具直接操作画布；自带本地桥服务，安装后离线可用。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏与浮层工作台中管理已有本地仓库，支持查看改动、提交、获取、拉取、推送以及浏览分支和历史。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and…
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session…
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Export and import session packages, relocate workspaces and sessions, and synchronize them between machines.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 导入导出会话包，迁移工作区与会话目录，并在机器之间同步会话。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Keyboard navigation for the DSH Web GUI: hold Control for 1-9 conversation numbers in the sidebar, Control+Tab to cycle, Control+J to jump to any conversation…
description.zh: 键盘流 DSH 会话导航：按住 Control 在侧边栏显示 1-9 编号、Control+Tab 轮转、Control+J 从覆盖全部会话（含折叠分组与未渲染行）的面板跳转；双击 Option 为可点击控件显示字母提示，Option+Enter 聚焦输入框。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side…
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports…
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: DocsMint workspace panel and agent tools for document search, reading, creation and updates through Cloud OAuth or self-hosted API keys.
description.zh: DocsMint 工作区面板与智能体工具，支持文档搜索、读取、创建和更新，可连接 Cloud OAuth 或自托管 API 密钥。

description.en: Inline diff cards for every edit, write and str_replace_editor call: old/new line numbers, character-level highlighting, 57-language detection with a…
description.zh: 为 edit、write、str_replace_editor 调用就地渲染内联差异卡片：旧/新行号、字符级高亮、57 种语言检测与红绿安全的语法配色，另有左右对照、Read 行范围，以及可配置的显示风格与高亮设置。

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and…
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with…
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Adds a left-sidebar panel to the DSH Web GUI: one ranked board of the films and series released in the past 21 days or due within the next 31 days, taken from…
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页版的左侧栏加一块影视雷达：把近 21 天内上映与未来 31 天内定档的电影和剧集排成一张加权榜单，美国、欧洲五国、日本和韩国取自 JustWatch，中国取自豆瓣。每行带海报（图床不可达时用绘制的占位图）、五句以内简介、豆瓣与烂番茄评分和豆瓣热门短评。搜索框输入即筛，并向豆瓣、TVMaze 与…

description.en: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark…
description.zh: 轻量的 DSH 字体与主题插件：中英文与代码字体选择器（只列本机已安装的字体），以及 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub、Catppuccin 五套官方色板预设，全部走官方主题 token（含代码块语法高亮），不打包字体、零依赖、零构建。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新。

description.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness session finishes a turn or needs your approval.
description.zh: 会话完成一轮任务或需要你审批时，弹出系统桌面通知。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the…
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的…

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH on Windows, macOS and Linux. While the DSH window is in the background, permission requests arrive as system…
description.zh: DSH 的原生桌面通知。窗口在后台时权限确认直接出现在系统通知里；平台支持通知按钮时，点「拒绝 / 允许一次」即把结果交回宿主审批流程，切回窗口或超时则退回应用内审批面板。权限确认与提问还会播放独立于窗口焦点的交互提示音；任务完成、提问、错误提醒、通知铃声与提示音都在「通知提醒」设置页配置。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin adding two code-quality skills: /simplify (behavior-preserving cleanups of the current diff) and /code-review (multi-angle review).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 提供 /simplify 和 /code-review 技能，清理当前改动并进行多角度代码审查。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness turn ends: bundled Python/PowerShell notifier, custom command fallback, and its own Settings page.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话轮次结束时发送桌面通知，提供 Python/PowerShell 通知器，也可执行自定义通知命令。

description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek…
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness bundle: aligns the Markdown pipe tables touched by each write or edit, and reports what changed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 自动对齐写入或编辑的 Markdown 表格，并说明改动内容。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder…
description.zh: 用可配置的模型和整段可改的改写指令，把输入框草稿改写成精确提示词；会读取 @文件、@文件夹、@会话 引用指向的内容作为上下文，并原样保留引用标记；支持一键撤销优化、恢复你自己敲的原文；按钮可放在输入框左侧或右侧工具栏，颜色与大小均可调整。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect the wensu stdio MCP server for read-only CNKI and Web of Science bibliographic search, details, export and status, without full-text downloads. Requires Windows, Python 3.11+, wensu on PATH, and a separately configured Edge or Chrome extension and native host. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入文溯 stdio MCP，提供知网与 Web of Science 只读题录检索、详情、导出与状态查询，不下载全文。需要 Windows、Python 3.11+、PATH 中的 wensu 命令，并另行配置 Edge/Chrome 扩展和原生宿主。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 303 │ dsh-tianshu-tui: an interactive terminal UI plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown/tool cards, 16+ themes, slash commands, session tabs, LSP diagnostics, cost tracking, self-update (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui`)
description.zh: ★ 303 │ 在终端中浏览流式回复、工具卡片、会话、诊断与费用。

description.en: Local meeting transcription for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS: dual-track recording, live transcript drafts with speaker labels, and @-referenced…
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及 @ 引用的总结、决策与待办。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: ★ 60 │ Configure reasoning effort for third-party models and default subagent settings.
description.zh: ★ 60 │ 为第三方模型配置思考强度，并设置子 Agent 的默认档位。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph…

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section —…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」…

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker…

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: ★ 67 │ Install reusable plugin templates, development tools and a bundled starter collection.
description.zh: ★ 67 │ 安装可复用的插件模板、开发工具与入门组合包。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one…

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback)…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Open an OpenBMC web console from DSH settings through an SSH-forwarded same-origin proxy that follows BMC IP changes. Requires an SSH jump host that can reach the BMC.

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset…

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine…
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.zh: ★ 128 │ 安装极简模式的 Windows 版预设，通过 Git for Windows 的 bash 执行命令。仅在完全访问权限下运行命令。

description.en: Transcribe session audio through V-yovoice and display a waveform player and transcript. Needs a reachable V-yovoice service (its root URL is set in the…
