description.en: Configurable session titles with custom prompts, refresh policies, local topic-drift detection, and single-session or historical title regeneration.
description.zh: 可配置的会话标题生成，支持自定义提示词、刷新策略、本地话题漂移检测，以及单条会话和历史标题重建。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

description.en: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one…
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry…
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: A Google Docs-style word processor inside DeepSeek Harness with rich text, page setup, tables, images, print, export, and agent editing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 Google Docs 风格文字处理器：富文本、页面设置、表格、图片、打印、导出，并支持由 agent 直接编辑。

description.en: An agent-writable spreadsheet editor inside DeepSeek Harness with formulas, formatting, CSV/Excel import, and export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里可由 agent 直接写入的电子表格编辑器：支持公式、格式、CSV/Excel 导入与导出。

description.en: Personal memory sidebar and agent tools for Mory, with search, editing and optional GitHub/Gitee synchronization. Requires a Mory service installed and running…
description.zh: Mory 个人记忆侧栏与智能体工具，支持记忆检索、编辑及可选的 GitHub/Gitee 同步。需在 DSH 宿主机上先安装并启动 Mory 服务。

description.en: Set an earlier automatic-compaction threshold per model on DeepSeek Harness: /autocompact writes a session-only override keyed by exact provider/model (off…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 按模型设置更早的自动压缩阈值：/autocompact 以精确 provider/model 为键写入仅本会话生效的覆盖值（off 回退后端默认、default 清除覆盖），设置页「自动压缩」管理所有会话继承的持久化逐模型阈值，输入框状态条目显示当前读数。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships…
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps…

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or…

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an…
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Replacement web interface for the unmodified official DSH release: collapsible reasoning groups, a turn timeline with adjustable reading width, cards for tool…
description.zh: 给未改动的官方 DSH 换一套网页界面：思考过程分组折叠、对话轮次时间轴与可调阅读宽度、工具调用卡片、模型与思考强度选择面板、子智能体编队视图、回答里可选的图表与流程图组件、明暗主题和手机布局。从 npm 安装，卸载即恢复官方界面。可选的 jev_presentation_advice 工具只有在你保存…

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global…
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: An agent that wakes up on its own schedule: by default every 60 minutes, ±20% (48–72). It browses the interests you set, drops what it finds into a local pool of notes, and keeps a profile of what you like. When it has enough worth sharing it hands the session you linked a short package of notes — whether to speak, and which note to use, is that session's agent's call in the moment. Quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit and a cooldown are decided in code; when the answer is no, the decision and expression phases after the gate call no model at all — browsing runs before the gate and is counted separately. Windows, Linux and macOS (Linux and macOS are minimal support).
description.zh: 让 agent 不定期醒来的插件：默认 60 分钟一次，上下浮动 20%（48~72 分钟）。按你设的兴趣范围上网逛逛，看到的东西存进本地素材池，顺手维护一份你的兴趣画像。攒够值得说的，就往你绑定的会话递一份短素材——说不说、说哪条，交给那个会话里的 agent 按眼前处境定。静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却都在代码层判；判别说时，闸门之后的决策与表达两相不再调用模型（闲逛相在闸门之前，另算）。支持 Windows、Linux 与 macOS（Linux / macOS 为最小支持）。

description.en: Multi-user collaboration rooms for DeepSeek Harness: discuss work, coordinate tasks, propose changes, and review them from each participant's local DSH.…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多人协作房间：参与者在各自本地 DSH 中讨论、协调任务、提出并审阅变更。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与一个 Git 工作区。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在…

description.en: Linear tools for DeepSeek Harness: 26 model-facing tools over the Linear GraphQL API (issues, comments, relations, teams, states, labels, projects, cycles,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linear 工具：26 个基于 Linear GraphQL API 的模型工具（议题、评论、关联、团队、状态、标签、项目、周期、用户），外加 linear_graphql 逃生口。需自备 Linear 个人 API token。

description.en: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native…
description.zh: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Point the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools at Keenable. Queries and fetched URLs are sent to api.keenable.ai, and pages are fetched on Keenable's servers. Works without a key at up to 1,000 requests per hour per IP; an optional API key lifts the limit. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.4.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把内置 web_search 和 web_fetch 接到 Keenable。搜索词和要抓取的网址会发送到 api.keenable.ai，网页在 Keenable 服务器上抓取。无需密钥即可使用，按 IP 每小时 1000 次；可选 API Key 解除限制。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.4.0。

description.en: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click…
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: ★ 70 │ Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness (memory palace · AGI Architecture Exploration on dsh-market): dual-scope SQLite memory graph, hybrid retrieval, provenance audit, and a knowledge flywheel.
description.zh: ★ 70 │ 用 SQLite 记忆图、混合检索和来源记录保存跨会话知识。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color…
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: ★ 101 │ Usage billing dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar cost metrics plus a full dashboard modal, priced from a current multi-provider catalog with real usage aggregated from session logs.
description.zh: ★ 101 │ 从会话日志汇总实际用量，显示多供应商价格与侧栏费用指标。

description.en: Native Windows completion and approval notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with session titles, optional AI summaries, quick reply, and an opt-in taskbar…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带会话标题的 Windows 原生完成与审批通知，支持可选 AI 总结、通知内回复和可独立开启的任务栏完成角标。通知携带原会话路由，跳转取决于 Windows 激活。角标需要 PowerShell 7。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV,…
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just…
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows)…
description.zh: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

description.en: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence;…
description.zh: 输入框内的 Codex 风格模型选择器：列出 profile 全部 provider/model，四档推理力度，选择按会话记忆；原生选择器的禁用补丁随包内置。

description.en: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card…
description.zh: 会话内选中文字即弹出工具条：添加到对话、新开讨论或复制；引用折叠为输入框旁的引用卡片，双击跳回被引用轮次。

description.en: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.
description.zh: 在工作区之间安全移动会话：移动前校验运行中/子代理/离线状态，每次移动自动备份到 ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/。

description.en: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites…
description.zh: 会话工具箱：导出 Markdown 与零依赖批量 ZIP、时间线浮层快速跳轮、安全复制会话（自动重写内部身份字段）、侧栏右键菜单扩展。

description.en: Usage statistics settings page computed locally from session logs: 30-day daily list, per-model and per-session tables with provider-aware pricing (DeepSeek…
description.zh: 用量统计设置页：全部基于本地会话日志计算（近 30 天条形图 / 模型表 / 会话表），按服务商感知计价（官方峰谷、内置 TokenBom 平价表），并跳过子代理会话继承的历史事件避免重复计费。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official…
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month /…
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

description.en: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
description.zh: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Refresh session titles from recent user messages through the selected model, with byte budgets and status prefixes. Extra model calls may incur fees.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过所选模型按近期用户消息更新会话标题，支持字节预算与状态前缀，额外模型调用可能收费。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while…
description.zh: 选中 DSH 已提交回复中的文字，开启独立、持久、只读的多轮 Topic；Topic 绑定来源会话证据与项目文件，来源 Agent 可继续运行。

description.en: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.
description.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，并在一个控制台里集中管理：单条删除、可筛选的批量清理与维护清扫。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits,…
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开…

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Auto Title: keeps session titles following the latest task; names you set by hand stay put.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 随最新任务自动更新会话标题，保留手动设置的名称。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Read official DSH documentation in the plugin page and search docs or npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在插件页阅读 DSH 官方文档，并用原生工具检索文档和 npm 元数据。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Sidekick: persistent Lead–Sidekick collaboration. Delegate bounded tasks, then accept or send back exact results.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 让主模型与 Sidekick 持续协作，委派明确范围的任务，逐项验收或退回修改。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Git Commit: commit workspace changes from the conversation header, with model-planned commit groups.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在会话标题栏提交工作区改动，由模型规划提交分组。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Long-term Memory: remember vocabulary, preferences, and recent activity per scope, consolidated by Dream.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 按作用范围保存词汇、偏好和近期活动，通过 Dream 整理长期记忆。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Session Recap: writes session recaps in the background and gives the agent bounded progress checkpoints.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 在后台生成会话摘要，记录阶段进度，供 Agent 后续继续工作。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Zhihu search, agent tools, knowledge bases, and usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎搜索、Agent 工具、知识库及用量追踪。

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

description.en: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

description.en: ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness, with durable API-key settings and CLI configuration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 接入 ZPDF 工具，支持 API 密钥保存和命令行配置。

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git…
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

description.en: Skill manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: lists global and project-level skills with call counts, last-used dates and estimated context tokens, and…
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏「Skill 管理」：列出全局与项目级 skill 的调用次数、最近使用时间与估算占用 tokens，支持把 skill 目录移入同级可逆的 skill-archive 归档、以及一键还原。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Shows the current workspace's Git commit graph in the right sidebar of DSH Desktop. Desktop profile only; needs git on PATH.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 桌面端右侧栏显示当前工作区的 Git 提交图。仅支持桌面端，需要本机已安装 git。

description.en: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3…
description.zh: Claude 式的项目与讨论串：项目主对话为能独立完成的任务开讨论串（可以点开直接对话的真实会话），默认最多 3 个同时运行，可各自在独立的 git worktree 里工作，做完把回报发回主对话。

description.en: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable…
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中呈现 ChatGPT 风格的富文本回答：实体面板、指标卡、多序列图表、可排序表格、嵌套分层图、流程图与本地控件。

description.en: Deletes a DSH session from the session menu, and lists the workspace files that session touched so you choose which ones to remove with it. Deletion is…
description.zh: 在会话菜单里删除 DSH 会话，并列出该会话碰过的工作区文件，由你勾选哪些一起删掉。删除是永久的、无法撤销；通过 shell 命令写出的文件不在追踪范围内。

description.en: Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not…
description.zh: 自动隔离损坏插件、让 DSH 其余插件照常启动——通过补丁 DSH 自身已安装的内核实现（挂载期隔离 + 补丁自愈），而非 preflight 冒烟测试。附带状态工具与一键恢复面板。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box…
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node…

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.
description.zh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

description.en: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding…
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API…

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with…
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用…

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.
description.zh: DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。

description.en: Window close behaviour for DeepSeek Harness Desktop — ask, minimise to tray, or quit, with a remembered choice editable in Settings, plus per-session and…

description.en: Multi-device DSH network: sidebar topology, peer health, delegation, file transfer and node management over TLS, LAN and public tunnels. DSH spawns its mesh server (127.0.0.1:8124) detached at startup and restarts it if it exits, and the server always answers LAN discovery on UDP 0.0.0.0:8129. Once a peer is paired, the default ACL lets it read, search and write files under ~/Code, read session history and logs, and delegate tasks to your DSH sessions; shell_run, channel messages, remote desktop and repair stay off until you allow them. If SakuraFrp is installed it reads that launcher's account token (or SAKURA_TOKEN) to query api.natfrp.com tunnels. Its /api/dsh-mesh routes are guarded only by a loopback peer-address check.
description.zh: 多设备 DSH 网络：侧栏拓扑、节点健康、委托、文件传输与节点管理，支持 TLS、局域网与公网隧道。DSH 启动时会把它的 mesh 服务（127.0.0.1:8124）以分离进程拉起、退出后重启，且服务始终在 UDP 0.0.0.0:8129 应答局域网发现。peer 配对后，默认 ACL 允许它读取、检索、写入 ~/Code 下的文件，读取会话历史和日志，并把任务委托给你本机的 DSH 会话；shell_run、频道消息、远程桌面和 repair 在你放开之前是关闭的。本机装了 SakuraFrp 时，会读取其 Launcher 的账号 token（或 SAKURA_TOKEN）去查询 api.natfrp.com 的隧道。它的 /api/dsh-mesh 路由只靠对端地址是否回环来放行。

description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend…
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable…
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent…

description.en: Mobile viewport lock, overscroll containment, virtual keyboard resizing, and sidebar auto-retraction.
description.zh: 移动端视口锁定、滚动溢出阻断、虚拟键盘自适应及侧边栏自动收起。

description.en: 🌌 Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin, it provides cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task-graph…
description.zh: 🌌 Mebular 忆云 · 智能体共享记忆与任务协作。通过 DSH 原生插件接入，提供跨设备、跨 Agent 记忆共享与任务图功能，让物理设备不再是你智能体的边界，安全、可控、去中心化！插件连接已有的 Mebular App/CLI 运行时；没有时可在面板里按提示安装共享运行时，不会静默启动或下载 Mebular。

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and…
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一…

description.en: ★ 0 │ A draggable, collapsible Minesweeper overlay with configurable board size. Game state stays in memory and resets when the page reloads.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 可拖动、可折叠的扫雷浮层，支持调整棋盘与雷数；状态仅保存在内存，刷新后重置。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek's official service status in the DSH session header, including overall and per-component status, uptime percentages, and active or recent…
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态，包括总体状态、各组件状态、可用率，以及进行中或最近的事件。这是 KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status 的维护分支（0.1.6 起以 @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status 发布）；不要与原版…

description.en: Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and…
description.zh: ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: ★ 243 │ Summon any of 331 domain experts or five built-in expert teams in DSH for reviews, design, operations and research, with the main session pulling the results together.
description.zh: ★ 243 │ 在 DSH 中召唤 331 位专业智能体或 5 个内置专家团，协助代码审查、设计、运营和研究，由主会话汇总结果。

description.en: ★ 346 │ Archive, restore, favorite and remove sessions, and diagnose damaged session logs.
description.zh: ★ 346 │ 归档、恢复、收藏和删除会话，并诊断损坏的会话日志。

description.en: ★ 40 │ Schedule one-off or recurring coding tasks that run in their own DSH sessions with a chosen workspace, model, skills and permissions, and review each run afterwards.
description.zh: ★ 40 │ 按计划在独立的 DSH 会话中执行一次性或周期性编码任务，可设置工作目录、模型、技能和权限，并回看每次运行的结果。

description.en: ★ 60 │ Answers from the current context in an independent bubble, without running tools.
description.zh: ★ 60 │ 根据当前上下文在独立气泡中回答旁支问题，不调用工具。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: ★ 294 │ A Codex-style sidebar for DSH Web with a workspace session tree, global search and turn navigation, in light and dark themes. Do not enable it together with ds-bot.
description.zh: ★ 294 │ 为 DSH Web 提供 Codex 风格的侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航，支持浅色和深色主题。不要与 ds-bot 同时启用。

description.en: ★ 136 │ Hand tasks to your local DSH from Feishu, Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, WeChat, QQ, Telegram, Discord or Slack, and get replies, answer questions and approve tools in the same chat.
description.zh: ★ 136 │ 通过飞书、Lark、钉钉、企业微信、微信、QQ、Telegram、Discord 或 Slack 把任务交给本机 DSH，并在同一聊天里接收回复、回答问题和审批工具。

description.en: ★ 71 │ Bring PUA to DSH: push the agent to change approach and verify results instead of giving up or declaring done too early, with persona styles, acceptance loops and status cards. Results depend on the model.
description.zh: ★ 71 │ 把 PUA 带到 DSH：在 Agent 反复失败、过早放弃或草率宣告完成时，引导它换方法、拿证据，提供多种风格、验收循环和状态卡片。效果取决于所用模型。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Run /simplify to have the agent tidy code within the current Git changes, the staged files, a commit or a path, keeping behavior unchanged. Prompts are in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 输入 /simplify，让 Agent 在当前 Git 改动、暂存区、指定提交或路径范围内整理代码，保持原有功能。提示词为简体中文。

description.en: ★ 553 │ Manage local and project skills with repository installs, update previews, backups, and restoration.
description.zh: ★ 553 │ 管理本机与项目技能，支持仓库安装、更新预览及备份恢复。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Keep your git workflow inside DeepSeek Harness. A composer chip shows the current branch at a glance; the TRAE-style popup lets you switch or create branches,…
description.zh: 让 git 操作不离开 DSH 聊天窗口。输入框工具行的胶囊实时显示当前分支；TRAE 风格弹层一键切换/新建分支、同步远端、勾选改动提交推送、按来源 -> 目标流向合并分支、暂存与恢复部分改动。所有面板停靠在输入框上方，不遮挡草稿；菜单打开时预取改动列表；工作区不干净时先确认再操作。非 git 目录自动隐藏。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A bottom bar for DeepSeek, Codex and OpenRouter balances and quotas, plus internet radio. Requires the corresponding account or API key; radio streams from third-party services.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在底栏显示 DeepSeek、Codex 和 OpenRouter 余额及额度，附网络电台；需相应账号或 API Key，电台流来自第三方服务。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export…
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Polishes the composer draft: opening the panel optimizes once with the default template, replacing the draft shows a line-by-line diff first, and a 9-second…
description.zh: 输入框旁的提示词优化器：打开面板即按默认模板优化一次，替换草稿前先给逐行 diff，替换后 9 秒内可撤销。五种模板（基础 / 结构 / 示范 / 推理 / 迭代）换选择不计费，历史与版本链存在本机，界面跟随 Harness 语言切换。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a…
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost,…
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view,…
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: ★ 5,125 │ Better Sidebar for DSH: file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, kept separate per conversation, plus a service other plugins use to register sidebar items.
description.zh: ★ 5,125 │ 在同一侧栏查看文件、编辑器、变更、任务和旁聊，各会话分别保存状态，也可供其他插件扩展。

description.en: Sidebar artifact shelf that collects the images, videos, files and links sessions deliver, deduplicated by SHA-256 content hash, with five filter tabs and…
description.zh: 侧边栏产物架：把会话交付过的图片、视频、文件和链接收进一处，按 SHA-256 内容哈希去重；五个分类标签带计数、关键词搜索、视频缩略图、灯箱查看、手动收藏链接、粘贴图片、上传文件（≤25MB）、首次启动回填历史会话日志，并提供 save_artifact 工具供模型主动收藏。收集到的文件会复制进…

description.en: ★ 223 │ Cross-session memory: auto-distill each session into a local SQLite store, inject on demand, consolidate while idle (autoDream).
description.zh: ★ 223 │ 将会话内容提炼并保存到本机 SQLite，按需调取，空闲时自动整理记忆。

description.en: ★ 35 │ Custom Claude provider support for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2
description.zh: ★ 35 │ 为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 接入自定义 Claude 供应商。

description.en: Single-owner cloud tasks for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): submit from local chat or either IM bot, run continuously in a native cloud worker, and follow overall…
description.zh: DSH 单用户云端任务（大肥鱼 bot）：从本地对话或双端 IM 机器人交办，云端原生持续执行，在工作台查看整体进展与成果并继续跟进。任务权限独立于 IM，支持约定交付及会话归档恢复。

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per…
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Harness-neutral reliability infrastructure for AI coding agents: reversible destructive actions, pre-emission redaction, recovery evidence, and a shared Decision Protocol with optional native adapters.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 为编程 Agent 提供可撤销的高风险操作、输出脱敏、恢复记录和共享决策协议。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Generate images, video, music and speech through multiple providers, with transcription and visual analysis tools.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 接入多家供应商生成图片、视频、音乐和语音，并提供转写与视觉分析工具。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Browse, search, and install SkillHub skills inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索并安装 SkillHub 技能。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and…
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Manage MCP server configuration, startup, reconnection and tool switches, and import JSON configurations.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 管理 MCP 服务器配置、启停、重连和工具开关，并导入 JSON 配置。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH…
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart…
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the…
description.zh: 调 DeepSeek Harness 整体观感与操作的开关集合，管的是整套界面而不只是某几块；每个开关独立生效，随宿主能力增长继续增加。包含 8 套极简主题的画廊（每套为浅色与深色各定义一组配色，通过单一主题变量层整套换色）、把侧栏面板行收成一个「面板」入口的收纳功能（点开是两列启动面板，带搜索与键盘操作），以及侧栏底…

description.en: Schedules a daily, weekly or monthly GitHub Trending digest, has a local trendradar core write Chinese summaries and period recaps, commits them to your own repo and opens the pull request, and shows an overview, digest, run history, subscription and settings workbench.
description.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月周期定时生成 GitHub 趋势日报，由本地 trendradar 核心写中文简介与周期总结、提交到你自己的仓库并开 PR，内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept for 7 days, and controls which agents can see each skill and whether the model may invoke it.
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: ★ 10 │ A bundle of session plugins that adds in-place edit, retry, recall and fork to conversations in DSH Web.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 组合多个会话插件，为 DSH Web 的对话提供就地编辑、重试、撤回和分支。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Ollama bundle: configures the ollama provider for llm-pi-ai and sets web_search to use the Ollama backend, including provider selection in the web row, all in one go.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 配置 Ollama 模型供应商和网页搜索后端，可在网页中切换。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Session modes and injection surface: mode rows (persona, tool and policy lists, toggles), a subagent takeover row, injection channels and tool descriptions. Row lists come from the session's shipped preset; this package adds no preset.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 为预设提供会话模式、工具权限和提示词注入设置；模式内容由会话使用的预设提供。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an…
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Store project pitfalls and reusable practices in separate volumes, with monotonic identifiers and synchronized indexes.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 分册保存项目常见问题和可复用做法，用递增编号管理条目并同步索引。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code,…
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot…

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections…
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

description.en: ★ 67 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: control the Unity Editor through the unity CLI — project management, live-editor pipeline commands, and C# eval as agent tools.
description.zh: ★ 67 │ 通过 Unity 命令行管理项目、执行编辑器流程和 C# 代码。

description.en: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a…
description.zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: ★ 400 │ Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
description.zh: ★ 400 │ 通过原生适配器为 DSH 接入 OpenCode Zen 模型。

description.en: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the…
description.zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: ★ 82 │ Terminal-native ACP client UI; Cordis client tree, any ACP agent
description.zh: ★ 82 │ 在终端中使用 DSH 或其他兼容 ACP 的 Agent，并通过 Cordis 插件扩展界面。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the…
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi…

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare,…
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer…

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player…
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range…

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed;…
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks,…
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user…
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation…
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API…
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench…
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Personal assistant for projects, conversations, memory, reviews and news. Bundled WeChat pins the QR-confirmed account; first messages cannot claim ownership.…
description.zh: 个人助理：在授权范围内整理项目，衔接原生对话、记忆、回顾与资讯。单包内置微信，扫码确认账号为唯一操作者，陌生人先发消息不能认领；白名单可进一步限制，身份缺失或冲突会暂停并提示在电脑恢复。接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of…
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Community fork of l246804/dsh-pstack (cannot be installed alongside it: same plugin ids and tool names) that ports the pstack workflow system to dsh: 58…
description.zh: l246804/dsh-pstack 的社区 fork（与上游不能同装：插件 id 与工具名相同），把 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh 并补齐可用性：58 个技能、5 个 preset、不依赖 PATH 里 node 的脚本运行器、脚本前置检查，以及 Cursor 词汇的翻译层。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning…
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can…
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and…
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing…
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT,…
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或…

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the…
description.zh: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。它的 POST 路由（添加、暂停、删除下载，可指定保存目录）通过 webServer.register…

description.en: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; runs as a workbench module or standalone. The port card works on Windows only…
description.zh: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量四张卡片，可放大到整页；既可作工作台模块，也能独立运行。端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

description.en: UI design knowledge base: 99 filterable design cards with live demos, implementation prompts and per-design usage notes, plus an agent tool that finds and…
description.zh: UI 设计知识库：99 项可筛选设计，带可交互 demo、实现提示词和适用/不适用场景，配套 agent 工具按场景检索并应用。

description.en: Workbench shell: mirrors native sidebar entries into a fixed system bar, adds a second row of page tabs for modules, and exposes a small module API for…
description.zh: 工作台外壳：把原生侧栏项镜像成固定的系统栏，给模块加第二行页面标签，并提供一套给整页插件用的模块 API；重启按钮需要外部管理器（DSH_RESTART_CMD 或 DSH_RESTART_TASK 指定的计划任务）。

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak…
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader…
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Edit Markdown or rich text as A4 handouts, render PDFs and print through existing CUPS queues. Requires macOS/Linux, local Chrome/Chromium and CUPS; Poppler enables thumbnails. Includes the print_handout Agent tool. Author-tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5. Draft HTML is restored without sanitization, and print paths are not confined to the generated-file directory. Use only trusted documents.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 Markdown 或富文本排成 A4 讲义、生成 PDF，并通过已有 CUPS 队列打印。需 macOS/Linux、本机 Chrome/Chromium 和 CUPS，缩略图另需 Poppler；提供 print_handout 智能体工具。作者验证 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。 草稿 HTML 恢复未清洗，打印文件范围未限定在生成目录；仅处理可信文稿。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Track running and completed sessions in a searchable task panel with persistent unread status, sound and browser notifications. macOS also supports system notifications; browser notifications require permission. Author-tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在任务面板中搜索与筛选运行中、已完成会话，保留未读状态，并提供声音和浏览器通知。macOS 另支持系统通知，浏览器通知需授权；作者验证环境为 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka and other booking sites, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API…
description.zh: 通过远程 PriceWin MCP 服务器（无需账号或 API key）实时比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com、Traveloka 等预订网站的酒店与机票价格，并附带旅行搜索 skill。在 Web 界面中结果以卡片呈现：酒店照片、评分、整段住宿总价及各网站带链接的价格；航班显示起降时间、经停与…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Pando desktop pet for the DSH UI, a replica of the confirmo.love companion with a local sprite directory and community sprites. Drag to move and right-click to switch sprites.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 添加 Pando 桌宠，支持本地及社区精灵图，拖动位置、右键切换角色。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Tavily web search for DSH (keyless or keyed, official DeepSeek when off), plus the Tavily MCP: search, extract, crawl, map and research.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 接入 Tavily 网页搜索和 MCP 的提取、抓取、站点映射与研究工具；关闭后使用 DeepSeek 默认搜索。

description.en: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图与生视频插件：文生图/图生图按渠道配置模型目录，并按模型族适配请求协议（gpt-image、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana、Seedream、GLM-Image、Qwen-Image、MiniMax image-01、DALL-E 3），提供侧边栏生图工作台、带节点工作流的无限画布、文件预览与画布技能，以及提示词模板库；生视频侧含文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧与多参考图模式，走异步提交/轮询/下载链路，另有宿主侧视频工具、画布视频节点，并可用本机 ffmpeg 把两个以上视频节点拼接成一个 MP4。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行（含未钉住的，未钉面板临时打开后还原）与第三方插件入口收进一个可搜索的分组「面板」菜单——分组折叠记忆、菜单内搜索带命中高亮与全键盘导航、Alt+1..9 直达第 N 个可见项、悬停钉住/置顶快捷操作。Ctrl+K…

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: Desktop pet companion for DSH with live task HUD, token and cost stats, balance and peak-hour alerts, reasoning-effort control, current and history…
description.zh: DSH 桌面伴侣：任务实时 HUD、Token 与费用统计、余额与峰谷提醒、推理等级切换、当前与历史对话搜索、会话管理。

description.en: ★ 0 │ View local AI usage and optionally submit anonymous data to a rolling seven-day ranking.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 查看本地 AI 用量，并可选择匿名参与近七日用量排行。

description.en: Enhances native DSH subagents and teams with persistent subagents, improved subagent messaging, and per-member model selection for teams. Adds no extra tools…

description.en: Layered memory for AI agents: five verbs (wake/work/pit/tomb/close), core layer read every time, archive on demand. Plain markdown, four pages created on first…
Provider and account hub for DeepSeek Harness: several API-key accounts per provider with one-click switching and failover when a call dies on quota or…

description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models…

description.en: ★ 3 │ View desktop usage, provider quotas and custom queries, with optional WorkBuddy credits and an extended model selector.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 查看桌面用量、供应商配额与自定义查询，可选 WorkBuddy 积分和扩展模型选择器。

description.zh: ★ 3,098 │ 在设置页切换已安装的皮肤，并调整各皮肤自带的选项。

description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.zh: ★ 3,098 │ 提供黑鲸主题、直角界面、线条图标及明暗配色。

description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Customize theme palettes, light/dark colors, Latin/CJK/code fonts and interface text size. Preferences are saved per profile. Author-tested on DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 Web GUI.

A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses…
description.zh: 在DSH里养一只大肥鱼宠物，你可以陪伴她长大。养成系体验，没有人格设置，通过你和她的互动学习成长。她可以自己刷B站，写日记，提取信息去问你，你的反馈决定了她成为什么样的人。通过事件流突破四个阶段、三道瓶颈，去积累「立场清单」，四个阶段完成后才会开始有立场。她的日记默认只给自己看，你在设置里打开就能读。事件流不能删除记录…

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime…

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn…
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.

description.en: Wenyuan Pavilion: an AI Team workbench for DSH with owned tasks, independent acceptance, an append-only ledger and concurrent projects. Install it into its own profile (dsh plugin --profile ai-team add @suifei/dsh-ai-team), not web or desktop: its patch sets that profile's sandbox to danger-full-access and approvals to never, and the member agents run with full access. The project's PMO acts automatically by default (every 60 s it resolves pending decisions and wakes owners to dispatch the next tasks); turn off PMO auto to send decisions to your inbox.
