description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading.…
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query…

description.en: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its…

description.en: Pick elements on a real Chrome, Edge or ego lite page inside DeepSeek Harness, comment and screenshot them, then insert the annotation as a chat reference chip…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里拾取真实 Chrome / Edge / ego lite 页面上的元素，写评论、截元素图，再把标注插入对话输入框——agent 拿到 CSS 选择器、页面位置、评论与截图，照着你眼前的界面改前端。它用自己的用户目录和随机本地调试端口启动 Chrome 或…

description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check /…

description.en: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders…
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面端窗口标题栏显示自定义文字与图片，支持多条目轮播、每条独立字体/颜色/对齐/流光，并可在设置里编辑；非 Windows 桌面端不渲染。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Check and update local applications on Windows with winget and macOS with Homebrew. Downloads and installs software; administrator approval may be required. Keep the optional legacy loopback mode disabled unless needed.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 检查并更新本机应用，Windows 使用 winget，macOS 更新需 Homebrew。会下载和安装软件，可能触发管理员授权；旧宿主回环兼容模式建议保持关闭。

description.en: Read-only Windows AppData analyzer: click the sidebar icon to drill down explorer-style through directories, each row showing recursive size, file count and…
description.zh: 只读的 Windows AppData 分析插件：点侧边栏图标后以资源管理器式逐层下钻，每行显示目录的递归体积、文件数与最后修改时间，并说明由哪个软件生成、作何用途，按「知识库 → 混合目录拆分 → 启发式 → 标注为推测」的顺序给出可删建议；只统计目录、不读取文件内容，也不提供任何删除操作，未知目录可按需联网检索并给…

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON,…
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject…
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: Add an optional rejection reason to approval prompts: the text is steered into the running turn before the rejection is answered, and the panel only follows…
description.zh: 在审批卡上增加可选的拒绝理由：理由会先作为 steering 消息进入当前轮，再把审批答成拒绝；浮层只跟随你正在查看的会话。

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, the agent asks you to choose an option, or a session finishes a turn, and only…
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批、智能体提问等你选择、或会话跑完一轮时，弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不看 DSH 页面（后台或未聚焦）时提醒；浏览器或 Windows 抑制通知时可用可选提示音兜底。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the…
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground…
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

description.en: Adds an Explain this action button under the permission approval card that asks the session model for a plain-language description of the pending operation —…
description.zh: 在权限审批卡片下面加一个「解释这条操作」按钮：调用当前会话模型，把待批准的操作翻成大白话——做什么、碰哪些文件、会不会改动或删除、有没有隐私风险——再给出风险等级和允许或拒绝的建议。解释以简体中文生成。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Adds a “why does this need escalation?” button to every DSH approval card: it opens a panel with the permission requested, the risk, what refusing means, the…
description.zh: 在 DSH 的审批卡上就地解释「为什么需要越权」：按钮展开所需权限、风险、不授权的后果、系统真正要执行的参数，以及每个路径是否落在会话工作区之外；卡片下方常驻一行风险与拒绝后果，模型给出的原始理由按「需要的权限 / 风险 / 不授权」分段显示，而不是挤成一坨。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the…
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check aquaculture input records, including required fields, withdrawal periods and harvest date intervals.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对养殖投入品记录的字段、休药期与起捕日期间隔，提示记录差异。

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three…
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: Architecture map workbench: register local repos, let a restricted agent (run as a hidden subagent session) read the code with the archify skill, keep…
description.zh: 代码库架构图册：登记本地仓库，由受限 agent（跑在子代理会话里，不占会话列表）用 archify skill 读代码，按分支维护结构图与领域图，支持概念提取、临时/永久自定义图、只读追问，并可在设置里挑选 DSH 已配好的模型来跑分析。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check archive registers for required fields, duplicate identifiers, retention terms and transfer dates.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对档案台账的必填字段、重复档号、保管期限用词和移交日期。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Favorites, copy id and path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favorites filter for DSH conversations, as additive extensions to the shipped archive feature.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为已有归档功能增加收藏、筛选、复制 ID 和路径、单独删除及空闲时批量归档。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently -…
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。

description.en: Session archive with tags, notes and per-session metrics, plus a Plan-Do-Check-Act loop over the archived sessions that produces prompt and AGENTS.md rules and…
description.zh: 会话归档：标签、备注与会话指标；对归档语料跑 Plan-Do-Check-Act，产出 prompt 与 AGENTS.md 规则，采纳后在后续会话上重新度量。纯本地运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Deletes any DSH session from its sidebar row, in bulk, or through a settings panel — into a recoverable trash, with ghost entries pruned automatically.
description.zh: 会话删除：任意会话行上直接删、多选批量清空、从回收站还原，删和还原都立刻生效不用重启；僵尸条目自动清理.

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive with workspace filtering and title/ID search, and read the transcript folded from the durable…
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：按工作区筛选、按标题/ID 搜索，不取消归档即可阅读从完整日志折出的对话——包括上下文压缩前的原文与工具调用。

description.en: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, conversation previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, confirmed permanent deletion…
description.zh: 按工作区管理已归档与未归档会话，支持独立范围正文搜索、上下文预览、标签备注、ZIP 备份导入导出、会话谱系、永久删除确认与失败重试，以及官方宿主更新。

description.en: Archived conversations list in the sidebar footer with read-only previews of the most recent messages, for sessions the product deliberately keeps hidden and…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的已归档对话列表，可只读预览最近消息；针对产品刻意隐藏且无法重新打开的归档会话。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Distill archived conversations into reusable skills, a fact ledger whose outdated entries retire, and topic clusters; ongoing sessions can be digested read-only, and memory self-checks only measure unless asked to rewrite. Note: its local API checks Host/Origin but does not yet use DSH host authentication.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把已归档会话提炼成可复用技能、会让过时事实退场的事实台账和主题簇；进行中的会话可只读增量提炼，记忆自检默认只测量不改写。注意：本机接口目前只检查 Host/Origin，尚未接入 DSH 宿主认证。

description.en: Adds a confirmed Delete session action to the sidebar menu of archived Sessions; the Host permanently removes their local JSONL logs (including hidden subagent…
description.zh: 在 Web 侧栏已归档会话的“...”菜单中新增带二次确认的「删除会话」；Host 永久删除本地 JSONL 日志（含隐藏的子代理后代）、工作区记账与归档/置顶集合，并刷新已打开的页面。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Balance and spending of an arckep.ru account inside the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web UI. Unofficial community plugin.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页界面中显示 arckep.ru 账户的余额与消费。非官方社区插件。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, pure JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）生成图片。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public…
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules…
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Immersive theme for Arknights players on the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers with edge blur adapted to each image, glass and text colors computed per image, a Rhodes Island icon system, and signature-style authorization and selection interactions.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 为《明日方舟》玩家提供壁纸、罗德岛图标、按图片调整的明暗配色和签字式授权交互。

description.en: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across…
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误…

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Drive CADCraft from the agent: draw lines, arcs and splines, manage layers, add dimensions, hatches and blocks, then export DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF. Exposes…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 CADCraft：绘制直线、圆弧与样条，管理图层，添加标注、填充与图块，并导出 DXF、DWG、SVG、PNG 或 PDF。同时暴露 CADCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可创建并读回图纸。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DeckCraft from the agent: create slides, apply layouts and themes, add shapes, pictures, tables and charts, then save a .pptx or export a PDF. Exposes…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DeckCraft：新建幻灯片、套用版式与主题、添加形状、图片、表格与图表，并保存为 .pptx 或导出 PDF。暴露 DeckCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DesignCraft from the agent: create pages, place and flow text, arrange frames and master pages, then export PDF. Exposes DesignCraft's command ids and…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DesignCraft：创建页面、置入与排布文字、组织图文框与主页，并导出 PDF。暴露 DesignCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive EffectCraft from the agent: build compositions, add layers, set properties and keyframes, evaluate expressions, then render frames or movies. Exposes…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 EffectCraft：搭建合成、添加图层、设置属性与关键帧、计算表达式，并渲染单帧或视频。暴露 EffectCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FigCraft from the agent: create frames, components and auto layout, set fills, strokes and effects, build prototypes, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or code.…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FigCraft：创建画框、组件与自动布局，设置填充、描边与效果，搭建原型，并导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 或代码。同时暴露 FigCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FilmCraft from the agent: build a project and sequences, import media, run edits as a script, then export with a preset or format. Exposes FilmCraft's…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FilmCraft：创建工程与序列、导入素材、以脚本方式执行剪辑，并按预设或格式导出。暴露 FilmCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive GridCraft from the agent: build workbooks, write and evaluate formulas, format ranges, insert charts and tables, and read cells back. Exposes both…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 GridCraft：构建工作簿、写入并计算公式、设置区域格式、插入图表与表格，并读回单元格。同时暴露 GridCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可端到端地创建并检查工作簿。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive LightCraft from the agent: import photos, apply develop settings, and export JPEG or other formats from a photo library. Exposes LightCraft's command ids…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 LightCraft：导入照片、应用冲图设置，并从照片库导出 JPEG 等格式。暴露 LightCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PdfCraft from the agent: read and extract text, render pages to images, rotate, delete, reorder, combine or split pages, and audit faux redactions.…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PdfCraft：读取并提取文本、把页面渲染成图片、旋转/删除/重排/合并/拆分页面，并检查伪脱敏。以命令与 MCP server 两种形式暴露 PdfCraft 的工具集。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PhotoCraft from the agent: open and create documents, work with layers and selections, apply adjustments and filters, run batch actions, then save or…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PhotoCraft：打开与新建文档、操作图层与选区、应用调整与滤镜、执行批处理动作，并保存或导出 PSD、PNG、JPG、TIFF 或 WebP。暴露 PhotoCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive SoundCraft from the agent: load a session, set track and mixer levels, insert plugins, edit MIDI, and bounce audio without opening a window. Exposes the…
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 SoundCraft：加载工程、设置轨道与混音电平、插入插件、编辑 MIDI，并在不打开窗口的情况下 bounce 音频。暴露这个 DAW 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive TextureCraft from the agent: build texture sets and layers over a mesh, paint, bake maps, and export PBR textures. Exposes both TextureCraft's command…

description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH…

description.en: ★ 61 │ Group thinking, tools and context into collapsible work segments. Uses DSH Web DOM conventions verified by the author on 0.1.2; newer layouts may differ.
description.zh: ★ 61 │ 将思考、工具和上下文合为可折叠工作段。依赖作者在 DSH Web 0.1.2 验证的 DOM 结构，新版布局可能有差异。

description.en: A session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: the trigger point is configurable, compaction does not make the local engine re-read the…
description.zh: 对本地模型友好的会话自动压缩插件：可自定义压缩触发点，不会使本地引擎重读全部历史，并让模型基于已缓存的前缀撰写结构化交接摘要，触发比例、摘要模板、显示样式与逐预设生效范围均可配置。安装重启 DSH 后接管；卸载即恢复DSH原生压缩。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20,…
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal…
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and…
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Maximize the DSH desktop window at startup. macOS needs Accessibility permission; Linux needs wmctrl or xdotool. Writes a local diagnostic log by default.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 启动时自动最大化 DSH 桌面窗口。macOS 需辅助功能权限，Linux 需 wmctrl 或 xdotool；默认写本地诊断日志。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect…
description.zh: 通过 Jev 调整主会话推理投入而不换模型，为 fresh 子任务独立选择并应用能力与投入，展示决策分布并收集逐回复资源分配反馈。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in…
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Keeps the Auto permission preset across DSH restarts: the auto-review unload migration no longer rewrites a live Auto Session to Full access during application…
description.zh: 让「自动审批」熬过重启：应用退出时，自动审查的卸载迁移不再把在用的自动审批会话改写成「完全权限」；集成缺席时，存留的自动审批会话也不会打不开。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Name sessions from the first message and stream title suggestions inside the rename dialog.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 根据首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗中流式给出标题建议。

description.en: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit…
description.zh: 自动重试断连类模型失败（传输中断、超时、限流、5xx、流中断），在同一次智能体回合内接管重试而不是让任务直接断掉。所有选项都能在插件配置或右侧栏面板里调整：重试次数、初始与最大延迟、退避系数与抖动、限流延迟窗口、一直重试的时间上限、换路线的触发条件与次数上限、死路黑名单时长、日志文件。限流按指数退避等待并尊重服务端重试…

description.en: ★ 248 │ Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.
description.zh: ★ 248 │ 由独立的只读模型复核权限请求，记录审批过程，复核失败时不自动放行。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job or subagent still running (by default every…
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务或子代理（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns…
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Persistent concurrent node-graph workflows for DeepSeek Harness with agent, command, HTTP, human, fan-out/join, gate, and subworkflow nodes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的持久化并发节点图工作流，支持 agent、命令、HTTP、人工、fan-out/join、gate 与子工作流节点。

description.en: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots…
description.zh: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost…
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or…
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动、会话开始/空闲/结束、收到消息、工具执行后，或按每天/固定间隔，自动执行本机命令、发 HTTP 请求或写一条日志；左侧栏面板与五个 agent 工具管理同一批规则。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on…
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适…

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up…
description.zh: 重启不丢工作：等所有对话空闲后自动重启，重启后接着干、不中断；已有守护的机器交给守护重启，绝不双开。 还顺手治一个常见毛病：反复启动攒下的过期登录 cookie 会把请求头撑爆、让 DSH 起不来，插件在每次重启前先清掉它们。 每次重启前自动备份配置和已装插件，默认留 2 份、最多 10 份，旧的和不完整的自动清理。…

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your…
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Register the current executable to start at Windows login and remove its registry value when disabled. Use the fixed Git source; the same-name npm package is a separate project. Requires the desktop executable, with no restart watchdog.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将当前程序写入 Windows 登录自启动项，禁用时移除该注册表值；使用固定 Git 来源，同名 npm 包是其他项目。应在桌面程序中使用，不含崩溃重启守护。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and…
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it…
description.zh: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并可用系统语音或你自己指定的本地 TTS 服务朗读回复；含预设、带暂停与上下句的播放控制条、语气与语速调节，以及一键启动该服务。

description.en: Runtime policy guards that block repeated failing tool calls, oversized shell commands and network commands chained with local ones, composite batch tools…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行时策略防护（拦截重复失败的工具调用、超长 shell 命令、与本地命令串联的网络命令）、复合批处理工具（read_batch/edit_batch）、用你自己的 SYSTEM.md 替换官方系统提示词各段的模式、软收敛提醒和回合遥测。

description.en: Ultra-lean coding preset for DSH that eliminates orchestration overhead and pre-action chatter for surgical edits and fast tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简预设插件：消除编排开销与前置报幕废话，专注外科手术式精准修改与高效工具执行。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time,…
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Assign wallpapers and appearance settings to model rules and rotate matching images.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 按模型规则配置壁纸和外观，并轮播匹配的图片。

description.en: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the…
description.zh: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact [消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘…

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent…
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos…
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包…

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: Two gates for outbound AI text. (1) Guard: before any text goes out it blocks the shapes anyone could write — padding verbs plus abstract nouns ("optimised the…
description.zh: 管 AI 对外说话的两道门。一、守门：发出去之前拦掉「谁都能说」的形状——空转（动词配宏观名词，如「优化了代码结构」）、空形容词、万能话、模板开场白、git commit/PR/review 的套话、把代码念一遍的注释。聊天、评论、邮件、commit message、PR 描述、review、issue、文档、代码注释…

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Injects durable user-set must-do and must-not requirements into the model at conversation start.
description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Pins your DeepSeek Harness account balance to the bottom-right corner and refreshes it every 60 seconds, with a click for an immediate lookup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 主界面右下角常驻账户余额，60 秒自动刷新，点击即可立即查询。

description.en: Floating ball showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance (OAuth), with live pricing, today's price curve and a token-consumption estimate range.
description.zh: 悬浮球显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户余额（OAuth），附带实时价格、今日价格走势与 token 消耗估算区间。

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Configure multiple metered accounts or token plans and query their balances from one dashboard.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 配置多个按量计费账号或 Token 套餐，在同一看板查询余额。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show your DeepSeek wallet balance at the foot of the sidebar, refreshed after each turn, with an animated change. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; supports DSH 0.1.7 and 0.2.0 only.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在侧栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每轮结束后刷新，金额变化时有动画。需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，仅支持 DSH 0.1.7 和 0.2.0。

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status…
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

description.en: A simple, information-dense DeepSeek status display for the DSH sidebar: balance, usage, and peak/off-peak countdown. Requires the DSH Web GUI with a signed-in…
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏集中显示 DeepSeek 余额、用量和峰谷倒计时，简约直观。需要 DSH Web 界面并已登录 DeepSeek 账户。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session…
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与…

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation: ingest CAMT.053 and MT940, match them against ledger entries and export the workpaper — 6 `bankrec.*` tools.
description.zh: 银行对账单核对：导入 CAMT.053 与 MT940，与账簿条目匹配并导出工作底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具。

description.en: A TRAE-宝-style personal assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session long-term memory, auto-extracted candidate memories, first-time onboarding, a…
description.zh: DSH 宝 —— TRAE 宝式个人助理插件：跨会话长期记忆、自动候选记忆提取、首次启动引导、专属助理 Agent 预设、定时每日简报、桌面通知与实时工作状态面板。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact…
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires…
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
description.zh: DSH 权限守卫：原生权限菜单里的四范围读写执行权限位，bash 命令可选 Jev 语义分类层。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission…
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so…
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY…

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch…
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Let Claude Code or Codex do the thinking: understand the request, write a clear prompt for DeepSeek Harness to do the work, and review the result. dsh-baton runs your tests itself, lists what changed, and has a sub-agent check every requirement, so your main model only reads the result and decides. Codex waits in one call of up to 59 minutes, with no hook to trust and nothing to poll; you can change the request while it runs, and name the Harness model for a task. On big jobs it saves most of your plan's quota.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 或 Codex 负责动脑：理解需求，写好 prompt 交给 DeepSeek Harness 去干活，最后把关。dsh-baton 会自己跑测试、列出改了哪些文件，再派一个子代理逐条核对需求，你的主力模型只看结果拍板。Codex 一次等待最长 59 分钟，不用信任钩子，也不用轮询；运行中可以随时改需求，也可以指定这次用 Harness 的哪个模型。大任务能省下大半订阅额度。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with…
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Beads issue-graph panel in the left sidebar of the Web GUI: filter ready, in-progress, open, and all beads, read a bead's description, notes, dependencies, and…
description.zh: Web 界面左侧栏的 Beads 任务图谱面板：按可领取、进行中、待处理、全部筛选，查看任务描述、备注、依赖与评论，并通过 bd CLI 新建、领取或关闭任务。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 数据库的工作区。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and…
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust…
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six…
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail…

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled…
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom…
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH…

description.en: ★ 100 │ A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: ★ 100 │ 调整过程细节、实时思考与最终回答的显示方式。

description.en: ★ 42 │ Hash-anchored read/edit/undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line gets a unique 3-char hash (A-Za-z0-9) that stays stable across edits; stale or ambiguous anchors are rejected, never fuzzy-matched. Undo persists across restarts.
description.zh: ★ 42 │ 通过行哈希执行读取、编辑和撤销，拒绝过期或歧义锚点。

description.en: ★ 25 │ Better input experience for DeepSeek Harness: file-to-Markdown, local file input, prompt optimization, and voice input
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 提供文件转 Markdown、本地文件引用、提示词优化与语音输入。

description.en: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.
description.zh: 分区更清晰的 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏，内置时钟、余额等小组件。

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream…
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Update checker for plugin bundles installed in a DSH profile: a Version section on the detail page of a plugin installed from a GitHub repository or release…
description.zh: 检查 DSH profile 内已装插件包更新的工具：从 GitHub 仓库或 release tarball 安装的插件，其详情页会出现 Version 分区，把已装 commit 或版本与确切目标版本对照；/plugin-updater 命令可列出插件包、检查 npm、Git 仓库与 GitHub release…

title.zh: Better Reasoning Effort（思考强度与输入模态）

description.en: ★ 67 │ Set reasoning effort and image-input support for third-party models right in the official Models page, with suggested settings from a built-in model knowledge base.
description.zh: ★ 67 │ 在官方「模型」页直接为第三方模型设置思考强度和图片输入支持，可根据内置模型知识库一键填入推荐配置。

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and…
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar…
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Browse SkillHub, install and manage local skills, and enable, disable or remove MCP servers. Desktop profile required; MCP removal writes a backup before editing the profile.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 浏览 SkillHub、安装和管理本地技能，支持启停或移除 MCP 服务。需桌面 profile；移除 MCP 前会备份 profile 配置。

description.en: Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging,…
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

description.en: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的浮动待办面板——窗口可拖动并吸附屏幕四边，首页按「今天/更多」分组，另有全部事项标签页（未完成/已完成筛选、增量加载），条目默认只读查看、点右上角「编辑」才可修改，图片附件点击放大、其它附件点击下载，内置番茄钟（15/30/45/60 或自定义，可设轮数与休息间隔）到点推送 Windows…

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

description.en: ★ 35 │ Organize workspace navigation by disk paths with optional name-based grouping.
description.zh: ★ 35 │ 按磁盘目录组织工作区导航，并可启用名称分组。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Compare a RequirementsPack with a bid document to locate possible responses. Findings require human review; unsupported tables and attachments are omitted. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 对照招标要求清单定位投标文件中可能的响应，结果需人工核对，不覆盖表格和附件。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Watches the official DeepSeek models for changes: every cycle it reads the model catalog and sends one minimal completion per watched model, then compares the…
description.zh: 盯着官方 DeepSeek 模型有没有变：每轮读取模型目录，并对每个受关注的模型发一次最小补全请求，比对系统指纹、返回的模型名、响应信封结构、目录元数据和固定输入的 token 数。任一项变化就弹一张随机表情包，列出具体改了什么，并放一声轰鸣。需要 DeepSeek API key（存入凭据库）；默认每 60…

description.en: Makes the dsh-pet desktop pet read model replies aloud in its own configured voice. Newer dsh-pet gets the whole text in one request (up to its 500-char cap);…
description.zh: 让 dsh-pet 桌宠用设置页里选定的音色朗读模型输出。新版桌宠整段一次下发（受其单次 500 字上限约束），旧版自动按 60 字切段兜底；每一段都回读桌宠日志，确认真的念了出来。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Read and send live-room chat with optional AI replies and speech transcription. Requires Python, Bilibili credentials for sending, and user-approved rooms.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 读取和发送直播弹幕，可选 AI 陪聊与语音转写。需要 Python，发送需 B 站凭据，直播间需由用户放行。

description.en: A whale-maid with a jar, sitting in the corner of your DSH window. She goes exploring on Bilibili for whatever you are into, ranks by like, coin and favourite…
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘带着一个罐子，守在右下角。按照你的兴趣，她会去 B 站探险，按赞币藏率排，给你找一些符合口味的电子榨菜。哪个词搜得少，她换条路再找。回来把五条装进罐子里，然后和你说说这些视频讲了什么。时政这类她只留最近两周，游戏攻略和音乐不限时间，每根轴她自己定。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Browse Bilibili recommendations, watch videos with danmaku, and optionally sync watch progress from a sidebar. QR login stores account cookies on the local host and sends them to Bilibili; no model calls. Requires Node >=20; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧边栏浏览 B 站推荐、观看视频与弹幕，可选同步观看进度。扫码登录将账号 Cookie 保存在本机并用于 B 站请求，不调用模型。需 Node >=20；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term…
description.zh: 让蓝色大肥鱼替你刷 B 站：帮你评论，把发现的有趣内容私信给你，还会写下日记；它也有记忆，能长期总结。视频按你的口味筛选并生成 Markdown 日报，也能守着评论区替你回话。开启「圈地自萌」后，它只回视频 UP 主本人主动邀请的楼中楼，普通观众喊话不算，绝不自己起新楼；评论、私信、自动运行和守护默认关闭。需…

description.en: ★ 1,385 │ Read video subtitles, select relevant material and produce daily digests and notifications.
description.zh: ★ 1,385 │ 读取视频字幕并筛选内容，生成日报与消息提醒。

description.en: Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.
description.zh: 派子代理去刷 B站，回报值得看的视频，带每条视频的笔记、卡片墙，以及 @/回复/私信转发的收件箱。

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are…
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: Adds paragraph-by-paragraph translation and a bilingual view to assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: each Chinese paragraph gets an English…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的助手回复加逐段翻译与中英双语对照：中文段落下补英文、英文段落下补中文，会话头部有开关；代码块、公式不翻译，表格会生成一张完整的译文表附在下方。译文由 DeepSeek API 生成（插件复用 DSH 已保存的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，也可在设置里粘贴…

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab…
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

description.en: Peak and off-peak billing season in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading, with a coloured dot, a countdown to the next switch, and a…
description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、缓存命中读数之后显示高峰/非高峰计费时段：状态圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板显示按接口返回货币表示的余额，并拆分为总额、赠送与充值。

description.en: Adds a 12-hour peak/off-peak billing strip and the account balance above the composer, with today, 7-day and 30-day spend per model.
description.zh: 在输入框上方显示以当前为中心的 12 小时峰谷条形与账户余额，可切换今日、近 7 日、近 30 日查看各模型花费。
输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https…
description.en: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the…
Local billing dashboard for DSH model calls: multi-platform provider/model breakdowns of calls, tokens and spend, peak/off-peak pricing, manual CSV price…
description.zh: DSH 本地计费面板：多平台、按平台/模型明细汇总调用次数、token 与花费，支持峰谷/阶梯计价、CSV 人工导入价格（含峰时窗口）、官方账单对齐，以及 HTML/PDF/CSV 导出。

description.en: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public…
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a…
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer…
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell…
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval…
description.zh: 把 AIGC 创作直接放进 DeepSeek Harness：用开源与闭源模型生成图像、视频、音频与 3D，含参数 schema、费用预估、审批与任务面板。

description.en: Opens a full-screen 3-D black-hole stage from a sidebar card, where 24,514 real internet radio stations orbit inside an accretion disc; drag to orbit, hold to…
description.zh: 从左栏卡片打开全屏 3D 黑洞舞台，2.45 万台真实网络电台嵌在吸积盘里环绕运行；拖动环绕、按住穿过虫洞进入星团、点星点播放，带搜索、13 个流派筛选、收藏与流内 ICY 曲目信息。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: ★ 79 │ DeepSeek Harness Blender production, reconstruction, validation, and export plugin
description.zh: ★ 79 │ 在 DSH 中调用 Blender 制作、重建、检查和导出场景。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender…
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2…

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation,…
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: ★ 2,058 │ Control Blender scenes, modeling and rendering with Python. Tested on Blender 4.2 LTS; GUI mode needs the bundled addon. The loopback execution bridge currently has no authentication.
description.zh: ★ 2,058 │ 通过 Python 操控 Blender 场景、建模和渲染。已测试 Blender 4.2 LTS，图形模式需安装配套 addon；本机执行桥接目前无认证。

description.en: ★ 103 │ Adds a Block PTC agent preset that groups tool work into blocks and replaces selected context with model-written summaries. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 and Node >=22; select the new preset explicitly. Summaries may lose details; original events remain in the session log.
description.zh: ★ 103 │ 新增 Block PTC 预设，按区块组织工具工作，用模型摘要替换选定上下文。需 DSH ≥0.2.1-rc.2、Node ≥22，使用时需选择新预设；摘要可能遗漏细节，原始事件仍保留在会话日志。

description.en: ★ 266 │ Apply light-adaptive color schemes and frosted-glass interface styling.
description.zh: ★ 266 │ 应用可自适应深浅模式的配色与磨砂玻璃界面。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input /…
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Blue-team defense mode for CTF and incident response: 36 defensive tools, six worker roles, SQLite findings and tasks, an optional decoy server,…
description.zh: CTF 网络攻防蓝队防御模式：36 个防御工具、六个执行角色、SQLite 事实库与任务队列，可选诱饵程序、欺骗防御与蜜罐闭环，以及带全面浏览的独立控制台。

description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt section that asks the model to drop stock AI writing habits: subheadings, bold and emoji overload, quoted aphorisms and grand-finale…
description.zh: 往系统提示词里加一段，要求模型去掉常见的 AI 写作习惯：小标题、加粗与 emoji 堆砌、引用名言和结尾升华。

description.en: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills…
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable…
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export…
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app;…
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Startup animation and chat wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-act boot animation with custom animation import and three configurable transitions (first-act entry, act join, second-act exit), plus static-image and muted loop-video chat backgrounds (Wallpaper Engine project folders, custom video directories, random rotation, per-video delete).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸插件：两幕冷启动动画，支持导入自定义动画与三段自定义转场（第一幕入场、两幕衔接、第二幕退场）；聊天背景支持静态底图与静音循环视频（识别壁纸引擎项目文件夹、自定义视频目录、随机轮换、单个删除）。

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random…
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/…

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one…
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval…
description.zh: DS Bot 团队的一块浮动看板：谁在跑、在跑什么工具，谁在等别的 Bot 交活，谁在等你批或等你答，谁报错了；带按发送方分组的交接表、显示待批命令或待答问题的单个 Bot 抽屉，收起后是一条状态胶囊。只读，不写 DS Bot 的数据。需要先装 DS Bot（按 0.1.7 与 0.2.0 开发）；没有 DS Bot…

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss…
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: ★ 60 │ Show the current model, account balance or subscription quota, and session or historical spending beneath the composer.
description.zh: ★ 60 │ 在输入框下方显示模型、余额或订阅额度，以及会话与历史费用。
给 DeepSeek Harness 用的第二大脑：Markdown 当数据库，零运行时依赖。核心记忆常驻系统提示，一张卡一个文件并可全文检索；侧栏网页版拆好的卡片先进收件箱，逐张人工确认后「存到云端」或「只存本地」（private/ 被 .gitignore 永久排除，绝不推送）；网页版对话进度存成…
description.en: A second brain for DeepSeek Harness where Markdown is the database and git is the sync, with zero runtime dependencies. Core memory is injected into every…
Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer…
description.zh: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers,…
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick,…
description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份…

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening…
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work…
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: Independent DSH plugin: Settings → brand color with preset swatches and a custom color picker; recolors only the sidebar/hero logo mark and favicon, never…
description.zh: 独立 DSH 插件：设置页「品牌颜色」，预设色卡 + 自定义取色，只给侧栏/首页 logo 和 favicon 上色，不改文字；兼容 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.2。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live…
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.
description.zh: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

description.en: ★ 186 │ Validate storyboard JSON and render vertical promotional videos locally with Remotion.
description.zh: ★ 186 │ 校验分镜 JSON，并通过 Remotion 在本地渲染竖版宣传视频。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four…
description.zh: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

description.en: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port…
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端通过 playwright-cli 驱动右侧边栏浏览器，为每个会话提供稳定的 pageId。需要用 --remote-debugging-port=0 启动 DSH，并全局安装 @playwright/cli。

description.en: Bookmark manager for the sidebar browser: toolbar star button, dropdown list with one-click navigation, inline editing and reordering.
description.zh: 侧边栏浏览器的书签管理器：工具栏星标按钮，下拉列表一键打开书签，支持就地编辑与排序。

description.en: Visible agent browser for DSH over CDP, also driving egolite, Tabbit, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Lightpanda backends. Only bcdp_status stays resident (401 chars); the other 33 context-optimized bcdp_* tools unlock per activity batch, so non-browser sessions pay no schema tax (-91.9% measured). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices; non-CDP channels (ego CLI / Tabbit CLI) sync frames by 3s polling. Cross-version support for DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 (exact enumeration of 10 rc).
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入），同时驱动 egolite、Tabbit、Chrome、Edge、Brave 与 Lightpanda 后端。常驻只有 bcdp_status（401 字符），其余 33 个经过上下文优化的 bcdp_* 工具按活动批次解锁——不碰浏览器的会话不缴 schema token 税（实测 -91.9%）。实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；非 CDP 通道（ego CLI / Tabbit CLI）以 3s 轮询同步画面。DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 跨版本支持（精确枚举 10 个 rc）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect playwright-mcp and peekaboo-mcp for browser and desktop control, with dependency setup and connection diagnostics.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 接入 playwright-mcp 与 peekaboo-mcp 操控浏览器和桌面，提供依赖安装与连接诊断。

description.en: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the…
description.zh: dsh 浏览器扩展的桌面端一半：在 dsh 自带的 webserver 上挂一个带令牌校验的 WebSocket 桥，向模型暴露 browser_* 工具，让它读取并操作用户当前标签页，图片识别默认关闭、需用户自行开启。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's…
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Adds a search-engine picker, a bookmarks panel with multi-level folders (add/edit/delete/import Netscape bookmark HTML) and keyword-then-Enter search in the…
description.zh: 给侧边栏「浏览器」Tab 增加搜索引擎选择、书签面板（多级文件夹、增删改、导入书签 HTML），以及地址栏输入关键词回车直接搜索。需先装 dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0（客户端 inject 其 betterSidebar 服务，缺了不会加载）。书签存本地 JSON，不依赖外部浏览器。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own…
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个…

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

description.en: Relay that bridges DSH and the browser: tasks started from a browser extension run in DSH sessions, while page operations are driven back through browser_*…
description.zh: DSH 与浏览器之间的通信桥：浏览器扩展发起的任务经 relay 在 DSH 创建会话执行，页面操作通过 browser_* 工具桥接回扩展，提供页面助手面板与免配置接入向导。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库…

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill…
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

description.en: dshBrutalDelete permanently deletes DSH sessions from disk — single-row or cross-workspace bulk delete, with Ctrl+A select-all and Delete shortcut, wiping…
description.zh: dsh暴力删除：永久删除 DSH 会话的磁盘数据——单条删除或跨工作区批量删除，支持 Ctrl+A 全选与 Delete 快捷删除，彻底清理对话记录、投影缓存、工作区归属、附件与子会话，不可恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OKX 永续合约看板插件：BTC/ETH 的 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D K 线、EMA 均线叠加、直线/斐波那契/尺子画线、收线预警（桌面通知/提示音/邮件；邮件通道需另装 dsh-qq-email 插件）与面板内回测。行情来自 OKX 公开接口，不需要 API…

description.en: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 /btw 旁问：fork 当前会话，并在主回合仍在运行时补入当前任务、最近的工具调用和流式输出作为上下文；执行期拒绝所有工具调用；按会话保留支持追问、停止、重试和删除的主题历史。

description.en: One-off btw side questions that inherit the current DSH session, with selectable context ranges and an optional compressed summary you review before sending it…
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 会话里发起一次性 btw 旁问，可选上下文范围；旁问默认不写入会话，可把压缩摘要预览确认后送入主会话。

description.en: Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions,…
description.zh: 在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。

description.en: DSH plugin that enforces per-task budget caps by CNY amount or token count, with automatic interception to prevent runaway agent costs.
description.zh: 为 DSH 每次任务设置预算线，支持按金额或 Token 限制消耗，并在达到阈值时自动拦截，防止 Agent 过度消费。

description.en: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Record a browser bug, lock the expected result and compare candidate fixes against the original code. Runs local development commands and stores evidence in the project .buggps directory; Git worktrees are not a sandbox. For DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 headless/web; needs Git, pnpm >=10 and Chrome or Edge.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，再将候选修复与原代码对照验证。会运行本地开发命令，并在项目 .buggps 目录保存证据；Git worktree 不提供沙箱隔离。适用于 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的 headless/web，需 Git、pnpm >=10、Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: ★ 183 │ Use a visible browser that the agent can automate and the user can take over.
description.zh: ★ 183 │ 使用可由 Agent 自动操作、也可由用户接管的可见浏览器。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine…
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel…
description.zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives…
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk…
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the…
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in…
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
description.zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

description.en: Editable prompt shortcuts beside the DSH composer: save the prompts and phrases you retype as buttons, then send the preset text or insert it into the draft,…
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑提示词快捷按钮：把反复重打的提示词、常用语存成按钮，点一下发送预设文字或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖；按钮还能在点击时现读上一条消息、当前草稿或选区，带 {{名字}} 的会先让你填再执行。

description.en: ★ 34 │ A cabinet-themed Agent preset with a lead, specialist teammates, task board, dependencies and per-member model selection. Research-first behavior is prompt guidance; models and their credentials come from DSH.
description.zh: ★ 34 │ 以首辅和分工阁臣组织 Agent 团队，提供任务板、依赖关系与成员模型选择。「先调研」属于预设提示词约定，模型及凭据由 DSH 提供。

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing…
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DSH.
description.zh: 展示缓存命中、发送前确认请求前缀风险，并按调用步骤定位缓存失效。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Channel test page for any configured provider/model: multi-round prompt-cache hit rate, streaming TTFT and tok/s, and a pelican SVG test.
description.zh: 任意已配置渠道的测试页：多轮提示词缓存命中率、流式 TTFT 与 tok/s，以及鹈鹕 SVG 测试。

description.en: ★ 39 │ View 2D and 3D CAD files and use parametric modeling and export tools from a conversation.
description.zh: ★ 39 │ 在会话中查看二维与三维 CAD 文件，并调用参数化建模与导出工具。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Create and preview CadQuery or ezdxf designs, and export STEP, STL or DXF using a local Python installation.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过本地 Python 的 CadQuery 或 ezdxf 建模、预览，并导出 STEP、STL 或 DXF。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library…
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Runs macOS caffeinate with -w bound to the DSH host process id, so the sleep-prevention process exits when the host exits, and exposes /keepawake to report…
description.zh: 以 -w 把 macOS caffeinate 绑定到 DSH 宿主进程 pid，宿主退出即随之退出；并提供 /keepawake 指令查看状态与切换防休眠模式。仅限 macOS，默认开启：DSH 启动后就阻止 Mac 空闲休眠（接交流电时也阻止整机休眠），直到 DSH 退出，屏幕仍可息屏；用 /keepawake…
让结论活过上下文压缩：模型把任务状态写成检查点，插件把它注入到 DSH 系统提示词首节点——那里永不参与压缩，所以压缩 100 次结论也不丢。四档注入（0/95/175/≤12000 字符）按会话关系收放；检查点写在插件自有目录，工作区一个文件都不多。
description.en: Keep conclusions alive across context compaction: the model writes a task checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt's first node — the…
Computer-aided translation, inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中完成计算机辅助翻译。

description.en: Calculator tool that evaluates arithmetic expressions with a hand-written recursive-descent parser. No eval or new Function; whitelisted identifiers, length…
description.zh: 计算器工具：手写递归下降解析器求值算术表达式，不使用 eval 或 new Function，标识符白名单、长度与嵌套上限、结构化错误码。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Connect CalDAV calendars to view, create, reschedule, and import events from DSH.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 连接 CalDAV 日历，在会话中查看、创建和调整日程，并导入日历文件。

description.en: ★ 0 │ General-purpose calendar for the DSH right sidebar: month view with date selection, a list of the day's events, and today and week overviews; events are stored locally, and the agent can read and write via calendar_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏月历中管理日程，查看当天及本周安排，支持 Agent 读写本地事件。

description.en: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里加一条档位条：思考三档（常规 / 严格 / 极致）、互斥的循环模式三档（3 / 5 / 8 轮）、可叠加的对抗审查开关；模型通过 clarify_tier 与 forge_level 两个工具读取当前档位。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Calorie diary for the DSH right sidebar: a built-in food table auto-computes kcal from grams, logs by meal, and shows daily totals and goal progress; the agent can read and write via calorie_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏记录饮食，按食物和重量计算热量，查看每日合计与目标进度，支持 Agent 读写。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check local JSON/YAML canteen retention records against the bundled rules and list missing fields, literal differences and skipped checks for human review. Does not issue a compliance decision. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按随包规则核对本地 JSON/YAML 食堂留样台账，列出缺项、字面差异及无法执行的检查，供人工复核，不作合规认定。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed:…
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: One panel for MCP servers, skills and Claude Code plugins across global/profile/project scopes: live status, import/export, trash & backups, and the official…
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理全局 / Profile / 项目三个作用域的 MCP 服务与技能：实时状态与工具数、导入导出、回收站与备份，并可安装/更新/卸载 Anthropic 官方 claude-plugins-official 市场的 Claude Code 插件。

description.en: Search, inspect, and use selected third-party skills and MCP tools through one on-demand gateway. Catalog trimming depends on the host and tool mode. A local…
description.zh: 通过一个按需网关搜索、查看和使用选定的第三方技能与 MCP 工具。目录精简取决于宿主和工具模式。本地日志记录使用元数据。

description.en: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Manage MCP servers, skills and tools per session and inspect their context loading state.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 按会话管理 MCP 服务器、技能和工具，查看它们在上下文中的加载状态。

description.en: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of…
description.zh: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: Render any Markdown report or DSH session excerpt into shareable PNG images with no npm dependencies, driving the Chromium-family browser already on the…
description.zh: 把任意 Markdown 报告或 DSH 会话片段渲染成可分享的 PNG 图片，零 npm 依赖：复用本机已有的 Chromium 系浏览器，不可用时退回 PDF、再退回 HTML。报告输出短图（结论）加长图（完整原文）；dsh-fact-check 的报告额外带档位徽标、甲乙双轨与逐条断言分档（都取自报告本身），其余…

description.en: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling…
description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

description.en: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and…
description.zh: 猫狗品种归因的侧栏插件：出三道整数挑战，逐段贴回模型回复，看 24 个品种的降序榜。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching;…
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: Zero-config per-Session freshness for codebase-memory: on Session start and on every working-directory change it refreshes the index of the Session's own…
description.zh: 零配置的 codebase-memory 保鲜插件：会话开始时、以及每次切换工作目录时，自动刷新该会话自己那个仓库的索引，让每个会话里的每个项目都查得到与当前代码一致的图；索引重活仍在共享 daemon 里完成。
