description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. Its tools sit in floating groups at the canvas corners and a bottom dock with text labels, and a home screen offers one prompt box, recent designs and large template cards. When the home screen's style is Auto, the plugin picks a style card that fits the subject and hands its colors and fonts to the model; your own words, a chosen card, a reference image or a default brand design system take precedence. Each design gets its own folder. When a design needs photos, the model can copy from a library of 64 AI-generated placeholder images in 8 themes (about 8 MB, downloaded from npm the first time they are needed; made with OpenAI image generation and screened by a person, not real places, products or people); export and handoff remind you to replace them before launch. When the model builds web pages, app screens, desktop app windows, WeChat mini programs, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; screens far from the view show a background thumbnail and load the live page when you move closer; while the model writes a page, the sidebar grows with it and a few cursors draw boxes, fill colors and type where it is writing, with a timer in the status bar; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact, and an existing HTML file or folder opens by browsing or by dragging it into the sidebar (desktop app). A design library gathers every design you made in any session, your saved inspiration (reference images, URLs, style cards) and a design market of shared templates, design systems and style cards (16 templates, 3 design systems and 20 style cards to start; search, filters, full-size screens and a live view; an offline copy ships with the plugin): start from one in a click, or share your own design to the market after a personal-data scan and an offline design check; after connecting GitHub once (public repositories only), submitting takes one click, and the web form still works. Mini program screens get the WeChat capsule in the top-right corner, which turns white over a dark top bar, and the design check flags text and buttons hidden under it. App and mini program screens follow platform layout (status and nav bars, a tab bar of 2 to 5 items, safe areas), desktop app screens get macOS traffic lights or Windows caption buttons, and the design check flags content under the Dynamic Island, the home indicator or the window buttons. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer, or draw on the preview (pen, highlighter, arrow, box, circle, text) and hand the marked-up screenshot to the model; picks, markup and style changes appear in the composer as small chips while the model still gets the full text. It can extract a brand design system from your website or project (colors by role, fonts, type scale, radius, shadows, buttons, inputs and cards) and use it for every new design. The model adds a few tweak sliders to each design (spacing, radius, brand color, layout variants) that update all screens live and write back to the stylesheet in one click. A finished design can be turned into React, Vue, Next.js or plain HTML code, or for mini programs into uni-app or native WeChat code; existing uni-app (including HBuilderX projects without package.json), Taro and native mini program projects are recognized so new pages go straight in, and each built screen is diffed pixel by pixel against the design. Also has a design tokens panel, twenty style presets (each a live sample screen you can open full size), a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through try-it mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and seven tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model; extract_design_system builds a design system from a site or project; handoff_design writes a handoff pack (screenshots, routes, tokens, shared components); compare_design diffs the built local page against the design and marks what differs. find_photos copies matching placeholder photos from the photo library into the design. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the seven tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show, and unchanged screens are not sent again. An experimental option, off by default, has the model also write business annotations (rules, states and edge cases the UI does not show), shown as numbered markers on the page and cards in the sidebar and passed on in code handoff.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。工具放在画布四角的浮块和底部工具坞里，按钮都带字；首页一个大输入框直接发，下面是最近的设计和模板大图。首页风格选「自动」时，插件按题材挑一张风格卡，把配色和字体交给模型；你在话里说了风格、手选了风格卡、放了参考图，或者有默认的品牌设计系统，就照你的来。每套设计一个文件夹。设计需要照片时，模型可以从照片库的 64 张 AI 生成示意图（8 类题材，约 8 MB，第一次用到时从 npm 下载；OpenAI 图像生成、人工挑选，不是真实的店铺、产品或人物）里取用；导出和转代码时会提醒上线前换掉。模型做网页、App 界面、桌面软件窗口、微信小程序、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；离得远的屏先显示后台截的缩略图，挪近了再加载真页面；模型写页面时右侧栏跟着一段段长出来，几只鼠标在写到的地方拖框、刷色、打字，顶上状态条带计时；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常；已有的 HTML 文件或文件夹，点「浏览…」或拖进右侧栏就能打开（桌面版）。设计库里有你在各个会话做过的所有设计、收的灵感（参考图、网址、风格卡），还有设计市场：大家分享的模板、设计系统和风格卡（首批 16 套模板、3 套设计系统、20 张风格卡，能搜、能筛、看大图、实时看，插件自带离线目录），点一下就能拿来接着改；自己做的设计查过个人信息、断网体检后也能分享到市场，连一次 GitHub（只要公开仓库权限）后一键投稿，不连也能用网页表单交。小程序屏画上微信右上角的胶囊，顶栏是深色时胶囊自动变白，设计体检会查出被胶囊挡住的字和按钮。App 和小程序按平台规矩画（状态栏、导航栏、2–5 项底部标签栏、安全区），桌面软件画上 Mac 红绿灯或 Windows 窗口按钮，体检会查出伸进灵动岛、底部横条或压在窗口按钮上的内容。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框；也能直接在预览上画（画笔、荧光笔、箭头、方框、圆圈、文字），把叠上标注的截图交给模型。点选、标注、调样式放进输入框都是一个小标签，模型照样拿到完整内容。能从你的官网或项目里提取品牌设计系统（按角色的配色、字体、字号阶梯、圆角、阴影，按钮、输入框、卡片的样子），以后做新设计都照它来；模型给每套设计配几个专属调节滑块（留白、圆角、主色、版式几选一），拖动时所有屏一起变，一键写回样式；做好的设计能转成 React / Vue / Next.js / 纯 HTML 代码，小程序能转成 uni-app 或微信原生小程序代码；认得出现有的 uni-app（包括 HBuilderX 建的、没有 package.json 的）、Taro 和原生小程序项目，新页面直接加进去；每屏做完和设计稿逐像素对比。另有设计变量面板、二十套风格卡（每张都是画好的一小屏样板，能点开看原大）、调样式面板（字号、颜色、圆角、内边距等，可以写回 HTML，或连同每项由哪条 CSS 规则、在第几行决定一起交给模型）、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片 / PDF / PPTX（屏和屏之间的跳转照样能点）、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击试用、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，以及设计体检（文字超出、截断、叠在一起，对比度、点击区大小等）。自带 ui-design 技能和七个工具：preview_page 打开预览；check_design 在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按真实尺寸量每一屏（顶栏底栏压住内容、脚本报错、资源没载到、死链；对比度和字号问题写明 CSS 文件和行号；严重问题附局部截图）；look_design 把真实截图交给模型；extract_design_system 从网站或项目提取设计系统；handoff_design 写交接包（每屏截图、路由、设计变量、该抽的组件）；compare_design 把做出来的本机页面和设计稿逐像素比，标出差在哪。find_photos 把合适的示意照片从照片库复制进设计。新会话可以选「设计模式」（标准模式的工具，加上这个技能、这七个工具和做设计的人设），各部分在插件页里各有开关。从手机或别的电脑打开 DSH 时，本地 HTML 做的设计打包进沙盒框里，照样能看，没改的屏不再重新传。试验功能「业务标注」（默认关）打开后，模型会同时写下界面上看不出来的规则、状态和边界，页面上标编号、右侧栏列卡片，转代码时一起交给开发。

description.zh: ★ 25 │ 下载、更新并启动桌面外壳，创建快捷方式与启动工具。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek…

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching…
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制，共 21 个工具：UIA 控件树 + 离线 OCR 看屏幕、按控件名字点击、不占剪贴板地打中文，微信 / Office / 浏览器 / 网课都能操作。不抢你的鼠标键盘（你在用它会等）、从不改你的窗口大小，侧边栏「指挥台」可随时打字纠正，每步操作后都会回头核对屏幕并如实说明结果。内置持久登…

description.en: ★ 8 │ Configure and reorder desktop status fields, with token costs, custom model prices, currencies and account balance.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 配置和排序桌面状态字段，显示 Token 费用、自定义模型单价、币种和账户余额。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click…
description.zh: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: configure per-model reasoning effort levels for custom pi-ai providers in the Models settings page, with presets for GPT, Claude, Grok, GLM and MiMo models.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在模型设置中调整第三方模型的推理强度，提供 GPT、Claude、Grok、GLM 和 MiMo 预设。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns,…
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone…
description.zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: inventory your Windows dev/test toolchain, spot the gaps, and fill them with one click.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 检查 Windows 开发和测试工具链，找出并补齐缺失组件。

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite),…
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件…

description.en: Starts a whole dev stack from one place: it scans a directory for projects, matches each one's start command, starts them in dependency order once their ports…
description.zh: 一个地方管起整套开发环境：扫描目录发现项目并匹配各自的启动命令，按依赖顺序启动、以端口探测确认就绪，日志带彩色显示在侧栏。

description.en: Workbench with an AI assistant, pause/stop controls, separate background-model settings, tasks/replies, Linky, scoped knowledge capture, local and Yunzhijia…
description.zh: 智能工作台，集成可停止的AI助手、后台模型独立配置、待办与回复跟进、Linky研发、知识收藏与检索、云之家搜索、资讯原文及开发工具；可选本地向量需下载模型，云之家需账号及CLI，多AI对话需桌面端。

description.en: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。

description.en: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input…
description.zh: 把 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟机投进 DSH 的浮窗，可同时开多个，并在投屏画面上点、拖、打字，输入回传到设备。

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar…
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring…
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the…
description.zh: DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。

description.en: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: Store project knowledge in editable Markdown files shared across sessions in the same project.
description.zh: 将项目知识保存为可编辑的 Markdown 文件，供同一项目的多个会话共享。

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes…

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and every…
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，每条规则右侧都有独立开关，可以随时单独停用某一条而不用删掉它（停用项不参与注入、剩余条目编号仍然连续）；也可以多选若干对话整体排除在外，让它们完全不受围栏约束，勾选对话本身不会改动任何规则；启用中的规则作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注…

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS…

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local…
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single…

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write,…

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume,…
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a…

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Open delivered files, changed-file rows and inline file mentions in the system default app with a left click; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus,…

description.en: Left sidebar disk panel for the DSH Web UI: volume free space, per-Workspace folder sizes, moving build artifacts to the macOS Trash with an audit log and…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 左侧栏磁盘面板：各卷剩余空间、按工作区统计目录占用、把构建产物安全移入 macOS 废纸篓（带审计与恢复）、把扫描结果交给 Agent 分析，以及 Host 端低空间看门狗与系统通知。仅限 macOS 和 Linux；移入废纸篓只在 macOS 上可用，Linux…

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with…
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: A persistent download server for DSH — jobs outlive the session, survive a restart, and resume from the last byte.
description.zh: DSH 的全自动轻量常驻下载服务器 —— 任务活过会话、扛过重启，断点按字节续传。

description.en: Per-session document ledger in the DSH sidebar (Windows only, Chinese-language UI): which documents a session read, created or modified, with time ordering,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏按会话查看文档台账（仅 Windows，界面仅中文）：用过哪些文档、创建/修改了哪些，带时间排序、类型分组、搜索与两种预览。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read,…

A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings…

description.en: DokuWiki integration for DeepSeek Harness: native tools to read, search, write and delete wiki pages and upload media files, with ACL-aware tool exposure and…

description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its…
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: ★ 131 │ Recall and re-edit messages in the web conversation.
description.zh: ★ 131 │ 撤回并重新编辑网页会话中的消息。

description.en: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层上下文压缩插件：把旧轮次折成由模型撰写摘要的 L1–L3 块，在地图里显示每层占用与可压位置，并在占用越过提醒线或持续增长时叫醒模型决定是否压缩。默认需要启用 DSH 实验性插件「会话搜索」（session_event_read / session_event_search），否…

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Inspect per-turn skill usage and manage installed skills and their upstream updates.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 查看每轮技能调用，并管理已安装技能及其上游更新。

description.en: Adds one tool, echo_judge, that scores 1-4 draft replies to an emotionally loaded message on three steps (perception, mental-state inference, response…
description.zh: 加一个工具 echo_judge：对 1–4 条回复候选按「感知／心智状态推理／支持策略」三步打分，用级联门控与步骤级信用分配合成总分，并指出最弱、该重做的那一步；打分走引擎自带的 ctx.llm，不需要 API key。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command…
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed…
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Adds an "edit question" action to every user message: editing re-sends the prompt from that turn, re-attaches the original images (extra ones can be pasted…
description.zh: 在每条用户提问旁加「编辑提问」入口：改完从该提问重新开始，原图一并重发（还可粘贴补充图），原会话可选保留或归档。

description.en: ★ 1 │ List real user prompts from a session, edit one, fork the session before that turn and place the revised prompt in the new composer without sending it. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=22; the first turn cannot be rerun.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 列出一段会话里真实的用户提示词，修改其中一条，在该轮之前分叉会话，并把改后的文本预填进新输入框而不自动发送。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 和 Node >=22，第一轮不可重跑。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: MCP hub for 1C development: keeps 1C:EDT connected through EDT-MCP, starts BSL Language Server with workspace roots on demand, and adds per-project settings, a…
description.zh: 面向 1C 开发的 MCP 枢纽：通过 EDT-MCP 保持 1C:EDT 连接，按需以工作区根目录启动 BSL Language Server，并提供逐项目设置、只读文档 wiki、模型规则以及 SonarQube/GitLab 技能。需安装 1C:EDT 2026.1/2026.2 并运行 EDT-MCP（默认…

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have…
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生…

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the…
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Replaces the composer's reasoning-effort dropdown with a card that shows one illustration per level (off / low / high / max); the four levels keep their…
description.zh: 把输入框的推理强度下拉换成一张卡片，每一档配一张插画（off / low / high / max）；四档取值与原来一致，换插画只需替换 assets/ 下的同名文件。

description.en: Replaces the composer model menu with a recent-models list, a searchable all-providers flyout and a draggable reasoning-effort slider; a Manage models row at…
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单换成最近模型列表、可搜索的全部模型飞出面板和一条可拖动的思考强度滑杆；全部模型面板底部的「管理模型」可直接打开设置的模型页。它接管输入框的模型位，请只装一个模型菜单类插件。

description.en: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: simple tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one declared step, and agents can change their…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐步思考强度驾驶：简单工具轮保持低档、失败与重活自动升一档，Agent 还能通过 set_effort 工具在不切换模型的情况下调整自身思考深度。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adjust reasoning effort from the model menu, including suggested levels for models without declared efforts. Availability depends on provider support; requires Node >=22, with no DSH compatibility range declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在模型菜单调整推理等级，为未声明档位的模型提供建议档位；实际生效取决于提供商支持，需要 Node >=22，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Design-review gate for DeepSeek Harness, a DSH port of Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model: a context-rich Elephant session drafts the design, then fresh,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的设计评审闸门，移植自 Google 的 Elephant-Goldfish Model：具备完整上下文的“大象”起草设计，再由零上下文的只读“金鱼”评审者严格审查，通过后才进入实现。注册的插件 id 为 `egm`，同一 profile 请只安装一个 EGM 插件。

description.en: ★ 497 │ Drive browser automation tools and watch or interact with the live browser view.
description.zh: ★ 497 │ 调用浏览器自动化工具，并查看或操作实时浏览器画面。

description.en: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a…
description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的 MCP 审计服务接入 DSH，在移动端视口矩阵中检查已部署页面并返回结构化修复证据；前置需要在同一台机器上装好 uv/uvx 与 Playwright Chromium 无头运行时。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell…

description.en: EIA technical guideline applicability and execution-standard check.

description.zh: 中文电子发票（OFD/XML）收件箱：导入、解析、去重、进入复核队列、登记回执并本地归档——10 个 `invoice.*` 工具，数据不出本机。

description.en: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the…
description.zh: 嵌入式闭环开发驾驶舱（DSH 插件）：agent 在面板里闭环开发 STM32——发现、编译、烧录、调试校验、串口监视，开发过程对用户全程可视化（阶梯进度、实时日志、RAM/FLASH 占用、串口波形解码）。需主机自带 PATH 上的 Python 3.10+（插件不能代装）；ARM 工具链首次使用时自动下载（约…

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in…

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.

description.en: ★ 43 │ Connect multiple mail accounts to send, receive, and search messages with attachments, drafts, and sending approvals.

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the…

description.en: ★ 55 │ Add switchable inline emoji packs to agent replies, mapped from 40 semantic emoji without extra model calls, with adjustable frequency and size.
description.zh: ★ 55 │ 为 Agent 回复加入可切换的行内表情包，由 40 个语义表情映射而来，不额外调用模型，可调整出现频率和大小。

description.zh: 每回合判定工作模型自身的情绪，并在下一回合开始前静默回注给它，形成「自省 → 状态留存 → 行为调整」 的闭环。包含宿主插件、输入框上方的情绪面板、只读的 emotion_status 工具与可选的只读 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a…

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close /…

description.en: ★ 204 │ Curated long-term memory kept as plain Markdown notes and shared across hosts, with the index size limit enforced by a tool guard. Keep the store git-ignored when it sits inside a project repository.
description.zh: ★ 204 │ 以纯 Markdown 笔记保存的策展式长期记忆，多个宿主共用一个记忆库，索引上限由工具守卫强制执行。记忆库放在项目仓库内时需加入 git-ignore。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls…
description.zh: 给 Engramory 记忆库加本地 BM25 自动召回、写入闸门、静态体检与记忆面板。不联网、不起进程，默认不调模型；召回质量由仓库里的可复算基准量化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without…

description.en: Automate Huawei eNSP labs: generate .topo files, start and stop devices, and push configuration one command at a time with per-command error reporting. On…

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode for non-destructive…

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and…
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and…
description.zh: 拖拽重排 dsh 左侧栏的插件面板条目与会话顶部标签，并能把条目在侧栏与标签区之间搬移（搬过去是真实标签）；顺序与搬移状态存本机，重启后保留。

description.en: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between…

description.en: ★ 2 │ Adds an Environment Check tab in Settings showing host process identity and grouped env vars (values stay on the host), plus a read-only env_inspect model tool.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在设置中查看宿主进程和环境变量分组，通过只读工具检查环境，变量值保留在宿主端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型、同样的思考强度，只花更少的输出 token，全程提示词侧。默认只开「精简输出」（late 模式，第 4 步后生效），其余开关默认关、可单独打开；工具输出很长时再开「截短工具输出」那个。本机实测、非榜单成绩：输出偏长的 30 对任务，只开截短开关时 0.756× 耗时、输出 token −21%；6 个真实 `pallets/click` PR 共 24 对，0.805× 耗时、token −23%。在官方 SWE-bench Lite 题目定义上用自建 harness 量不出收益（8 题、三次独立跑合池 72 对：墙钟 0.933×、token 0.903×，墙钟仍跨 1；同一配置单跑之间就差三成），往截短上再叠别的开关反而更差。数字与复现见仓库。

description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and…
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace,…
description.zh: 免运维的远程 DSH——拿飞书私聊当界面，机器人出站长连接、不需要公网入口，工作区、会话（切换与改名）、模型、推理深度、权限预设、余额都用卡片操作，工具审批与 agent 反问也在同一个聊天里回。

description.en: Feishu OAuth login reduces the need to distribute the DSH owner token while retaining token login; authorized users receive native owner session cookies with…
description.zh: 通过飞书 OAuth 登录减少分发 DSH owner token 的需要，同时保留 token 登录；获准用户使用原生 owner 会话 Cookie，共享 owner 权限，不提供逐用户隔离。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic maps to one dsh session, with in-card approvals and questions over a long connection that needs no public endpoint.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过飞书话题连接 DSH 会话，在卡片中审批和回答问题，无需公网入口。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send…
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊…

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and…
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each…
description.zh: 在 QQ 通道上给 DSH 人设按人记好感度（需先装 QQ 通道插件，如 dsh-onebot-qq；身份取自消息里的 QQ 号，纯 Web 界面下不会注入）：分数、每日衰减、理由回看、生闷气与哄好，外加影响整体语气的综合情绪。

description.en: Gives the companion a mood judged each turn and shown as a short context note, with a panel for mood, emotion dimensions and timeline.
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个每轮判定、以一小段上下文提示的心情，面板里能看心情值、情绪维度与时间线。

description.en: Synthesises speech through Alibaba Bailian's WebSocket TTS and returns a WAV file plus a preview URL, with an optional per-turn hint that nudges the model…
description.zh: 调用阿里百炼 WebSocket TTS 合成语音，返回 WAV 文件与试听地址，并可按轮提示模型使用语音。需要百炼 API Key 与 ffmpeg，文本会发送到阿里云；插件本身不发消息，怎么发由当前会话的传输方式决定。

description.en: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person…
description.zh: 给 DSH 加识图：用智谱 GLM-4V 描述图片、读图中文字（需智谱 API Key，有免费额度），可选火山方舟认人、SauceNAO / trace.moe 反查动漫原图（各需自己的 Key）；GIF/WebP 图需要装 ffmpeg。Key 与 ffmpeg 路径在插件自带的设置页里配。

description.en: Look up Chinese companies inside the conversation: name a company and get its business registration, shareholders, executives, outbound investments and…
description.zh: 在对话里直接查中国企业：说出公司名就能拿到工商基本信息、股东、高管、对外投资、工商变更，以及被执行、失信、限制高消费、经营异常、严重违法、行政处罚等司法与经营风险（共 11 类维度）；结果以对话卡片呈现，展开可看字段与原始数据，API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

description.en: ★ 3 │ A skill-only bundle that makes a five-part Feynman-style answer the default shape for explanatory replies: conclusion, numbered points, summary, takeaway and action, then a one-sentence Occam cut. MIT; ships a skill and a Cordis patch, no host JavaScript entry.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 纯技能包：把费曼五段式（先结论、编号论点、总结、启示与行动，最后压成一句话）作为解释型回答的默认骨架。MIT 许可，仅含技能与 Cordis 补丁，没有宿主 JavaScript 入口。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Right-click files, folders, web links, and workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebars to reference, copy, preview, open in a chosen app or browser,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话区和侧边栏右键文件、文件夹、网页链接和工作区：引用、复制、预览、用默认或选择的应用/浏览器打开、定位或另存为。

description.en: Local image, PDF, data, audio/video and Office file conversion through agent tools and a drag-and-drop interface; v1.0.x targets DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, with…
description.zh: 通过 Agent 工具和拖拽界面在本地转换图片、PDF、数据、音视频及 Office 文件；v1.0.x 适配 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，部分转换需要外部工具。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment…
description.zh: 把右侧文件区的文件和文件夹拖进输入框：落下的文件变成句中内嵌的小卡片、附件卡片或 @ 路径，可在设置里切换。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files…
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files…

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web GUI 的文件树：行内显示大小与修改时间，右键菜单支持下载、上传、复制路径。

description.en: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with…
description.zh: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by…
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be…
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的…

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add workspace file references and selected preview text to the composer. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将工作区文件和预览中选中的文字引用到输入框。要求 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default…
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: ★ 44 │ Review DeepSeek Harness file changes in native sidebar tabs
description.zh: ★ 44 │ 在原生侧栏标签页中审阅工作区文件变更。

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: ★ 28 │ DeepSeek Harness dual-face plugin: Codex-style file references (@path), fully bundled document→Markdown (MarkItDown engine, 20+ formats), mature image handling (read_image for multimodal routes, automatic vision descriptions for text-only models), read_document tool.
description.zh: ★ 28 │ 上传和引用文件，将文档转为 Markdown，并提供图片与文档读取工具。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a…
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item…
description.zh: DSH 工作区文件树的右键菜单：打开文件、展开或折叠文件夹、复制绝对路径/相对路径/文件名，并在资源管理器中定位。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads…
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Analyze video shots, transcripts and visual evidence, run segment-by-segment analysis jobs, and export reports. Requires local media tools; Whisper/OCR enhancements need additional Python packages. Model analysis uses your configured DSH model.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 分析视频镜头、台词与画面证据，按分段任务深度拉片并导出报告。需要本地媒体工具，Whisper/OCR 增强需另配 Python 环境；模型分析使用 DSH 中配置的模型。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Finance terminal for the DSH right sidebar: cross-asset quotes, a rotating globe, a risk-appetite gauge, plain-Chinese explanations and related news, with two-way chat with the agent via finance_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏查看多类资产行情、风险偏好指标、中文说明和资讯，并与 Agent 交流。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add Cmd/Ctrl+F search to the DSH desktop app, with highlighting, match counts and previous/next navigation. Search the conversation and right panel separately; collapsed content is skipped.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 DSH 桌面端补上 Cmd/Ctrl+F 页内查找，支持高亮、匹配计数和前后跳转，可分别搜索对话与右侧面板，跳过折叠内容。

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted…
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的…

description.en: Search Nyaa anime releases with quality and Chinese subtitle checks, manage scheduled tracking and qBittorrent delivery, and browse Bangumi lists with manual…
description.zh: dsh-find-anime：按画质与中文字幕要求搜索 Nyaa 动漫资源，管理定时追番与 qBittorrent 下载，浏览 Bangumi 番单并手动同步进度。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.11 及以上版本。

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度、新鲜度与有界热度排序，而不是只看 star。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: Chinese tax and cross-border e-commerce workbench: a local BigInt statement parser for Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Stripe CSV/TSV/XLSX exports…
description.zh: 中国财税与跨境电商工作台：提供 Amazon、TikTok Shop、Stripe 原始结算账单本地 BigInt 离线解析与异常雷达工具（fintax_parse_statement）、7 场景确定性算税与四层口径差额桥接工具（fintax_calc）、4 个腾讯 IMA…

description.en: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
description.zh: 通过 Firecrawl Cloud API 把 URL 抓成 LLM 可用 Markdown，或搜索网页并返回结果内容。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet of Firefly (流萤) that chats through the host model, plays animations on click, whispers on a timer, narrates task…
description.zh: 流萤桌宠：透明置顶的桌面伴侣，走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify…
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: Dreams for the pet in dsh-fish: once she has been quiet long enough, it picks real events from her event stream, follows one of six dream theories, and hands…
description.zh: 给 dsh-fish 里的她做梦：安静够久之后，从她真实的事件流里挑碎片，按六种梦理论之一拼成「梦的种子」，她自己把梦写完。提供三个工具（dream_recall、dream_record、dream_now），插件自己不调用模型，数据放在 ~/.dsh-fish-dream。梦只能用真实发生过的事重拼，理论只决定怎么…

description.en: ★ 514 │ Long-term conversation memory with decay, retrieval and session or workspace libraries. Extraction and keyword expansion use the configured model. By Yuuyuko-uu, under the bundled custom license.
description.zh: ★ 514 │ 为会话提供带时间和遗忘机制的长期记忆，支持检索、长期事实及会话或工作区记忆库。提炼与扩词使用已配置模型；作者 Yuuyuko-uu，采用包内自定义许可。

description.en: A single-character agent that lives across QQ (via SnowLuma / OneBot 11), Bilibili and Douyin (the Douyin channel needs an always-on Windows desktop): persona cards with slowly evolving traits, per-person memory with Ebbinghaus decay and correction, a virtual clock driving a daily routine, proactive messages, auto-extracted memories, and a ten-tab settings panel covering retrieval, persona, routine, memory inspection, channels, habits, models and usage. QQ groups are deny-by-default: a group is answered only when it is on the allowlist or allGroups is explicitly switched on, and it still has to @-mention the bot. Private chats answer QQ friends only. Bilibili/Douyin auto-reply is off by default, limited to the owner, allowlist and mutual follows on Bilibili, and to the owner and allowlist on Douyin unless reply-to-everyone is explicitly enabled. Vendors MIT-licensed code from dsh-qq-bridge and dsh-douyin-bridge, credited in-source with their LICENSE files; it does not need either installed alongside.
description.zh: 活在 QQ（经 SnowLuma / OneBot 11）、B站、抖音（抖音通道需一台常开的 Windows 桌面）三端的单角色智能体：人格卡与慢慢长出来的人格、按人隔离的记忆（艾宾浩斯衰减、可纠正、聊完自动记）、虚拟时钟驱动的作息与主动开口；设置面板共十个标签，覆盖检索、人格、自走、记忆检视、三端通道、习惯、模型与用量。QQ 群默认拒绝：只有列进群白名单、或显式打开「所有群」的群才会被回应，且仍需 @ 它；私聊只回 QQ 好友。B站 / 抖音自动回复默认关闭：B站只回主人、白名单与互关，抖音只回主人与白名单（「回所有人」需另行打开）。内置了 dsh-qq-bridge 与 dsh-douyin-bridge 的 MIT 授权代码，源码与 LICENSE 内均有署名；不必与这两个插件同装。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice…
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Convert Markdown to inline-styled WeChat articles, with themes, a sidebar workbench and block editing tools.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 把 Markdown 排成带内联样式的公众号文章，提供主题、侧边工作台和块级改稿工具。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health…
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the…
description.zh: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending…
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on…
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh)…
description.zh: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

description.en: ★ 25 │ Visualize session execution, tool calls and concurrent agent branches.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 可视化会话执行过程、工具调用与并发 Agent 分支。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Local long-term memory with 15 MCP tools, automatic capture and recall, and bounded pointer context. Shares stored user input across sessions. Requires Node >=20, Python >=3.10, torch, sentence-transformers, numpy and mcp >=1.30 <2; first use downloads an embedding model. No DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 提供 15 个 MCP 长期记忆工具、自动捕获召回和有界指针上下文；用户输入会持久保存并跨会话共享。需 Node >=20、Python >=3.10，以及 torch、sentence-transformers、numpy、mcp >=1.30 <2，首次会下载嵌入模型；包内未声明 DSH 版本范围。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Pop-out sidebar: a DeepSeek Harness sidebar that shows artifacts and pops out into a larger web tab.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在侧栏预览产物，也可弹出到独立浏览器标签页中放大查看。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk…
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Notify for approvals, questions, plan review and completed replies, accounting for window focus and background sessions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 根据窗口焦点和后台会话状态，提醒审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: FOFA cyberspace mapping inside the conversation: check the account quota, run FOFA queries and export the full result set into CSV/JSON/TXT files in the…
description.zh: 在对话里做 FOFA 网络空间测绘：查看账号额度、执行查询语句，并把全量结果按时间游标深翻页导出为 CSV／JSON／TXT 落到会话工作区；被时间预算或上游报错中断的 CSV／TXT 导出可凭游标续写同一文件，已拉取的行不丢。结果以对话卡片展示（语句、命中数、文件路径），API Key 在插件页保存到…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Lets the DeepSeek Harness web composer accept folders via drag, paste or the /folder command, with a host folder dialog and @path mentions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在网页输入框拖入、粘贴或选择文件夹，生成 @path 引用，也可使用 /folder 命令。

description.en: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的文件夹资源管理器：打开任意本地文件夹、按类型显示彩色图标、重命名/新建/删除/复制文件与文件夹，并可把文件作为 @ 引用添加到对话。

description.en: Inserts the full path as text when a folder is pasted into the input box, instead of trying to upload it (Windows and macOS).
description.zh: 粘贴复制来的文件夹时插入完整路径文本，而不是尝试上传（支持 Windows 与 macOS）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Stop automatic following once a generated answer fills the visible conversation area, keeping its opening in view. Works with or without dsh-smooth-stream and depends on the host conversation DOM.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 生成的回答铺满会话可视区域后停止自动跟随，保留开头供阅读。可独立使用或搭配 dsh-smooth-stream，依赖宿主会话 DOM 标记。

description.en: ★ 5 │ DIY your DSH UI fonts: per-region font, size, weight, and color for Chinese and English, pick-to-create regions, unified overrides, saved themes, random color schemes, and one-click install of cute fonts.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 按区域调整中英文字体、字号、字重和颜色，保存主题，并支持随机配色和字体安装。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Adjust conversation, interface, and code typography and save, import, or export presets.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 分别调整对话、界面和代码的字体样式，并保存、导入和导出排版预设。

description.en: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through…
description.zh: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

description.en: Adds a Forget action to every session row menu, confirmed by a second click in the menu, that removes the session from the sidebar and from disk: running work…
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入「遗忘会话」（菜单内二次点击确认），把会话从侧栏与磁盘彻底移除：先停掉正在运行的工作，经官方通道解除工作区、归档与置顶记录，删除日志目录与投影缓存条目，并由复活守卫在一个窗口内补删迟到写入或句柄残留重建的文件；灵枢记忆、附件与其他会话不受影响。

description.en: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to…
description.zh: AI填表智能体：支持自动填表、表格填充、表格补全、Excel填表与 Excel回填；使用企查查 MCP 填写 XLSX 空白字段，预览确认后导出新副本。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add a Foxy persona as a DSH agent preset while keeping the native conversation runtime. Choose a model in DSH; persistent memory requires the separate dsh-foxy-memory plugin.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH 增加 Foxy 人物预设，复用原生会话运行时。模型由用户在 DSH 中选择，持久记忆需另装 dsh-foxy-memory。

description.en: Lets Foxy browse Bilibili with daily windows and video limits, filter by interests, comment or remember through an editable prompt, reply to mentions and…
description.zh: 让 Foxy 按每日时段和视频上限浏览 B 站，按兴趣筛选，用可编辑提示词评论或记忆，并回复 @ 与评论楼中楼，按视频去重。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Connects DSH Foxy to Foxy Memory for cross-platform recall, with local JSONL fallback, platform filters, and a memory browser. Requires dsh-foxy.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 Foxy 接入 Foxy Memory，支持跨平台召回、本地 JSONL 回退、平台筛选与记忆浏览。需先安装 dsh-foxy。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

description.en: Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: Keyless image generation with two tools: generate_image (no API key, one call at a time, bounded rate-limit retries) and list_image_models.
description.zh: 无需 API 密钥的图片生成，含两个工具：generate_image（无需密钥、串行调用、有限次限流重试）与 list_image_models。

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

description.en: ★ 1,102 │ Search and fetch pages through multiple engines with configurable routing, filters and fallbacks.
description.zh: ★ 1,102 │ 使用多个引擎搜索和抓取网页，自定义路由、筛选与失败切换。

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a…
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain,…
description.zh: 免费网页搜索，支持 10 个引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、按时间筛选的高级搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页内容抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基本使用无需…

description.en: Hosts the ai-goofish-monitor scraper for the Xianyu second-hand marketplace: managed backend lifecycle, thirteen goofish_* agent tools, a sidebar panel, and AI…
description.zh: 托管闲鱼二手市场监控后端 ai-goofish-monitor：管理其进程生命周期，提供十三个 goofish_* agent 工具与侧边栏面板，并把商品分析默认接到 dsh-our-free-model 的免费模型网关。

description.en: Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table…
description.zh: 通过 FreeCAD 读写 STEP 模型、量取几何尺寸（距离、角度、直径），并生成带孔表的第一角法二维加工图，可导出 SVG、DXF、PDF、PNG。

description.en: Registers FreeLLMAPI as a dsh model provider, with the router itself bundled in the plugin. It launches the vendored server with the host binary and exposes…
description.zh: 把 FreeLLMAPI 注册为 dsh 的模型 provider，路由本体随插件打包。插件用宿主二进制启动内置服务并暴露 freellmapi 路由；侧栏面板负责启停该进程、列出路由的模型目录、实测哪些自称可用的模型真能回答，并按路由自身计算的稳定、速度、智能评分排序。provider…

description.en: ★ 18 │ Free-tier model aggregation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers a freeroute provider over a pool of free-quota upstreams such as OpenCode Zen, B.AI, OpenRouter and SenseNova.
description.zh: ★ 18 │ 将 OpenCode Zen、B.AI、OpenRouter、SenseNova 等来源的免费额度模型汇总为一个供应商。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Add multi-engine web search with parallel queries and fallback across Startpage, DuckDuckGo and other services. Search queries leave the host for those engines; optional engines can use configured API keys. Requires Node >=20.3.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过多引擎并发与回退接入 Startpage、DuckDuckGo 等网页搜索服务。查询会发送到相应引擎，可选引擎可使用已配置的 API Key。需要 Node >=20.3。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under…
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Public chat rooms with quoted replies and opt-in encrypted private text chat inside DeepSeek Harness, using a shared Nostr relay and locally protected…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内进入公共聊天室交流，支持引用回复、私聊申请和加密文字聊天，通过共同 Nostr 中继互通，身份保存在本机受保护存储中（macOS 钥匙串 / Windows DPAPI；Linux 无身份保存适配，暂不能发言）。

description.zh: ★ 19 │ 读写、编辑和搜索多种编码的文件，保留 UTF-8 BOM，并支持 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS 等编码。

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check…
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device…
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline…

description.en: ★ 3 │ Turns DSH's settings dialog into a Codex-style full-page fullscreen settings page for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 将设置弹窗改为 Codex 风格的全屏设置页。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a…
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: ★ 68 │ Collect public fund data and inspect holdings, manager history and performance metrics.
description.zh: ★ 68 │ 整理公开基金数据，查看持仓、基金经理履历与业绩指标。

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back;…
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh,…
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar, built to fix DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: it watches your on-disk output folders and shows files as…
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧栏变成产出目录的实时画廊，专门解决 DSH「只在任务结束时才列出产出文件、过程不可见」的问题：直接盯磁盘产出目录，文件一生成就能看到，方便在任务进行中校验与纠正。图片缩略图自动刷新、支持缩放拖动；文档、代码、数据、压缩包与链接点击即调用 DSH 原生侧栏预览；支持按「本对话产出」筛选；支持多扫描目录，兼…

description.en: A panel plugin that keeps mini-games in one place and plays them in the same window. Ships with Tetris: a 10x20 board, seven pieces, a ghost piece and a…
description.zh: 面板插件：把开发的小游戏集中到一处，并在同一窗口内直接游玩。首发俄罗斯方块：10×20 棋盘、七种方块、落点虚影与下一个方块预览、消行与等级计分、三档难度，最高分存在 localStorage。

description.en: Daily game automation on Windows for Genshin Impact, Honkai Impact 3, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero: a scheduled task per game drives BetterGI, the…
description.zh: Windows 上的原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零日常自动化：每个游戏一个计划任务，分别驱动 BetterGI、game-daily 技能族、三月七助手或绝区零「一条龙」；带逐游戏开关、前台守护、只在出问题时介入的运行期值守，以及每游戏固定一个汇报会话、后续结果追加进去。需要 DSH…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Play five built-in games and install community games while following agent status, with saved progress and completion reminders. Community catalogs and game packages are downloaded; games run in isolated frames with instance credentials. Requires DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 Agent 工作时游玩五款内置游戏或安装社区游戏，保留进度并显示任务状态与完成提醒。社区目录和游戏包需联网下载，游戏在隔离框架中运行并使用实例凭证。需 DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0、Node >=20。
