description.en: ★ 1 │ Summarize Git commits and changed lines across workspaces and generate daily, weekly or monthly reports, optionally limited to your own Git identity. Runs local Git commands; optional plugin updates use the configured npm registry. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 统计各工作区的 Git 提交与变更行数，按全部作者或本人身份生成日报、周报和月报。使用本机 Git，可选从配置的 npm 源检查并更新插件；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0。

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

description.en: Session-level autonomy gears for DSH: a rail on the edge of the conversation area switches P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A and injects the active gear's behavioral…
description.zh: 会话级行动档位：对话区左缘的滑轨切换 P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A，并向每条请求注入当前档位的行为提示词；模型的 set_gear 只能降档，手刹 H 拦截全部工具调用。模型的 set_gear 只能自行降档，升档需用户在卡片上批准。

description.en: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Shows a Gemini quota bar in the DeepSeek Harness composer; clicking it opens a multi-account pool panel with per-account remaining quota, cooldown start/stop, keep-alive detection, and one-click account switching.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 在输入框查看 Gemini 额度，展开面板后管理多账号、冷却状态和账号切换。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on…
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: Reads one Genshin Impact account (characters, talents, weapons, artifacts, wish history) into a single snapshot, then exposes it as six agent tools and a…
description.zh: 把原神账号读成一份快照（角色、天赋、武器、圣遗物、祈愿记录），对外给 6 个 agent 工具和一个六页签面板。圣遗物副词条取自游戏内公开的角色展柜；评分同时给 CV 与逐角色权重两套模型，各六档评级；抽卡分析包含保底、欧非分档与各池进度。读取角色、武器与祈愿需要米游社扫码登录；展柜数据按 UID 公开。

description.en: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
description.zh: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

description.en: Two chibi Genshin Impact desktop pets (Columbina and Nahida), 22 transparent animations each, with desktop wandering, drag-and-throw physics, click reactions,…
description.zh: 两只原神 Q 版桌宠（哥伦比娅、纳西妲），每只 22 段透明动画；可桌面漫步、拖拽抛掷、点击反应，会碎碎念，并用 DSH 模型陪聊。本包派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），沿用上游的 /dsh-pet-7340 路由与 ~/.dsh/dsh-pet 数据目录，请替代 dsh-pet…

description.en: ★ 55 │ GenUI for DeepSeek Harness: interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps rendered inline in assistant replies, with actions that flow back to the model.
description.zh: ★ 55 │ 在回复中渲染图表、表单、计算器与小应用，并将操作反馈给模型。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64),…
description.zh: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view,…
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
description.zh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。

description.en: Connects free and check-in account channels to DeepSeek: Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, Qoder, TRAE, Raccoon, LobsterAI, MiniMax, ZCode…
description.zh: 把免费、签到型的模型账号渠道接进 DeepSeek：华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy、Qoder、TRAE、Raccoon、LobsterAI、MiniMax、ZCode、讯飞 Loomy。在设置里逐渠道登录，能签到的渠道每日签到（也可开自动），同步可用模型池，模型以普通…

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end;…
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Publish generated HTML or Markdown to GitHub Pages and manage previously published artifacts.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将生成的 HTML 或 Markdown 发布到 GitHub Pages，并管理已发布产物。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Import binaries and run decompilation and output operations through persistent PyGhidra and GhidraMCP servers.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过持久运行的 PyGhidra 与 GhidraMCP 服务导入二进制、反编译并输出结果。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word…
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven…
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show the session's repository, branch, change count and short SHA above the composer; switch or create branches, list worktrees and open a per-file diff panel.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框上方显示当前会话的仓库、分支、改动数和短 SHA，可切换或新建分支、查看工作树，并在侧栏逐文件查看差异。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Git branch and worktree management: shows and switches the current branch in the input toolbar, with an IDEA-style branch picker, remote checkout, right-click actions, push/update, and isolated worktree workspaces.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在输入框切换和管理 Git 分支，支持远程分支、推送、更新，以及独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

description.en: VSCode/IDEA-style Git source control in the DSH right sidebar, with a colour-coded commit graph, branch switching, staging, hunk actions, stash and history…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供类 VSCode/IDEA 的 Git 源码管理，含彩色提交图、分支切换、暂存与逐块操作、stash 与历史过滤。

description.en: Adds read-only Git status colors, file badges and directory change summaries to the native DSH file tree, with cached status reads and a manual refresh button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生文件树中显示只读 Git 状态颜色、文件标记和目录变更汇总，提供状态缓存及手动刷新按钮。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Manage forge accounts and project authorization, then supply HTTPS credentials through a helper and reject unauthorized hosts.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 管理代码托管账号和项目授权，通过凭据助手提供 HTTPS 认证，并拒绝未授权主机。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count,…
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: Git panel for the DSH right sidebar: staging, commits, branch switching, fetch/pull/push, worktrees, a Cursor-style commit graph and GitHub pull requests (the…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 面板：暂存、提交、切换分支、fetch/pull/push、工作树、Cursor 风格提交图与 GitHub PR（GitHub 卡片需要 GitHub 令牌）。直接调用系统 git，面板与终端状态保持一致。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: ★ 169 │ Long-term memory stored in a local Git repository, with a settings row to check its status and clear memories. Declares support only for DSH 0.1.
description.zh: ★ 169 │ 把长期记忆保存在本地 Git 仓库中，可在设置页查看状态并清除记忆。仅声明支持 DSH 0.1。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: ★ 0 │ dsh panel plugin: sidebar git management — Local Changes / All Commits, branch/tag/stash management, merge with conflict handling.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏查看改动与提交，管理分支、标签和暂存记录，支持合并及冲突处理。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: ★ 3 │ A Review tab and guarded git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: changes vs HEAD as a filterable file tree with per-file diffs, a commit graph, and stage/commit/branch actions.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 按文件查看改动和差异，浏览提交图，执行暂存、提交和分支操作。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Git tools and /git slash commands for DeepSeek Harness, running git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work even when the session shell is sandboxed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过宿主进程执行 Git 和 /git 命令，即使会话 Shell 在沙箱中也可推送、拉取和获取更新。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash…
description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and…
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Run a dedicated Git Bash executor and terminal integration on Windows.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 在 Windows 上使用独立 Git Bash 命令执行器与终端集成。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls —…
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备…

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search,…
description.zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

description.en: ★ 19 │ A GitHub workflow engine for DeepSeek Harness with native GitHub CLI (gh) integration. It provides 18 agent tools for PRs, CI diagnosis, releases, secrets, rulesets, and Copilot dispatch, plus /gh shortcuts.
description.zh: ★ 19 │ 通过 gh 在 DSH 中管理 PR、排查 CI、发布版本，并操作密钥、规则集和 Copilot 任务。

description.en: Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click;…
description.zh: 把对话里的 GitHub / GitLab / Gitee 链接变成带缓存元数据的悬停卡片，点击在 DSH 右侧栏浏览器中打开；裸 URL 与 GenUI 块都覆盖，且不修改 GenUI 本体。

description.en: Sidebar GitHub panel plus github_* agent tools: list your repositories, inspect issues and pull requests, and create, update or comment on issues.
description.zh: 侧栏 GitHub 面板加 github_* 工具：列出仓库、查看 Issue 与 PR，新建、更新或评论 Issue。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes…
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo…
description.zh: GitHub MCP 辅助面板：在「设置 → 插件 → GitHub MCP」展示可复制的示例提示（30 条示例池随机 4 条）、可视化公开仓库的星/fork/语言，并提供 gh_repo_stats / gh_current_user 模型工具。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh…
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally,…
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with…
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: GitHub authorization, repository browsing, AI-written project intros and confirmed Release publishing inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内完成 GitHub 授权、仓库浏览、AI 生成项目介绍与 Release 发布，所有写操作先预览再确认。

description.en: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话与工作区文件同步到私有 GitHub 仓库，实现跨设备接力；支持同步徽标、搜索与批量上传、本地/远端独立删除、冲突选边，以及多设备安全的索引合并。

description.en: GitHub Trending in the DSH sidebar: daily, weekly and monthly boards with category chips, model-written project intros in the UI language, and one-click…
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏浏览 GitHub Trending：日/周/月三榜加分类标签，由模型用界面语言撰写项目简介，一键加星可同步到 GitHub 账号或存入本地收藏。它会访问 github.com、api.github.com 和 raw.githubusercontent.com，把 README…

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve…
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes,…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and…
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and…
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Shows GLM Coding Plan quota windows (5-hour, weekly, monthly tools) as an always-visible pill in the composer stats row with a 5h reset countdown, opening a…
description.zh: 在输入框统计行常驻 GLM Coding Plan 额度 pill(含 5 小时窗口重置倒计时),点击展开双列卡片式详情面板:各窗口限额、重置时间、近 24 小时按模型 Token 用量与小时级 sparkline,支持插件一键自更新。

description.en: A macOS global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from any app and sends what you type, with an optional screenshot or window text, to a new or the last…
description.zh: macOS 全局热键，在任意应用里唤出一个小输入条，把输入内容连同可选的截图或窗口文字发到新会话或最近的会话。

description.en: Settings panel for global and per-workspace AGENTS.md, with identity and persona injection, runtime-context toggle, and result notifications.
description.zh: 设置面板管理全局与各工作区 AGENTS.md，支持身份与人设注入、运行时上下文开关和结果通知。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Edit the user-global AGENTS.md ($DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md) from the web settings panel.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 在网页设置面板中编辑用户全局的 AGENTS.md（$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md）。

description.en: ★ 11 │ Keep a shared cross-session todo list, hand tasks to a conversation and confirm agent-reported completion. The panel requires the DSH Web client.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 跨会话管理人和 Agent 共用的待办清单，一键交给对话继续处理，并由人确认完成。界面需使用 DSH Web 客户端。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll…
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover…
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

description.en: For the DSH Go phone app (https://go.dshtui.com): watches the quiz screen and pushes each answer as a heads-up notification, using an optional local answer bank.
description.zh: DSH Go 手机 App 专用插件（官网 https://go.dshtui.com）：盯住手机上的考试/答题页面，把每道题的答案弹成顶部通知，可选导入本地题库优先命中。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show the 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage windows of an OpenCode Go plan under the composer, with progress bars and reset countdowns. The key comes from the DSH credentials service and goes only to the usage endpoint.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框下方显示 OpenCode Go 套餐 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口，带进度条和重置倒计时。Key 来自 DSH 凭据服务，只发往用量接口。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Set token, estimated cost and elapsed-time caps for DSH goals and block continuation when a cap is reached, with a per-model breakdown. Price accuracy depends on configured models and rates; automatic currency detection queries the official DeepSeek balance endpoint. Requires Node >=22 and declares DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 DSH Goal 设置 token、估算费用和运行时长上限，超限阻止续跑，并按模型展示明细。费用准确度取决于模型与价格配置；自动币种识别会查询 DeepSeek 官方余额接口。需 Node >=22，声明兼容 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0。

description.en: Kifu-style context compression for long DSH sessions: each step folds new turns into a DAG (node = position, edge = attempted fix), injects only a ~417-token hot list (2000-edge fixture, L5 tier), and adds failure memory plus position-repetition detection. Each span is summarized exactly once, so what is retained does not decay with the number of compactions.
description.zh: 棋谱式上下文压缩：每步把新回合折进一张 DAG（节点=局面、边=试过的改法），只注入约 417 tokens 的热清单（2000 边合成夹具、L5 降级档）；带失败记忆与局面重复检测。一段历史只摘要一次，保留率不随压缩轮次衰减。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the…
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a…
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect Google Drive accounts in Settings, browse files in the right sidebar and drag them into the conversation. Uses Google OAuth with a local loopback callback; files and metadata come from the Google Drive API, and service-account setup can optionally use gcloud. Requires DSH >=0.2.0.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在设置中连接 Google Drive 账号，于右侧栏浏览文件并拖入对话。使用 Google OAuth（本机回环回调），文件与元数据来自 Google Drive API，服务账号配置可选用 gcloud。需 DSH >=0.2.0。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Search Google Scholar, citing papers and all versions through SerpAPI with three agent tools sharing one monthly quota. Requires your own SerpAPI key; queries are sent to serpapi.com. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 通过 SerpAPI 检索 Google Scholar、被引文献和全部版本，三个 Agent 工具共享月度配额。需自备 SerpAPI Key，检索词会发送到 serpapi.com。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive…
description.zh: 把本机 Gopeed 下载器接进 DSH 的 agent 工具：新建、查看、暂停、继续、删除下载任务，诊断或启动 Gopeed 进程，并通过 DSH 后台任务接收下载完成事件（空闲的 agent 会被唤醒）。进程诊断与启动仅支持 Windows，下载相关工具跨平台可用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Gotify notifications when DSH session turns end: a host and browser plugin bundle, configurable in the Settings UI.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话轮次结束时发送 Gotify 通知，可在设置页配置。

description.en: Image generation and editing for GPT Image, Gemini (Nano Banana) and Grok, with official, OpenAI-compatible, api.toolify-ai.com and custom HTTP providers.…
description.zh: 支持 GPT Image、Gemini（Nano Banana）和 Grok 的图片生成与编辑工具，支持官方接口、OpenAI 兼容接口、api.toolify-ai.com 与自定义 HTTP 供应商。支持文本生图、参考图编辑、画板标注、遮罩编辑与 Agent 多轮对话，图片和历史记录保存在本地。界面为上游…

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in…
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Draggable companion widget by Tokyo with Codex quota monitoring, manual executable discovery, and editable replies. Requires the Codex CLI (codex app-server)…
description.zh: Tokyo 的可拖动陪伴挂件，支持 Codex 额度监控、手动程序定位和可编辑回复。需安装 Codex CLI（codex app-server）并使用 ChatGPT 登录；API-key 登录不显示订阅额度。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version…
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert…
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers,…
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: ★ 25 │ A DeepSeek Harness plugin for graph-based goal management and kanban visualization.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 通过关系图与看板管理 Agent 目标。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and…
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions,…
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

description.en: Requirements interview before work starts: judges whether a request is clear, asks focused questions when it is not, in strict mode denies editing tools until…
description.zh: 开工前先做需求访谈：判定任务是否说清楚，没说清就分轮追问；strict 档位下用户未在对话中确认四段需求清单前，拦截编辑类工具；确认过的偏好写入两层记忆。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: Puts Grok Bot's own face in the DSH sidebar session list: each row's status dot becomes a living GrokBot avatar whose six motions read as idle, working,…
description.zh: 把 Grok Bot 本人那张脸装进 DSH 侧栏会话列表：每行的状态圆点变成会动的 GrokBot 头像，六种动作分别对应空闲、处理中、等待、已阻止、思考与完成——颜色标记项目，动作标记状态。

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search,…
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability…
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Requires at least one search API key (Grok, or any one of the supplementary sources). A grok-search-rs-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness with…
description.zh: 需至少配置一个搜索 API Key（Grok 或任一补充来源）。基于 grok-search-rs 的 DeepSeek Harness 搜索插件，提供可配置的来源回退、可视化设置、搜索日志回放和账户额度查询。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Use a SuperGrok or X Premium Grok Build subscription in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 的 Grok Build 订阅。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Summarize running, approval, completion and scheduled-task states on collapsed sidebar groups, with counts and hover details.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在收起的侧栏分组上汇总运行、审批、完成和定时任务状态，显示数量与悬停明细。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite…
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Detect and contain runaway symbol streams at the model boundary in DeepSeek Harness, with tooling to repair polluted artifacts and sessions.
description.zh: 在模型输出边界检测并拦截退化符号流，并提供修复被污染工件与会话的工具。

description.en: Deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims in DeepSeek Harness, reporting bounded verdicts, reasons, and evidence references.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成智能体主张证据审阅插件，通过确定性规则输出有限判定、理由与证据引用。

description.en: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and…
description.zh: 会话头部的「护航」面板：启停本机 dsh-guard 守护，显示扫描开关、守护心跳与上次扫描时间；做监控的 Python 守护需单独部署，插件通过 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 环境变量定位它的目录。守护默认路径是 Windows 上的 D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard，可用…

description.en: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree, Git panel (commit graph, push/pull, per-file revert), SSH hosts and a real PTY terminal on the left, while the official DSH conversation stays docked on the right so tool calls, file edits, approvals and session history keep working as you code. Built on a craft-first belief: write it by hand, understand every change, treat AI as an assistant and stay the first owner of your software.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 IDE 模式：点工作区「…」菜单一键把主面板变成 VS Code 风格工作台——左侧 Monaco 编辑器、文件树、Git 面板（提交图/推送/拉取/逐文件还原）、SSH 主机与真实 PTY 终端，右侧原样停靠官方 DSH 会话，写代码时工具调用、自动改文件、审批与会话历史照常可用。作者主张「古法编程」：亲手写、每个改动心中有数，AI 是助理，你是软件的第一责任人。

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree snapshots, click by control name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面操控：读无障碍树、按控件名点击、动作投递判定，以及可重复执行的任务文件。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and…
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window…
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7…

description.en: Bundles five skills — web slide decks, social card images, typeset web pages, Chinese de-AI editing (humanizer-zh) and a writing-voice profile — with the first three sharing one design system (magazine and Swiss themes, contrast-checked brand colours). Adds a sidebar page that lists your works with thumbnails, opens a new session with a draft that reuses a work's theme and layout, offers six content workflows, and collects the messages you sent in local dsh sessions as study material for the voice profile.
description.zh: 打包五个 skill：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、中文去 AI 味（humanizer-zh）和语气档案，前三个共用一套设计系统（杂志风与瑞士风主题、按对比度校验的品牌色）。侧栏页面列出你做过的作品和缩略图，「做同款」会在新会话里按这份作品的主题和版式填好草稿；提供六个内容生产工作流；把你在本机 dsh 会话里发过的消息整理成语气档案的学习素材。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings…
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Track your DeepSeek Harness coding time on Hackatime (WakaTime-compatible heartbeats).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 DSH 编码时长记录到 Hackatime，兼容 WakaTime 心跳协议。

description.en: ★ 51 │ Read Hacker News feeds, discussions, search results and user profiles through public APIs. Declared peers target DSH 0.1 prereleases.
description.zh: ★ 51 │ 通过公开 API 读取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论、搜索结果和用户资料；依赖声明面向 DSH 0.1 预发布系列。

description.en: Browses and plays the 6,454 videos Hacker News has recommended since 2007 inside a DSH panel, with a player, the HN discussion behind each pick, AI questions…
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里浏览并播放 Hacker News 二十年推荐的 6454 个技术视频，带播放器、每个视频背后的 HN 讨论、基于字幕的 AI 问答，以及随包发布的 6454 条中文标题。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/…
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full…

description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

description.en: ★ 5 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: lets text-only models receive pasted images and analyze them with a built-in OpenAI-compatible vision tool.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 让纯文本模型接收粘贴的图片，再调用兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉工具分析。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching…
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Adds a pixel-coordinate viewer to the sidebar image preview: hover coordinates, one adjustable dashed rectangle with start/end/size labels, edge snapping, and…
description.zh: 在侧栏图片预览中加入像素坐标查看器：悬浮读取坐标，用一个可移动/缩放的虚线选框标注起点、终点与宽高，越界自动吸附，缩放后仍按图片真实像素计算。

description.en: Search Wikimedia Commons and Openverse for real photos, download them, and verify provenance, magic bytes and dimensions before they reach your agent.
description.zh: 在 Wikimedia Commons 与 Openverse 搜索真实照片，下载后校验来源、魔数与尺寸，再交给 Agent 使用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Shows oversized images to the model at a readable high resolution by tiling them before admission.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将超大图片分块后提供给模型，保留可辨识的细节。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Zoom, browse, download, and annotate image regions in the DSH conversation viewer.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 为会话图片提供缩放、多图浏览、原图下载和区域标注。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and…
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations,…
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Register a packaged image-generation skill in DSH. CLI use needs Python, the OpenAI SDK, a configured image endpoint/key and any applicable service fees; prompts and edit images are sent to that endpoint.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH 中注册图像生成技能；需自行配置 Python、SDK、图像端点和密钥，提示词及编辑图片会上传并可能产生费用。

description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for…
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding…
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整（含裁切/留白预览）、标记键盘微调，结果以附件 + version 1 manifest 回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（显式选择供应商、providerId…

description.en: Requirement to a detailed design doc another AI can build from: the model fills a plan, the plugin validates it and emits a SPEC plus task cards, then…
description.zh: 需求 → 另一 AI 能直接开工的详细设计文档：模型填 plan，插件校验后产出 SPEC 与任务卡，再由独立评审与实现证据复核。需要 Python 3.11 及以上；它调用的 spec-graph 引擎已随包附带。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable,…
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: ★ 105 │ View DSH sessions, chat and approve individual actions from a phone. Remote access requires a separately secured relay; notifications, Web Push and GitHub starring are optional configured network actions.
description.zh: ★ 105 │ 在手机查看会话、聊天和逐次审批；远程访问需另配受保护的中继，可选通知、Web Push 和 GitHub 授权。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already…
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: Five skills for a reviewable engineering incident journal: record an event only when a counterfactual can be written, quiz yourself from the existing entries,…
description.zh: 五个技能维护一本可复习的工程事故日志：写不出反事实就不记，从已有条目出题自测，体检条目腐化，按出处收外部资料，并能在改目录名的同时改掉全库引用。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces…
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: ★ 219 │ Collect public-source industry and company evidence, map industry chains and draft research reports.
description.zh: ★ 219 │ 整理公开行业与公司证据，绘制产业链并编写研究报告。

description.en: Cross-domain search and A-share data for DSH: arXiv, Crossref, GitHub, Hacker News, Hugging Face, Product Hunt, plus stock quotes, klines and announcements.
description.zh: DSH 的跨领域信息与 A 股工具：arXiv、Crossref、GitHub、Hacker News、Hugging Face、Product Hunt，以及行情、走势与公告。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with…
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Request-side injection and jailbreak plugin for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites only the request copy sent to the model — system-prompt sections, fabricated turns,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的请求侧注入与破甲 / 越狱插件：只改写发给模型的请求副本（系统提示词系统段、构造回合、关键词与正则替换），不写入会话记录、不改动宿主文件；内置 unrestricted / nsfw / authority 三个预设，可把 dsh-purge…

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with six scenes: Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern…
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气、北冥和大肥鲸六个场景。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's…
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin: the model draws vector figures inline between reply paragraphs, so answers read as text, figure, text.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 让模型在回复段落之间插入矢量图示，结合文字解释内容。

description.en: DSH plugin: images dropped or pasted into the composer become @path reference chips at the caret, with a hover preview.
description.zh: 把拖入/粘贴进输入框的图片当文件处理：光标处插 @路径 胶囊、不占附件栏，输入框与已发送消息里都能悬停看原图。

description.en: Inline visualizer for DSH: the model loads a design contract first, then renders an SVG or a sandboxed HTML card in place inside the conversation, with…
description.zh: 对话内联可视化：模型先按需加载设计契约，再把 SVG 或沙箱 HTML 卡片就地渲染在对话里，支持深浅色令牌与源码/下载切换。

description.en: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
description.zh: 不另开窗口：用右栏内置浏览器，同一份 cookie、同一处登录，指针走到哪点到哪。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to…
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at…
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM…

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison…
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3…
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted…
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话改写成更清晰、以第一人称表达的版本，更容易得到好答案；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，缺的信息用占位符标出而不乱猜，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100),…
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid…

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compat…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a…
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: No longer updated: folded into dsh-lifeguard (last release 0.2.2). It checked a plugin against what was installed and flagged only real conflicts.
description.zh: 已停止更新：功能合并进 dsh-lifeguard（最后一版 0.2.2）。原来做的是：装插件前先跟已装的比一遍，真会撞上才说一句，先说原因再给动作，装还是照装。

description.en: Session install radar for DeepSeek Harness: lists what each conversation installed (pip, npm, git clones, winget-like installers) with size, path, creation…
description.zh: 会话安装雷达：按会话列出装了什么（pip、npm、git clone、winget 等），给出体积、安装位置、创建时间、用途、为什么装、卸载后果。含侧栏面板、10 个 agent 工具、临时目录时间戳扫描、进程命令行审计，以及仅限临时目录的两段式确认清理。另有可选的定时清理旧临时目录功能，默认关闭。

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count,…
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在…

description.en: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Sales workflow for individual insurance agents: P1-P5 product class matched against the client risk rating, a policy ledger that counts grace periods from the…
description.zh: 个险代理人的展业工作流：P1-P5 产品分级与客户风险等级匹配、按回执签收日推算犹豫期的保单台账、双录五环节校验，含 10 个工具与 5 个技能。

description.en: Windows only. Autonomous news briefing on user absence or continuous schedule, illustration & anime gallery with tagging and QQ bot search, plus native OS…
description.zh: 仅 Windows。离席或持续自主资讯全网检索与多端推送，精选二次元/色图插画画廊与点图搜图，以及会话状态全局系统原生桌面弹窗通知，支持投递至 DSH 会话与 IM 机器人。

description.en: Five-layer intent recognition pipeline (rules, pgvector retrieval, Jev scoring, fine-tuned arbitration, LLM fallback) with scenario management UI, PostgreSQL…
description.zh: 五层意图识别流水线（规则、pgvector 向量检索、Jev 概率精判、微调仲裁、LLM 兜底），带场景管理界面、PostgreSQL 存储与可分发 API 服务。

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call…
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first…
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不…

description.en: Adds a full-screen sea overlay that appears on a schedule (3 minutes every 120 minutes by default) and fades out on its own. The phase, sky colours and moon…
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个按间隔浮现的整屏海：默认每 120 分钟浮现 3 分钟，到点自己淡出。时段、天色与月相由宿主按城市表算出的太阳位置决定，所以光和真实的时间地点对得上。海面可以是 canvas 程序化绘制（按透视随机分布的水面斑块，近处大、远处细碎，带碎光、近岸白浪与白天掠过的海鸥；夜里有一轮月亮），也可以是自选目录里…

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A job-hunting workbench for profiles, target roles, resume analysis and rewriting, text and realtime voice mock interviews, and DOCX/PDF report exports. Text uses the host model; realtime voice uses the host's settings and credential service. All /zhijing routes go through connection.requestRejection(). Development preview pinned by Git commit; requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.9.0. MIT.

description.en: Click the chibi mascot and it reads the assistant reply aloud through your local IndexTTS 2.5 install. One character = one reference clip; a missing portrait…

description.en: LittleStar Meeting Room: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of werewolf. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明;…

description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config,…

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一模型池：会话粘性、能力感知映射与自动故障切换。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, eleven switchable school variants (including an opt-in full 61-star minor-star table that ships the placement verses alongside the chart), chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期), while LiuYao and MeiHua quote the received Zhouyi text in full (64 hexagram statements, 384 line statements plus 用九/用六, cross-checked across three editions with variant readings in brackets); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 1,062-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks; tarot ships a card-by-card library for all 78 cards (Rider-Waite-Smith base: English name, card-image description, core meaning and astrological correspondence, cross-checked against three published sources — court cards deliberately carry no zodiac because two published mappings conflict, and the chart says so). A classical-source library now backs the readings: 464 indexed citations from 66 classical works, with 584 verifiable quotations including all 120 Qiongtong Baojian pattern extracts; every quote is checked as a literal substring against a 341-page offline source snapshot, variant readings are kept side by side rather than harmonised, modern editorial notes are kept separate from the classical text, and the quotations with their plain-language glosses live only in a standalone citation index page instead of the browser chunks. Every result can carry a reproducible shadow-chart ID (same normalized inputs → same ID; version bumps auto-diff chart fields) plus optional step-by-step deduction traces (rule, inputs, result and source per layer). The browser client ships as a small first-screen entry plus per-tab engine chunks loaded on demand (first-screen gzip ≈ 90KB), while the offline page stays a single file. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding; charts open with a plain-language conclusion, one-click copy of an ask-ready prompt and saved birth charts, and an unknown birth hour falls back to a three-pillar chart instead of silently assuming midnight. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.
description.zh: 玄学命理排盘：十九套体系——八套排盘（八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、大六壬、奇门遁甲、合盘、塔罗）加十一套速查（黄历、农历互转、择日、称骨、小六壬、星座、生命数字、人生K线、风水、起名、十六型人格问卷），并可按所问之事生成可读报告；八字含交运日、岁运并临/伏吟反吟、通关、三书对照与杂气月取格/人元司权，紫微含 34 格局、十一类流派开关（含可显式开启的 61 颗杂曜全表，逐颗附安星诀与本盘落宫，诀文按多处独立辑本同表才收、同名异星不合并）、飞星串连与三方四正复合飞化，六爻与梅花含《周易》经文原文（64 卦辞、384 爻辞加用九用六，三本互校、异文括注），六爻含用神旺衰、全卦逐爻旺衰、伏神出伏与应期线索，风水含八宅与玄空飞星，起名含 1062 字库与 998 姓 / 82 复姓的姓氏库（逐姓康熙笔画）、五格剖象与音韵检查，塔罗含 78 张逐张牌义库（RWS 底本，牌面图像、核心义与占星对应经三处公开资料互核；宫廷牌两派映射冲突故不配星座并写明）；另建古籍引文库：66 种典籍、464 条索引（含《穷通宝鉴》120 格在内共 584 条可核验原文），逐句对照 341 页离线底本快照核为子串，异文并列不调和、今人按语与古籍正文分层，原文与白话只放在独立索引页、不进浏览器分块；每张结果可带可复现的影子盘短 ID（同参同 ID、跨版本自动字段 diff）与可选推导链（逐层规则、输入、结果、出处）；浏览器入口只带界面，按 tab 懒加载引擎分块（首屏 gzip 约 90KB），离线页仍是单文件；宿主面板与离线页共用同一套分组首屏（问一件事/看一个人/查日子），带最近用过与窄屏收纳，盘面先给一段人话结论、可一键复制问事提示与保存「我的命盘」，时辰未知改走三柱模式而不静默按子时；纯本地计算，默认不联网。npm 包内另附离线单文件页（命理排盘.html）：双击即开，十九个 tab 齐全，不用起服务、不用联网。

description.en: Android in the sidebar, driven by text instead of screenshots. 30 tools read the real UI tree, tap by text/id/ref, measure animation motion, and mirror the screen into the sidebar where you circle a spot and send it back with one sentence — the host ships the marked-up frame plus the controls inside the circle to the chat. Token cost is the point: a screen check is a 200-600 token text block, not a 1k+ token screenshot, and a warm check costs 100-200 ms of wall clock. Video is raw H.264 straight into WebCodecs — no transcoding — with p50 2 ms host-write to decoded frame over a 26 s run, one decoder, zero dropped frames; it falls back to MSE on its own and ?avc=0 forces the old path. Sound is one switch, off by default and remembered per serial, so the default path pays nothing; when on, audio rides its own socket (48 kHz stereo PCM, measured 22 s / 1047 packets / 0 loss) and closing the window reclaims it too. Nothing runs behind your back: closing the window stops capture at once, the viewer-less host decoder, recorder and device-side server are gone within 3 s, an idle channel is dropped after 90 s, and a request you closed is never reopened by itself. `adb_proc audit` settles who leaked what in one call. Bundled helpers, no extra services; needs adb and ffmpeg on the host, and the adb_ocr tool plus the OCR fallback for empty UI trees are macOS-only.
description.zh: 安卓真机，在右栏，用文字而不是截图驱动。30 个工具直接读界面树、按文字/id/ref 点按、量动效曲线；画面实时推到右栏，圈一处、写一句话，「发送」把带圈的画面连同圈内控件一起回到对话，不用你复述屏幕。省 token 是重点：看一次屏是一段 200–600 token 的文本，不是一张上千 token 的截图，热帧判断 100–200 ms 出结果。视频把 scrcpy 的原始 H.264 直接送进 WebCodecs，不转码：26 秒稳态实测宿主写出到解码帧 p50 2 ms、单解码器、丢帧 0；解不了自动退 MSE，`?avc=0` 可强制旧路径对比。声音只有一个开关，默认关、按序列号记住，默认路径不为它付任何代价；打开才多一条音频 socket（48 kHz 立体声 PCM，实测 22 秒 1047 包零丢），关窗一起回收。进程有边界：关窗当场停止采集，没观众的宿主解码器、录屏、设备端 server 3 秒内消失，闲置通道 90 秒自清，你亲手关掉的请求不会再自己弹回来；`adb_proc audit` 一次调用就能定案谁漏了进程。设备端辅助程序随包附带，不需要额外服务；宿主需要 adb 与 ffmpeg；adb_ocr 与文本树为空时的 OCR 兜底仅支持 macOS。

description.zh: ★ 22 │ 在编程会话中使用音乐播放功能。

description.en: Build presets for DSH Agents: package personas, prompts, skills, tools and runtime contexts into reusable capability bundles. Each task loads only the…
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 做「预设」：把**人设、提示词、技能、工具、运行时上下文**打包成一套可复用的能力组合。一个任务，只装它需要的东西。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and…

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write,…
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session;…
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits…
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no…
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Lets a phone reach the DeepSeek Harness desktop over a LAN address or a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with QR pairing, a live session feed, approval prompts and a…
description.zh: 让手机连上本机的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道二维码配对，实时消息列表与授权提醒，桌面悬浮球。局域网与 Cloudflare 隧道两个入口默认都开启；每台手机用自己的配对令牌。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from…
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm:…
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Operate n8n from DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, alias-addressed agent tools and a settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：多实例注册表、Agent 工具与设置页界面。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.

Optional separate generation reads that turn and consumes model quota; cards are saved in browser local storage.

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style…

description.zh: 按会话独立的极速交付模式，从输入框切换。新对话默认开启；对话运行期间拒绝切换，并在会话头部显示只读开/关徽标。一个开关驱动三个子系统：测试与构建命令断路器（不真正执行，直接返回成功回执）、按 SEARCH/REPLACE 冲突块原子写入的 apply_patch 工具（任一锚点未命中则整次回滚）、以及把终端输出脱水成一…

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized…
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves;…
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: A handwritten-journal salary timer on the DSH composer dock: set your monthly salary and work hours, then it shows how much you have earned today and this…
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 输入框下方的「牛马费用计时器」手帐小卡——填好到手月薪与上下班时间，实时显示今天已挣多少、本月累计多少，附带日薪/时薪/秒薪、下班进度条、下班后的无偿加班时长、工作日打卡点阵与状态章（打工中、午休中、已下班、无偿加班、休息日）。配置只存在页面 localStorage，不发网络请求。

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus…
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断…

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

description.en: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft;…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里提供 shell 风格的提示词历史：空输入框按 ↑ 取回上一条并继续向前翻，按 ↓ 向后回到空草稿；历史按工作区隔离、落盘并在重启后保留，且只记录人工输入，一旦手动输入或编辑草稿，↑/↓ 就恢复为正常的光标移动。另提供设置页可导出、导入和清空历史。

description.en: Conversation rewind for DSH: rewind in place to any earlier user message with one click or the /rewind and /undo commands, without a new branch or window, and…
description.zh: DSH 对话回退：一键就地回退到任意更早的用户消息（也可用 /rewind、/undo 命令），无需新建分支或切换窗口，并可一并还原被写类工具修改过的工作区文件；设置页按工作区列出最近的回退记录，可撤销最新一次回退的文件改动。基于 SiriLee/dsh-rewind 派生并独立维护，不能与上游同装（共用…

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot…
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline,…
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研…

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Save a message, turn or conversation to Obsidian, SiYuan, Joplin, Notion, Yuque or ima after preview. Configure each destination and its credentials; requires host Connection authentication. Same-title Obsidian notes use exclusive create with retry.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 预览后将单条消息、一轮或整个会话存入 Obsidian、思源、Joplin、Notion、语雀或 ima；需配置目标和凭据，并使用提供 Connection 认证的宿主。同名 Obsidian 笔记改为独占创建并重试。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and…
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Writes engineering decisions down the way DSH documents its own — every non-trivial change leaves a Markdown note under .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/…
description.zh: 像 DSH 记录自己的决定那样记录工程决策：每次非平凡改动在 .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ 下留一篇 Markdown，写清问题、决定、被否决的备选与后果，进 git、可以像代码一样 review。插件提供这套流程：note_search、note_read、note_write…

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.
description.zh: 任务跑完、等你审批或等你回答时，在屏幕角落弹出一张不抢焦点的通知卡。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DeepSeek Harness notification center: a tab-title whale status light (green = done / amber = pending) plus browser system notifications for completion and pending items, with 45 optional opencode sound effects and configurable volume.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用标签页状态灯、浏览器通知和提示音提醒任务完成或等待处理。

description.en: Configure automation Hooks for user and project scopes to run commands on session, tool, permission, and context-compaction events. Manage Hook authorization…
description.zh: 为用户和项目配置自动化 Hook，在会话、工具调用、权限请求和上下文压缩等事件发生时运行命令。Hook 授权需在“Hooks 设置”中手动管理。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Desktop, browser and webhook notifications when the agent finishes a turn, hits an error or waits for approval.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ Agent 完成回合、出错或等待审批时，通过桌面、浏览器或 Webhook 提醒你。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Send native desktop notifications or webhooks when tasks complete, fail or wait for confirmation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在任务完成、失败或等待确认时发送桌面原生通知或 Webhook 消息。

description.en: ★ 65 │ Send notifications through 28 outbound channels and handle approvals, questions and session control from your phone through 6 inbound channels.
description.zh: ★ 65 │ 通过 28 个出站渠道推送通知，并经 6 个入站渠道在手机上处理审批、回答提问和控制会话。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web…
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Plays a distinct chime when a turn finishes, is interrupted, fails, or asks a question, and can show a Windows toast for questions.
description.zh: 回合完成、中断、出错或 Agent 提问时播放可区分的提示音，提问时可弹 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound…
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one…
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: ★ 131 │ Show desktop or webhook notifications for task completion, questions and approvals.
description.zh: ★ 131 │ 为任务完成、提问和审批发送桌面或 Webhook 通知。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a…
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent…
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan…
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer.…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page…
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, using the official Notion MCP with no integration token.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在界面中通过 OAuth 连接官方 Notion MCP，无需另填集成令牌。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: Long-form fiction workflow for DSH: seven queryable bibles, edit-impact tracking, living relationship and plot maps, and a first-chapter tryout that picks your…
description.zh: 长篇小说创作工作流：七份可查账的设定库、改稿影响追踪、活的图谱，以及用试笔稿选写手的机制。它的 /novel-panel 路由（含保存、归档、对账）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们写入小说项目。

description.en: Plot decision gate for novel writing: seven beat_* tools register each node that changes the story into a decision point with 2-4 structured options; author…
description.zh: 小说写作的剧情决策闸：七个 beat_* 工具把会改变故事的节点登记成决策点、给出 2–4 个带结构化状态变化的走向；作者拍板写入全书账本（canon + 义务），后续章节的 compile/verify 都会继承；beat_gate 在没拍完前返回 pass:false，beat_compile…

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: ★ 44 │ Manage chapter drafting, setting constraints, repetition checks and whole-book reviews.
description.zh: ★ 44 │ 管理章节写作、设定约束、重复检查、批量起草与全书复核。

description.en: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires…
description.zh: 小说生成器：按时间线生成世界快照，通过世界快照和最近章节自动推演新章节。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: A novel reader docked in the DSH right sidebar for office slacking, with an AI companion that roasts whatever you just read alongside you - import your own TXT…
description.zh: 装在 DSH 右侧栏的小说阅读器，办公摸鱼专用，搭配 AI 伴读，跟大肥鱼一起吐槽文章、发表看法 - 自己的 TXT 三种方式导入，五套阅读主题，章节、进度与批注保存。伴读跟着你读到哪儿就评到哪儿，吐槽或捧场，可在毒舌、温柔、侦探、摆烂四种腔调中切换，节奏自己定，默认关闭。内置 434 本中文经典，包里只有 44…

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and…
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

description.en: ★ 29 │ Manage chapter references, narrative continuity, revision checks and writing materials.
description.zh: ★ 29 │ 管理章节参考、叙事连贯性、改稿检查与创作素材。

description.en: NovelAI image generation for DSH: `nai_image` (style presets, artist strings, per-model weight rewriting, token budget warnings, results rendered inline),…
description.zh: 把 NovelAI 生图接进 DSH：`nai_image`（画风预设、画师串、按模型自动转权重、token 预算提醒，出图直接内联显示）、`nai_status`、`nai_prompt`（build / check / guide 三个动作），外加带逐帧草稿预览的画室页面、独立 studio…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Check application structure and potential identity disclosures in document text and metadata using supplied rosters and rules.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据提供的名单和规则，核对基金申请结构及正文、文档属性中的潜在身份泄露。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Subscribe to one or more ntfy servers and channels and turn messages into Windows toast notifications. Supports an optional Bearer token; message content is displayed but never executed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 订阅一个或多个 ntfy 服务器与频道，把消息转换成 Windows 系统通知。支持可选 Bearer Token；只显示消息内容，不执行消息中的任何内容。

description.en: Connect any ACP-capable agent to DSH and use DSH as a single entry point for all conversations and tasks. Models, thinking levels and permission modes come from the agent itself; tool calls appear in the main chat, diffs are collected on a dedicated NTR page, and approval requests appear in the composer. Requires an ACP-capable agent CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 把任意支持 ACP 的 Agent 接进 DSH，用 DSH 一个入口管理所有会话和任务。模型、思考等级和权限模式由 Agent 自己提供；工具调用显示在主聊天区，diff 汇总到独立的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框。使用前需在本机安装支持 ACP 的 Agent 命令行工具。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP…
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing…
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits…

The settings route currently lacks authentication and can change exemptions and pause rules; use only in a trusted local environment. Requires Node >=22.5; automatic resume can start model work and incur charges.
