description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a…
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control…
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Paoding: an installer for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) orchestration mode, with host-aware role tool filtering and a visual configurator on the Web settings page.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 安装庖丁编排模式，在网页中配置角色，并按宿主环境筛选各角色可用工具。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Discourages unnecessary sequential tool calls by guiding the model to batch ready, independent calls, potentially reducing wait time, model round trips, and…
description.zh: 引导模型将已就绪且互不依赖的工具调用合批，减少不必要的串行调用；在运行时支持并行执行时，有望缩短等待时间、减少模型交互轮次及 token 消耗，不修改调度器。

description.en: ★ 91 │ dsh-passwords: a server-grade gateway that turns DeepSeek Harness into a multi-tenant platform — remote access + automatic HTTPS, per-subuser permissions & quotas, sandbox enforcement, first-run setup, SQLite auth with at-rest encryption, rate-limit and audit log (bilingual zh/en UI)
description.zh: ★ 91 │ 为远程访问配置登录、用户权限、配额、HTTPS 与审计日志。

description.en: Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long…
description.zh: 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：悬停看正文与出处，发送时按原位展开；其他插件写入的长文本同样接管。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged…
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with…
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file…
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them…
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing…
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing…
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: ★ 27 │ Pause before the next model request so the user can add instructions and continue manually.
description.zh: ★ 27 │ 在下一次模型请求前暂停，允许用户补充文字并手动继续。

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Pavement design methods as a judgement manual: 76 cards over 9 chapters on method selection, indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion and…
description.zh: 路面设计方法判据手册：9 章 76 张卡，覆盖方法选型、指标指派、参数口径、轴载换算与气候分区；第九章机场道面曾整章丢失，已由原 PDF 重扫恢复。

description.en: Asphalt pavement skid resistance: 76 cards over 12 chapters on friction calibers, water film and hydroplaning, texture parameters, tire-road contact and…
description.zh: 沥青路面抗滑：12 章 76 张卡，覆盖摩擦口径、水膜与滑水、纹理参数、胎路接触与养护决策，每条能力都带「什么时候别用」。

description.en: Pavement structural dynamics as a judgement manual: 59 cards over 8 chapters flagging which chapter name oversells its contents, which formulas break when…
description.zh: 路面结构动力学判据手册：8 章 59 张卡，指明哪章名不副实、哪些式子抄走就错、哪些数不能互引。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare a local payroll table against supplied social-insurance, housing-fund and tax parameters; lists differences and rules it could not check. Does not file reports. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按提供的社保、公积金和个税参数核对本地工资表，列出差异及无法执行的规则，不代申报。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Loopback HTTP bridge that lets a peer machine ping this PC and run shell commands, with an optional ssh reverse-tunnel supervisor.
description.zh: 本机回环 HTTP 桥：让对端机器 ping 并执行 shell 命令，可选 ssh 反向隧道看守。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry,…
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page…
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Reads local PDFs in the DSH sidebar — jump to any page and page through the whole document.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏里看本地 PDF：跳到任意一页，整本连着看。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Parse documents with MinerU cloud or self-hosted providers, using background jobs, cached results and shared requests.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 通过 MinerU 云端或自托管服务解析文档，支持后台任务、产物缓存和请求合并。

description.en: Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows PDF 翻译插件：由视觉模型识别并翻译正文、表格、图表和公式，输出中文 PDF 与 LaTeX 源码压缩包。需要自备支持图片输入的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that…
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state…
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33…

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target…
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

description.en: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half…
description.zh: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026…

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each…
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日…

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show DeepSeek peak and off-peak periods and remaining time above the composer, with themes and custom CSS.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框上方显示 DeepSeek 峰谷时段和剩余时间，支持主题和自定义 CSS。

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live…
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

description.en: Peer channels between conversations at the same level: user-granted, symmetric, with durable grants that survive a restart and burst messages merged into one…
description.zh: 平级对话之间的通道：经用户授权、对称，授权跨重启保留；忙时多条消息合并成一批按发送时间排序投递。

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime…
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill,…
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把…

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: ★ 100 │ Minimal Root-Orchestrator PTES pentesting plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 100 │ 按 PTES 渗透测试流程组织任务，提供主 Agent 统筹的编排预设。

description.en: An event-stream driven personality that grows over time, not a configurable character card or assistant. Evolved from ssamurias/dsh-fish and registers the same…
description.zh: 一个由事件流驱动、只能长大不能被设定的人格，而非可配置的角色卡或助手。由 ssamurias/dsh-fish 演进而来，注册同名工具（her_recall、growth_commit 等），因此不要与 dsh-fish 同装。

description.en: Performance optimization and smoothness enhancement for DSH Desktop (renderer-side only; host code untouched, no on-disk config): skips offscreen message…
description.zh: DSH 桌面端性能优化与流畅度增强（纯客户端：只改渲染进程、不改宿主代码、不落盘配置）：长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏不排帧、后台暂停定时器、媒体懒加载、会话列表节流、大会话文件预热，设置页显示实测省下的主线程时间。遇到卡顿、掉帧、打开大会话慢、后台吃 CPU 时先试它，也可以当作轻量加速与渲染优化工具。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM…
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS…
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: ★ 136 │ Define allow, deny and ask rules for tools, arguments, workspace paths and network targets.
description.zh: ★ 136 │ 按工具、参数、工作区路径与网络目标配置允许、拒绝和询问规则。

description.en: ★ 116 │ Import, switch and manage bundled or custom conversation personas.
description.zh: ★ 116 │ 导入、切换和管理内置或自定义会话人设。

description.en: Rewrites your composer draft in the voice of a chosen character card before it is sent, using the model the current session is already on, with an optional…
description.zh: 发送前把输入框草稿按所选角色卡的口吻改写，用当前会话正在使用的模型；可先审查再发送，并有一项本地检查会点名改写过程中丢掉的技术记号。

description.en: Switches the tone of DSH replies from Settings → 人格模式 or the /persona command (/persona catgirl, /persona off), effective from the next turn. Only the active…
description.zh: 在「设置 → 人格模式」或 /persona 命令（/persona catgirl、/persona off）里切换回复语气，下一轮对话生效。同一时刻只注入当前这一条（放在运行时上下文里，系统提示词只保留一条约 50 字的稳定策略），关闭时注入 0 字；只改语气，不改事实、代码与工程纪律。
按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。
description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and…
Three custom agent presets, one editable character card each, with three built-in personas out of the box; import SillyTavern character-card PNGs or…
description.zh: 三个自定义 agent 预设，每槽一张可编辑角色卡——开箱自带鲸鱼娘/病娇/小满三张预制人设，支持导入 SillyTavern 生态角色卡 PNG 或 md/txt/json 设定文档；设置页「角色卡」区块可取名、编辑、展示卡面图，保存后下一回合生效，无需重启。

description.en: Injects a persona into the system prompt and a past conversation into context, with a settings page and a conversation picker.
description.zh: 把人设正文注入系统提示词、把历史对话注入上下文，带设置页与对话选择器。

description.en: Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on…
description.zh: 在系统提示词之外，用选定人格转述每条助手汇报；内置四个预设，支持会话级开关，原文随时可查。

description.en: Switches the running session's persona and speaking style in place, via the composer's persona button or `/role`; each persona can bind its own on-screen…
description.zh: 用输入框的「人设」按钮或 `/role` 指令就地切换当前会话的人设与说话风格，每个人设可单独绑定屏幕吉祥物立绘；人设作为独立的 prompt section 追加在部署人设之后，不动工具与技能，切换人设后会在会话里声明一次。

description.en: ★ 115 │ Inspect token usage, costs and session state, and configure personal preferences.
description.zh: ★ 115 │ 集中查看 Token 用量、费用、会话状态并调整个人偏好。

description.en: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.
description.zh: 左侧切换供应商，右侧直接选择模型；悬停、聚焦或点击供应商即可切换右侧模型列表。

description.en: Inject a personal rules file into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with silent-step and repeated-action loop guards editable from the settings dialog.
description.zh: 把个性化规则文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示，并提供静默提醒与重复操作循环检测，可在设置弹窗中编辑。

description.en: ★ 6,190 │ A lazy blue fish living in DeepSeek Harness: plays with a Rubik's cube, snacks, naps, roams the desktop, tracks your balance wallet, and chats when idle.
description.zh: ★ 6,190 │ 在 DSH 中添加蓝色鱼形桌宠，会玩魔方、吃零食、打盹和聊天，并显示账户余额。

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting…
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的附属插件：给桌面上的鲸鱼娘套上二次元人格，让她的思考过程说中文、被点会回话，还会每天自己写一篇日记。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included…
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Track pet achievements from DSH tool/session events with local evidence. The ledger retains commands and output excerpts; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从 DSH 工具和会话事件记录宠物成就与本地证据。账本会保留命令及输出片段；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 76 │ A Live2D pet docked in the DSH interface: she follows the pointer, reacts to clicks and changes expressions with each session phase, with configurable motions, expressions and lines.
description.zh: ★ 76 │ 在 DSH 界面添加 Live2D 桌宠，随鼠标、点击和会话状态切换动作、表情与台词。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: ★ 64 │ Show session events through a sticker companion, status bubbles and a desktop window.
description.zh: ★ 64 │ 用贴纸角色、状态气泡与桌面浮窗反映会话事件。

description.en: Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: twelve hand-drawn sprites follow the live session state and swap instantly, with a tired slump after a…
description.zh: 美树沙耶香桌宠：把会话状态映射成十二张立绘并啪地直接切换——一轮对话跑完会累倒、连点十下会气炸、闲着会擦剑吹口哨；同类状态连着来她会换话变脸，每种状态每碰 5~8 次播一次语音，台词还配了专属录音。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Display a companion for each active conversation, with work-state animations, model colors and shared care. Download is about 184 MB. Native desktop companions require Windows DSH Desktop. Host routes use local Host/Origin or paired-device checks rather than Connection authentication; use in a trusted environment.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为每个活跃会话显示一只宠物，用动作和配色区分工作状态与模型，共享喂食、好感度和命名。下载约 184 MB，原生桌宠需 Windows DSH 桌面版；宿主接口采用本机 Host/Origin 或设备配对检查，仅建议在可信环境使用。

description.en: Local video understanding for agents: extracts keyframes adaptively based on motion and pauses, inspects any timestamp at full resolution, and aligns visuals…
description.zh: 让智能体看懂本地视频：根据画面运动与停顿自适应抽取关键帧，支持任意时间点全分辨率定点检视；自动从内嵌字幕或配置的语音转写（ASR）中提取台词并与画面时间轴对齐。需预装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe；无字幕视频要台词另需转写引擎（约 190 MB 本地 whisper 模型、云端 API Key…

description.en: ★ 3 │ Notify for approvals, questions, completed work and errors through desktop alerts, sounds, title markers and webhooks.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 通过桌面通知、声音、标题标记和 Webhook 提醒审批、提问、任务完成及错误。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision…
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Send tasks from your phone through an OpenTandem account. First QR action downloads and installs an external CLI/background Runner; paired or pending state resumes on Host restart. Author tested macOS with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2/0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 OpenTandem 账户从手机向本机发送任务。首次点二维码按钮会下载并安装外部 CLI/后台 Runner，已配对或待配对状态会随宿主重启续接；作者验证 macOS、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2/0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Control a paired Android phone from DeepSeek Harness: read the accessibility node tree, tap by text, type into fields, take screenshots, launch apps, and read…
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 控制已配对的 Android 手机：读取无障碍节点树、按文字点击、输入文字、截图、启动应用，还能读写手机上的文件；连接走加密 WebSocket。需要配套的 Android App（Android 11+；自 v0.0.45 起每个 Release…

description.en: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network,…
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop…

description.en: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
description.zh: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone or tablet into the DSH right sidebar over adb with mouse and keyboard control, keeping videos, clips and chats next to the desktop…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏通过 adb 投屏并反控安卓手机/平板，视频、短视频和聊天留在电脑上，在工位上不必再拿手机；声音转发需 Android 11+，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A DSH workbench for picking photos from local folders on macOS and Windows: local dedupe, filtering and grouping, AI grid triage and scoring with an…
description.zh: DSH 本机照片挑选工作台（macOS / Windows）：本地去重、过滤与分组，用你自备的图片输入模型做 AI 网格粗筛与评分（插件不内置模型、凭据或额度），并支持人工复核、校准与导出。

description.en: Interactive physics lab in the DSH sidebar — 24 parameter-driven animations (mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics) grouped by grade, each with a…
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的高中物理动态仿真实验室：24 个可调参数的互动模型（力学 / 电磁 / 光学 / 热学），按高一高二高三分组；每个模型配知识点讲解与跟随动画的分步解说、出题判分，其中 4 个电磁学模型支持拖动旋转的 3D 视角。纯客户端，解析式本地计算，不调模型、不联网、不上报数据。

description.en: ★ 16 │ Add Pi, Pi+ and Pi-IM agent modes with a trimmed tool set and Chinese system prompts; Pi+ enables the official apply_patch tool. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.9.
description.zh: ★ 16 │ 新增 Pi、Pi+ 与 Pi-IM 三种 Agent 模式，精简工具并使用中文系统提示词；Pi+ 开启官方 apply_patch。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.9。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Delegates coding tasks to a local Pi coding agent and shows each run as an inspectable DSH child session with reasoning, tool calls, token usage and duration; a returned session id continues the same Pi conversation. Pi runs with its own auth and permission model, not DSH approvals or sandbox. Needs Pi installed, DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node ^22.19.0 || >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把编码任务派给本机 Pi agent，每次运行都在 DSH 中生成可点开的子会话，包含思考、工具调用、token 用量与耗时；传回 session id 可在同一 Pi 上下文继续。Pi 使用自身的认证与权限模型，不受 DSH 审批和沙箱约束。需安装 Pi、DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node ^22.19.0 || >=24。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an…
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano…
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail…
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline,…
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the…
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏拼小拼豆的轻量小游戏，等模型回复的空档拼一张：12 个带引导豆的内置图案、16 色在 12/16/24 格板上自由拼、一句话让模型生成图纸、照片在本机转成图纸（不上传）、拼完熨烫存入最多 60 件的作品墙，并可导出 PNG。

description.en: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
description.zh: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

description.en: ★ 13 │ Collect pinned conversations from every workspace at the top of the sidebar, with rename, fork, archive and unarchive actions plus live activity dots. Uses DSH session state and browser localStorage; depends on sidebar DOM structure.
description.zh: ★ 13 │ 在侧栏顶部汇总各工作区的置顶会话，支持重命名、分叉、归档、取消归档，并显示实时活动状态点。使用 DSH 会话状态和浏览器 localStorage，依赖侧栏 DOM 结构。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be…
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click,…
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: Project document chain integrity check: stage order, completeness and amount parseability.
description.zh: 项目全流程文件链条核对：环节顺序、文件齐备与金额可解析。

description.en: A fixed-pixel office tower for DeepSeek Harness: every workspace is a floor and every session an office inside it. Lit windows mean work in progress, and…
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的所有会话画成一栋固定像素的办公楼：一层是一个工作区，一层里的每间办公室是一个会话；亮灯表示正在工作，点击楼层或角色可直接回到对应会话。

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a…
description.zh: 四套配色的像素风 DSH Web 皮肤（木屋/羊皮纸/暖阳/终端绿）；中文像素字体由插件自身的 host 路由发货；完全平面、无阴影。

description.en: Turn the Edifier Halo PixelBar desktop pixel display into a DSH tool: push short text, switch scenes, set screen color, ambient light and volume over HID, and…
description.zh: 把花再 Halo PixelBar 桌面像素屏变成 DSH 工具：经 HID 推短文字、切场景、设屏色、调氛围灯与音量，并可按需切回时钟。需 USB 连接设备；仅在 Windows 上验证；需要 Python 3.8+ 与 hidapi（pip install hidapi）。

description.en: Drive an Edifier Halo PixelBar — a 256x32 1-bit dot-matrix screen in a desktop speaker — from DSH over raw USB HID: push custom bitmaps, play GIF animations,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 里驱动花再 Halo PixelBar（桌面音箱上的 256×32 单色点阵屏）：通过裸 USB HID 推自定义位图、播放 GIF 动画、用精灵图渲染像素角色行走场景、推自绘文字，并带颜色校准表、硬件自检，以及 EQ / 音量 / 氛围灯 / 表情与场景控制；推送后还能自动切回时钟。

description.en: Bundled Pixiv skill backed by a Python CLI: search illustrations, manga and novels, browse daily/weekly/monthly/rookie/original/AI/R-18 rankings, look up…
description.zh: 内置 Pixiv 技能，由 Python 命令行脚本实现：搜索插画、漫画、小说，查看日榜/周榜/月榜/新人榜/原创榜/AI 榜/R-18 榜，查询作品、小说系列和画师详情，下载原图，多页作品合成 PDF、动图转 GIF、小说系列合并成 TXT；需要 Python 3.9 以上并装好 requests /…

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a…
description.zh: DSH 电商商品图生成：24 个提示词模块覆盖主图、详情图与广告图，支持参考图风格复刻、批量生成，以及作品库实时预览。

description.en: Composer toggle that shapes replies: conclusion first, inline quotes, no cross-turn references.
description.zh: 输入框「说人话」开关：结论先行、引用原文、去掉需要翻前文的表述。

description.en: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and…
description.zh: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be…
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard)…
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Inline annotations for DSH plan review: select plan text, comment on any passage, and send one structured review back to the agent.
description.zh: 给 DSH 计划评审加选区批注：选中计划原文、逐条写意见，一次性把结构化反馈发回给 agent。

description.en: After you approve a plan review, automatically close every plan tab of that session in the right sidebar, including tabs left by earlier revision rounds.

description.en: A tiny always-on floating tree of the DSH workspaces, conversations and subagents that are running, waiting on you or on a schedule — live running state, who…

description.en: Pre-install security gate: quarantines each plugin, skill and subagent bundle with install scripts disabled, scans it with Cisco Skill Scanner, SkillScan,…

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The…
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint…

Flutter debug APKs hot-reload on Dart save; plain APKs can turn Flutter off. Requires an existing APK, a running emulator, the Android SDK and scrcpy 3.3.3; verified on a Windows emulator.

description.en: Native Google Antigravity agents loader and subagent orchestration engine with model selection and Web UI settings integration. Loads agent definitions from…

description.en: Loads Google Antigravity rules from ~/.agents/rules and the workspace's .agents/rules into the system prompt: always-on rules in full, the rest as a catalog…

DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

description.en: Workspace artifact manager that sorts files into artifact, process, memory and material roles, with extra workspace roots, 12 file types, a year/month/day…

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer). v0.19 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.19.2 or newer (0.19.5 is latest). Settings, dashboard and composer chip keep working on both the legacy and the rc.2 host APIs.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。v0.16 把记忆图谱升级为可交互 3D 球面（Canvas 手绘、零依赖）：拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放、拖节点 3D 整理布局、双击空白重置、自动慢转（尊重减少动态效果）；悬停或点击节点即时高亮邻居（位移+时长点击阈值），配色随浅色/深色面板自适应。v0.17 新增图谱搜索（排序匹配，镜头飞到命中的节点并点亮邻居）、节点的「在 Finder 中显示 / 复制路径」（等待命令结果，失败自动复制路径兜底）、Windows 兼容（路径变量展开、CRLF 读写保留换行风格、explorer 参数与退出码处理、工作区大小写匹配），README 精简并加入真实截图。v0.18（issue #8）新增 boot 快照模式：session 在本会话固化 boot 块，会话中途写记忆不再让前缀缓存失效（最近动态改走独立的靠后 context 段），默认仍是 live；双击记忆节点改为在 DSH 右侧栏打开该文件（打不开时回退系统文件管理器）。v0.19 兼容 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2：agent 注册表优先 agents.roots()、缺失时回退 agents.list()，所有 agent/created 监听器都做了异常保护——rc.2 下未保护的抛错会让 agent 注册被拒、无法新建会话，因此 rc.2 用户必须升级到 0.19.2 或更新版本（最新 0.19.5）。设置面板、看板与输入框 chip 在老宿主与 rc.2 上均可工作。

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a…
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Improve the DSH Web shell on phones: narrow-screen layout fixes, iOS keyboard and viewport handling, and single-tap session switching. Client-only; remote access still uses DSH's own tokenized web address. No DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 优化手机上的 DSH Web 壳层：窄屏布局修正、iOS 键盘与视口处理、单击切换会话。仅前端插件，远程访问仍使用 DSH 自带的带令牌网址。未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API,…
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock,…
description.zh: 话分两头：把 AI 对话从「切来切去」变成「并排开火」——每个会话一枚原生小窗，贴着主对话随开随用；一键平铺所有窗口（顶对齐·同高·紧贴），最小化到带实时状态灯的底部停靠条（转圈=工作中·绿色=刚完成·黄色=待审批·灰色=空闲），真浏览器里还能把会话弹出成独立浏览器窗口。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip,…
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are…
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review…
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL…
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable…
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls…
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice…
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes…
description.zh: 离线小说阅读器：把 .txt 与 .epub 导入右侧栏，在输入框上方用一个可缩放大小的速览窗显示正在读的章节，每本书都从关闭时的段落与段内位置继续。

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its…
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status,…
description.zh: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage beside the composer: the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows each as a small ring with the used percentage (amber at 70%,…
description.zh: 在输入框旁边常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐用量：5 小时滚动、每周、每月三个窗口各一个圆环与已用百分比（70% 变黄、90% 变红）；点击整条弹出详情卡，含每个窗口的额度进度条、重置倒计时与刷新按钮，不点击时不会在对话上悬浮任何东西。API Key 只留在 Host 进程里，不进入浏览器。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the…
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed…
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current…
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with…
description.zh: 本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。

description.en: Two columns for the dsh Plugins page, Minecraft resource-pack style: the left column holds the packs running together, the right holds packs that are installed…
description.zh: 在 dsh 插件页加「插件包」标签：左栏是正在一起用的包、右栏是装好但未启用的，支持箭头或拖拽在两栏间搬包、自定义标签、搜索、范围筛选、批量启停与撤销。标签与中文名存在 DSH_HOME 下的 packs.json 里而不是浏览器存储，换浏览器或清站点数据都不丢。

description.en: Connects Penpot to DSH across two independent channels with 9 tools: 5 MCP tools (execute_code, high_level_overview, api_info, export_shape, import_image), 2…
description.zh: 把 Penpot 接进 DSH，提供两条独立通道与 9 个工具：5 个 MCP 工具（execute_code、high_level_overview、api_info、export_shape、import_image）、2 个免浏览器的 REST 读写工具（penpot_read 与…

description.en: ★ 0 │ A 25/5/15-minute focus timer beneath the composer, with automatic breaks, a completion sound and browser-local saved state.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框下方显示 25/5/15 分钟番茄钟，自动切换专注与休息阶段，带提示音并在浏览器本地保存状态。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots…
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set…
description.zh: 打包 PrismSearch MCP 服务与配套 Agent Skill。网页搜索默认使用 Bing 和百度，无需账号或 API Key；设置 API Key 后可用 Google、Brave，在配置中启用后可用 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、360、Yandex；支持引擎自动回退与聚合模式。另提供图片搜索、微信公众号文…

description.en: PromptPolish is an icon-only prompt optimizer beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector: it rewrites the current draft with the active session model and DSH…
description.zh: PromptPolish 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器左侧提供图标式提示词优化：用当前会话模型与 DSH 额度重写草稿，无需 API Key、不自动发送，并带草稿变化保护。

description.en: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1…
description.zh: 提示词精灵：住在 DSH 右下角的小宠物，每小时送你一条 OpenAI / Anthropic 官方提示词——EN 模板逐字可复制、中文 1:1 翻译、模型个性化「为什么值得抄」，9 套皮肤随便换。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Route the pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows, with status, diagnostics and portable installation controls.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 在 Windows 上把 pwsh 工具路由到 PowerShell 7，并提供状态、诊断和便携安装入口。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏放一排可自定义的快捷语按钮：点一下发送「请继续」等快捷语，把卡住的 agent 一键叫醒，且不覆盖你写了一半的草稿。

description.en: ★ 21 │ Creative branching canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: ★ 21 │ 在树状创意画布中生成、对比和迭代多个可交互方案。

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in…
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into…
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons…
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits…
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire…
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Exposes this machine's DSH web GUI to a chosen CIDR range, such as Tailscale, on DSH 0.2.1+. It can require an optional numeric access code and provides a phone layout that applies only to remote pages.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 将网页界面开放给指定网段，可设置数字访问码，并为远程页面提供手机布局。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard…
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows only, dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own,…
description.zh: 给 dsh Web GUI 的悬浮重启按钮（仅 Windows，需 dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1）：拖动改位置、点击确认后一键重启应用与 Host，可中途取消、超时会自动收手并说明原因；图标（4 个自带矢量图或上传图片）、底色、位置锁定都在设置里改。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop app that keeps the window position, size, maximized state and display, with an optional resume of the sessions the…
description.zh: DSH 桌面版一键重启：保留窗口位置、大小、最大化状态与所在显示器，可选在重启后自动续上被打断的会话（不只你当前打开的那个）。入口是侧栏底部账号行右侧的图标按钮，另有 /restart-desktop 斜杠命令；账号行认不出来时自动回落到 sidebar.footer.action 座位，按钮不会凭空消失。仅支持…

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file…
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Local-first resume warehouse for DeepSeek Harness: package your work into reusable bullets, import an existing resume into a template, analyse a job…
description.zh: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的表述、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。应用本体随 npm 包发布（server/、web/、skills/、scripts/、requirements.txt，无需 clone…

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how…
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config…
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Discover DSH plugins on GitHub, inspect trust and compatibility evidence, and install through the official installer.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从 GitHub 发现 DSH 插件，检查可信度与兼容性证据，再通过官方安装器安装。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Capture, OCR and control Windows background windows through a bundled Rust engine. Windows x64 only; declares DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2 and Node.js ^22.19 or >=24. Grants screen capture, mouse and keyboard capabilities.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过随包 Rust 引擎截取、识别和操控 Windows 后台窗口，提供鼠标与键盘工具。仅限 Windows x64，声明适配 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.2，需 Node.js ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: A macOS screenshot button in the composer tool row: the scissors split button runs the native screencapture marquee — optionally hiding the Harness window…
description.zh: macOS 输入框工具栏截图按钮：剪刀分体按钮调起系统原生 screencapture 框选（右侧下拉可先隐藏 Harness 窗口），截图自动进剪贴板并附成输入框草稿；会先检查屏幕录制授权，未授权时提示去设置，而不是返回一张只有壁纸的图。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Review dependency advisories and static behavior evidence; automatic disabling requires a reviewed malicious finding.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 检查依赖漏洞和插件行为证据，只有审核确认恶意行为后才自动停用插件。

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Preview and move selected session workspace files to a local trash when deleting a session; files can be restored. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 删除会话时预览并将选中的工作区文件移入本地回收站，支持恢复。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0、Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Search session messages with Chinese-friendly substring matching, jump to highlighted results and move between matches.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 按字词搜索会话正文，支持中文短词匹配、结果定位高亮和命中跳转。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode…
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good…
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: ★ 4 │ View a session’s plugins and skills from its header, and enable or disable installed bundles and configured MCP servers in the current profile. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在会话标题栏查看当前会话的插件和技能，并启停当前 profile 中的插件包与 MCP 服务。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0。

description.en: Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.
description.zh: 本机全部会话的全文检索：sessiongraph 跨工作区查找对话，中文两字词也能命中，sessiongraph_index 负责建索引。

description.en: Sessivra: drag sessions into resizable split views, insert native @ references into drafts, exchange linked replies and review delegated work before queued…
description.zh: Sessivra：拖拽会话自由分屏、调宽，拖入草稿插入原生 @ 引用；支持关联回复、共享裁决、验收后继续排队任务及会话树。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-sessivra。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Encode a plugin set as a share code or QR code that others can import and install item by item.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 把插件组合生成分享码或二维码，供他人导入后逐项安装。

description.en: Browse, sort, group, toggle and batch-update every DSH plugin you already installed — with groups, filters and resumable updates.
description.zh: 已安装 DSH 插件的书架：按名称/安装时间/大小排序，自由分组与一键启停，批量检查并可断点续装的自动更新。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: Keeps e-commerce merchant logins in one place: one isolated Chrome or ego lite browser profile per shop for Pinduoduo, Taobao/Tmall, Douyin, JD and 1688, so…
description.zh: 把拼多多、淘宝/天猫、抖音、京东、1688 的商家店铺登录态集中管起来：一店一份隔离的 Chrome / ego lite 浏览器档案，上架与采集脚本复用同一份登录态；支持静默与定时检测、掉线自动代填、按「平台→采集域→指标」目录执行定时采集作业，以及只部署经校验 commit 的自更新。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Shows the DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer, just above the account entry.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧边栏底部、账户入口上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers.…
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md…

description.en: Reskin the whole DSH interface with colour themes, illustration wallpapers, custom cursors and a desktop pet.
description.zh: 给整个 DSH 界面换肤：配色主题、插画壁纸、自定义光标与桌面桌宠。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation…
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Guard DSH tool calls against foreground waits, blocking wait tools, polling and interactive commands, with configurable budgets and background-task guidance.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 限制 Agent 的前台等待、阻塞等待工具、轮询及交互式命令，支持配置等待预算和规则，并提示使用后台任务。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: An upgrade assistant for DSH plugins. Checks which installed plugins have newer versions, then upgrades them in one click or on a schedule — taking a snapshot…
description.zh: DSH 插件的升级助手。自动检查已装插件哪些有新版本，可一键全部升级或定时自动升级；每次升级前自动打快照，装失败自动回滚到升级前，不会把环境弄坏。也能体检：列出插件冲突、兼容性未声明、依赖缺失，并给出检查优先级。支持按补丁/次版本/主版本三档控制自动升级范围，可排除不想动的插件。所有操作都能回退到任意历史快照。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool…
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a…
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Compose two skill contracts into a traceable, unverified draft with declared gaps and preserved constraints; the composition engine runs locally with no model…
description.zh: 把两个技能契约本地组合成可追溯的未验证草案，列出缺口并保留双方约束；组合引擎在本机运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and…
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of…
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked,…
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed…
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria,…
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。
DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。
description.en: Appearance suite for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, startup authentication sequence, and a sidebar toggle for…
Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. The same library doubles as an appearance theme behind the interface, and…
description.zh: 全屏开机动画，盖住加载页直到应用就绪再淡出。同一套素材还能当外观主题铺在界面后面，另有桌面宠物浮在屏幕上自己活动。插件内置多套视频、壁纸、语音与宠物，也支持上传自己的文件进行自定义。

description.en: ★ 0 │ General usage stats for DeepSeek Harness: throughput, tokens, cost, tool calls, and activity, charted in the Web UI. A TypeScript superset of dsh-plugin-tokspeed.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用图表展示吞吐量、Token、费用、工具调用和活跃情况，扩展自 dsh-plugin-tokspeed。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Group sessions by decisions, running work, completed unread and recent activity, with a floating board and inline answers for supported questions. Requires Node >=20; no explicit DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按待决策、执行中、完成未读和近期记录分类展示会话，提供悬浮看板，并支持直接回答部分问题。需 Node >=20；未显式声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Turns a stated rule into a checkable intake card and writes it into the right AGENTS.md, and keeps project plans, a rule ledger, project records, handoffs, a…
description.zh: 把一句话的要求做成可核对的规则卡并写进对应的 AGENTS.md，同时统管项目档案、计划、交接、改动账本与时间线。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall with colour-coded notes, checklists, folding, a trash drawer that restores deleted notes, drag and resize, and five sticky_wall_*…
description.zh: 侧栏便签墙：彩色便签、待办勾选、折叠、可恢复的回收站抽屉、拖拽与改尺寸，并给模型 5 个 sticky_wall_* 工具从对话里记事和恢复。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Subagent Director: choose an LLM provider/model for each subagent (call args > role binding > plugin default > inherit parent) and plan main-agent/subagent responsibilities with role templates, plus a settings UI.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 为不同子 Agent 指定供应商、模型和角色模板，按调用参数或默认规则分配任务。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and…
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: ★ 602 │ Use ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, GitHub Copilot and Google Antigravity accounts as DSH model providers, with login, multiple accounts and usage controls. Tokens are stored locally; available models and quotas depend on the account.
description.zh: ★ 602 │ 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok、GitHub Copilot 和 Google Antigravity 账号接入 DSH，支持登录、多账号及用量管理。令牌保存在本机，可用模型和额度取决于账号。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven…
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进…

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state…
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs…
description.zh: 在侧边栏面板里一键启停已安装插件，按来源分组（官方自带、市场安装、本地导入），标出需要重启 Host 才生效的改动，并在「发现」页一键安装精选插件。

description.en: A white-box rule workbench for DeepSeek Harness: turn plain-language rules into readable, auditable rule chains executed by a deterministic 171-atom…
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 把大白话业务规则转成可读、可导出的规则链，再由 171 原子前向链引擎确定性执行；业务数据留在本机，生成规则时只发送字段名与规则文本，附完整逻辑库/数据库工作台。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows…
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in…
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with…
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Type /telleru in a conversation and an AI teacher writes and talks on a right-hand whiteboard. Routes go through the host connection.fetch API. Optional TellerU token and Doubao speech key stay in plugin settings. License is the bundled Terms of Use (free to install and use; modification and redistribution require permission). About 20 MB unpacked (app, fonts). Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 and Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在对话中输入 /telleru，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲。接口走宿主 connection.fetch。可选的 TellerU 令牌和豆包语音密钥保存在插件设置中。许可为随包使用条款（可免费安装使用，修改与再分发需书面许可）。解压约 20 MB（含应用与字体）。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3、Node >=22.19。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the…
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm…

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.

description.en: ★ 33 │ Layered memory that captures conversations, extracts facts, consolidates scenes and distills a profile, then recalls what is relevant before each model step. The pipeline is adapted from TencentDB Agent Memory.
description.zh: ★ 33 │ 分层蒸馏记忆：自动记录对话、抽取原子记忆、整合场景并提炼画像，在每次模型调用前召回相关内容。管线设计移植自 TencentDB Agent Memory。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then…
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，…

description.en: Redacts secrets, cookies and personal data in every model request at the host process undici dispatcher and restores the placeholders in the reply, so one…
description.zh: 在宿主进程的 undici dispatcher 上拦截所有发往模型的请求：密钥、Cookie 与个人信息换成占位符，回复里再还原，一处拦截覆盖所有 provider（含插件自带的 adapter）；按 kind 可选 mask / warn / block、可换成同形的假 key，记录按天落盘并带统计卡。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Backs up a DSH profile's text configuration to an unlisted secret GitHub Gist, and syncs it back on another machine: a settings page with three buttons (status…
description.zh: 把本机 DSH profile 的文本配置备份到不公开列出的 secret GitHub Gist，并在另一台机器上同步回来：设置页只有三个按钮（状态／上传／同步），另有 config_backup 工具；恢复是合并式的、可撤销；凭据库、二进制文件、锁文件与本机用量计数不进入备份，并在界面上逐项列明。需要带 gist…

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar, folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. Five headline numbers (tokens with a small trend and the change against the previous period, spend, longest task, the active-day streak with your best, today's cache hit rate), a 12-month activity grid in daily / weekly / running-total views, a model-family chart by day, week or month as stacked columns or a share pie (version and tier stay apart, and vendor-specific ids collapse correctly), a token-stats ring chart of where the tokens went (system prompt, tool definitions, user messages, injected context, skills, tool calls, reasoning, answers), tokens and spend per project with the subagent share, and a per-provider split with each route's own hit rate and spend. A range switch in the header (today, this week, this month, all time or custom dates) drives the token and spend numbers, the token stats, the projects and the providers, and the selected range exports as CSV or JSON. Spend is priced at bundled list prices (peak and off-peak hours for DeepSeek direct); each provider can be set to list price, a discount, a monthly plan or not counted, stored only on this machine. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from npm for the in-panel update button - no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页，数据全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来。包括五个核心数字（用量带小趋势与环比、花费、最长任务用时、连续活跃天数及最长纪录、今日缓存命中率）、近 12 个月活动图（每天 / 每周 / 累计三档）、按日 / 周 / 月分组的模型家族图（堆叠柱看用量、饼图看占比，版本与档位分开，不同供应商写法会正确归并）、按系统提示词 / 工具定义 / 用户消息 / 注入内容 / 技能注入 / 工具调用 / 模型思考 / 模型回复拆分的 Token 统计环形图、按工作目录拆分用量与花费并标出子代理占比的项目，以及带各自命中率与花费的供应商分类。页头的时间范围开关（本日 / 本周 / 本月 / 累计 / 自定义日期）驱动用量与花费数字、Token 统计、项目和供应商分类，所选范围可导出 CSV 或 JSON。花费按内置的官方价折算（直连 DeepSeek 分高峰、空闲时段），每家供应商可设成官方价、倍率、包月或不计入，设置只存在本机。唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset…
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is…
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next…
description.zh: 统计「只调用工具、没有向用户输出文字」的助手轮数，在下一次模型请求的边界把一条简短的过程汇报提醒作为可见的用户消息插入，让长时间沉默的工具循环先汇报已完成的工作再继续。设置页可调整沉默阈值（默认 10）、提醒文案、文案语言（en / zh-CN / zh-TW）、是否每再积累一个阈值就再次提醒、是否统计子代理会话，以及…

description.en: Host-side progress checkpoints for long DSH tasks. After N minutes or M tool calls the model is nudged to post a one-line progress note and keep working, so…
description.zh: DSH 长任务进度检查点——到点由宿主侧提示模型一边干活一边补一行进度，跑偏能及时纠正；汇报间隔与步数兜底都能在设置页里调。

description.en: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session…
description.zh: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an…
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: ★ 91 │ Analyze the workspace, explain its architecture, keep decisions and TODOs, and restore project context in later sessions, with optional hybrid retrieval.
description.zh: ★ 91 │ 分析当前工作区、讲解项目架构、保存开发决策和待办，并在后续会话中恢复项目上下文，可选混合检索。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Keep project-isolated engineering notes and reviewable project skills under .dsh/project-evolution, grounded in the current Git snapshot. execFile is used only for fixed git status commands. Git pin, no npm package. Requires Node >=22. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把项目隔离的工程经验与可审阅的项目技能放在 .dsh/project-evolution，并对照当前 Git 快照。execFile 只用于固定的 git 状态命令。以 Git 固定提交收录，没有 npm 包。需 Node >=22。MIT 许可。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Explain the consequences of extra-permission requests in full-access mode, with confidence and inspection scope.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在完全权限下分析额外授权请求的影响，并标注置信度与已检查范围。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and…
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Project board, task schedule (gantt) and project memory: sessions opened from a card auto-load the latest project STATE; persisting progress without losing…
description.zh: 项目看板 + 任务日程（甘特图）+ 项目记忆：从卡片打开的会话自动带上项目最新记忆；一句话落盘不丢事实需要 python3，Windows 上不可用。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they…
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry`…

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under…
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: Project workspaces for multi-session collaboration, conversation handoffs, searchable chat records, and editable shared memory; automatic memory curation and…
description.zh: 为跨会话协作提供项目空间、会话接力、可查询的聊天记录与可编辑的共享记忆；自动记忆整理与接力判断需在插件配置里分别指定 memoryModel 与 sessionManagerModel 两个后台模型。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only…
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: ★ 153 │ Manage preset and custom prompt templates and insert them into the composer.
description.zh: ★ 153 │ 管理预设和自定义模板，一键插入当前输入框。
