description.en: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
description.zh: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves…
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: Pins the first prompt of the current session in a scroll-proof bar above the conversation: one-click copy, a panel listing every prompt you sent (click a row…
description.zh: 把当前会话的第一条提问常驻在对话区上方，滚动也不消失：一键复制，面板列出本会话发过的全部提问（点某一行直接跳到那条消息，够不着会自动往前翻页），另有十套外观可在面板里即选即换（含四套亮色）。

description.en: DSH prompt-cache health guard and cost coach: install from npm as dsh-prompt-cache-guard (not the unrelated dsh-cache-guard package). cache_guard_health…
description.zh: DSH 提示缓存健康度守卫与省钱教练：npm 包名是 dsh-prompt-cache-guard（与无关的 dsh-cache-guard 不是同一个包）。cache_guard_health 工具给出绿/黄/红健康度、一行干预建议与 PTC 切换提示，cache_guard_config 读写开关与灵敏度。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the…
description.zh: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

description.en: Adds a prompt-refine button to the DSH composer and, when auto mode is on, refines the prompt before the agent starts by rewriting the text with recent session…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加「提示词优化」按钮；开启自动模式后，在助手开始执行前先用旁路模型结合最近会话上下文改写提示词，无法确定改写方式时先用原生提问卡片确认，各阶段以命令卡片在主对话中播报，分析失败时按原文继续。

description.en: ★ 242 │ Prompt method cards, local insertions and rewrite previews. AI assistance uses your configured model and may incur API charges. Requires Node.js 24+ and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2–rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 242 │ 提供提示词方法卡、局部补句与改写对照。AI 辅助使用已配置模型，可能产生 API 费用；需 Node.js 24+、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 至 rc.5。

description.en: ★ 6 │ Preview a rewritten draft with the current or a chosen model, optionally using recent conversation context. Uses model tokens; choose a result to apply it, then send it yourself.
description.zh: ★ 6 │ 用当前或指定模型打磨草稿，可参考近期对话，预览后点「用这版」才写回输入框。会消耗模型额度，最终发送由你操作。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of…
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without…
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows /…
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，…

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning…
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON…
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model…
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional…
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown…
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Prompt optimizer inside the DSH composer. One click rewrites the current draft with the model you already selected: it classifies the scenario (paper / agent…
description.zh: DSH 输入框内的提示词优化器。点一下就用当前选中的模型就地改写草稿：自动识别场景（论文 / 派活 / 日常 / 英文），弹出三自检诊断面板（验收能否机器判定？缺信息还是缺能力？在抬深度还是扩范围？）， 并可手动钉住场景。改写结果直接替换输入框草稿，不新增对话轮次。

description.en: Multi-select system-prompt picker behind one bolt icon in the composer: check saved rows to inject in order, each scoped to main agent, sub-agents or both;…
description.zh: 输入框工具栏一枚闪电图标后的系统提示词多选器：勾选保存的行按序注入，每行可设作用域（仅主 agent／仅子 agent／全部）；所有行（含内置「火力全开」）均可编辑和删除，「全清」只取消全部勾选、不删除任何条目。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Predicts your next message after each reply and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab accepts, Alt+→ accepts piece by piece, ↻ suggests another and Esc dismisses. Uses the session model by default and sends only recent conversation text.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 每轮回复结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色提示文字显示在输入框中：Tab 采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。默认使用当前会话的模型，只发送最近的对话文本。

description.en: A ✨ button left of the send button: reads the draft and recent turns, asks the configured model for three suggestions each pairing an issue with a patch, lets…
description.zh: 发送按钮左侧的 ✨ 按钮：读取草稿与最近若干轮对话，向已配置的模型要三条建议（每条都是「问题 + 改法」），可逐条勾选并实时预览合并后的提示词，结果写回输入框但不发送。

description.en: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个「重铸」按钮，把当前草稿就地改写成更精准的提示词——整段替换只占一步撤销，可一键恢复原文，也可中途取消。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Rewrite a composer draft with the current session model, preview the streamed result, then apply or undo it. Supports plain, sections and role-task-goal formats; model calls consume tokens. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0 and Node >=20.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 调用当前会话模型改写输入草稿，流式预览后手动应用或撤销，支持纯文本、分段和角色·任务·目标格式；模型调用消耗 token。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0、Node >=20。

description.en: ★ 270 │ Rewrite a composer draft before sending with the current or a chosen model. Can include recent context and optional images; consumes model tokens and leaves the final edit and send to you.
description.zh: ★ 270 │ 使用当前或指定模型，在发送前原地改写输入框草稿，可参考近期上下文并按需带入图片。会消耗模型额度，改写后由你编辑和发送。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词。

description.en: Keeps frequently used prompts in the DSH composer, with insert, replace, variables and a trash.
description.zh: 把常用提示词存进 DSH 输入框工具行：可插入、可整框替换，带变量与回收站。

description.en: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer…
description.zh: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's…
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

description.en: Translates user prompts before sending and translates model reasoning and replies back into the user's language via translation APIs or configured DSH models,…
description.zh: 通过翻译 API 或 DSH 已配置的模型，在发送前翻译用户提示词，并将模型思考文本和回答译回用户语言，提供独立内容开关和输入框快捷菜单。

description.en: Composer prompt library: reusable global and per-project prompts are stored as Markdown files and appended to the draft on click or @ mention; the global…
description.zh: 输入框常用提示词库：全局与项目两层的 Markdown 提示词，点一下或 @ 触发追加进草稿、不覆盖已写内容；全局库装好即用，项目库需在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里给该插件配 config.root 后才会出现。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Translate supported DSH prompts, edit them per profile and inspect exact-version matching while retaining tool and parameter names.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按当前配置翻译和编辑 DSH 提示词，检查版本匹配，并保留工具名与参数名。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Structure exam mathematics problems, check candidate solutions and estimate rubric scores. Results are not formal proofs or authoritative grading; requires Node >=22.19.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按考试要求组织数学题、核对候选解答并预测步骤分；结果不是形式化证明或权威评分，需要 Node >=22.19。

description.en: Drives Proteus 8/9 interactive simulation from the agent through eleven proteus_* tools: connect, simulation start/stop/status, probe readings, a project save…
description.zh: 让 Agent 通过 11 个 proteus_* 工具控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真：连接、仿真启停与状态、探针读数、会校验文件哈希与 mtime 确已变化的工程保存、纯本地计算的布局建议；本机注册了 Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM…

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Inspect WorkBuddy, WorkBuddy AI and ZCode CLI provider setup with observed, inferred and unavailable evidence. Basic checks are offline; optional connection checks can start provider diagnostic processes. Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 只读检查 WorkBuddy、WorkBuddy AI、ZCode CLI 的连接配置，区分观测、推断与未知。基础检查离线，可选连接检查会启动提供商诊断进程；需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adds a badge to the composer toolbar showing whether the selected DeepSeek model (official API, including the 2026 holiday table, or OpenCode Go's DeepSeek models) is currently billed at peak or off-peak rates; hover for per-million-token prices, time to the next switch and the full schedule. Hidden for flat-rate providers; web only, DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框工具栏显示峰谷徽章，提示当前所选 DeepSeek 模型（官方 API，含 2026 年节假日表，或 OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek 模型）是否按高峰价计费；悬停可看每百万 token 峰谷单价、距下次切换的时间与完整时段规则。单一价 provider 自动隐藏；仅 Web，需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
description.zh: 在设置里为每个已启用的 provider 单独配置正向代理（HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5），未配置的 provider 与其它流量保持直连。

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

description.en: Shows which provider the composer's currently selected model belongs to, and stays silent for providers another plugin already presents.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框展示当前所选模型所属的供应商；已被其他插件接管的供应商自动让位，不重复显示。

description.en: DSH plugin: a local egress proxy bridge. Hands a credential-free HTTP(S) proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and injects the upstream auth on the…
description.zh: DSH 插件：本地出口代理（egress）桥——把只接受无凭据 HTTP(S) 代理地址的消费方，接到需要账号密码的上游代理上，凭据只在需要的那一跳注入；默认失败即断联，绝不降级为直连。零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Start a local mihomo proxy core on demand and shut it down when idle — no always-on port, no leftover process, no change to the Windows system proxy. Routes…
description.zh: 按需拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲后自动关闭：不常占端口、不留后台进程、不改 Windows 系统代理设置。已有代理在跑时直接借道它的出口。需要自备 Clash/mihomo 配置（订阅、导入 FlClash 配置或手动粘贴）；首次运行会自动下载约 61 MB 的 mihomo 内核到插件目录。
按提供商（账号）分流的 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理池。基于 API 密钥识别账号实现精准分流，支持绝对直连（无视 DSH 全局代理）与内置联网工具代理热装。配置在 DSH 设置页图形化管理，保存即热生效。
description.en: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and…
Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and…
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: Lets the DSH Web UI run behind an authenticating reverse proxy, with separate controls for trusted hosts, login bypass, cross-site navigation, local-page…
description.zh: 让 DSH Web UI 可在带身份验证的反向代理后运行，并分别控制受信任主机、跳过登录、跨站导航、本地页面信任和可选的网络监听器。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Grade PowerShell tool calls before execution and request confirmation for high-risk matches. Heuristic checks supplement native approvals; requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 执行前分级 PowerShell 工具调用，对高风险命中请求确认。启发式检查只补充宿主原生审批；需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 19 │ pstack coding workflows, skills, model-role settings and host subagent delegation for DeepSeek Harness. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=24.21.1; scripts use host shell tools and their declared interpreters. Browser, terminal and forge steps need optional bundles; model calls follow configured routes and pricing.
description.zh: ★ 19 │ 将 pstack 编程工作流、技能、模型角色设置和宿主子代理协作移植到 DeepSeek Harness。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.21.1；脚本通过宿主 shell 工具和各自解释器运行，浏览器、终端及 forge 步骤需可选组合包，模型调用按配置路由计费。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Combine PTC coding mode, Cordis tools and preset-authoring skills in switchable agent presets.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 把 PTC 编码模式、Cordis 工具和预设编写技能组合为可切换的 Agent 预设。

description.en: Normalizes an omitted or undefined first argument to {} for TypeScript PTC run_code calls, so no-argument tools such as tools.job_list() stop failing with…
description.zh: 把 PTC run_code（TypeScript function-body）中省略或为 undefined 的工具首参归一化为 {}，tools.job_list() 这类无参调用不再报 binding arguments must be lossless JSON。

description.en: ★ 25 │ A session-bound agent-native REPL for DeepSeek Harness PTC mode.
description.zh: ★ 25 │ 为 DSH 的 PTC 模式提供与会话绑定的 REPL 交互执行环境。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Measure tool activity before and after a /pua steering message with local receipts. Requires Node >=22 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0; does not establish causality.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 对比 /pua 施压消息前后的工具行为并保存本地回执。需 Node >=22 与 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0；统计不证明因果关系。

description.en: Market-gap radar for DSH plugin developers. Splits the catalog into categories and topics, tags every topic empty, thin, contested or crowded, and ranks the…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发者的市场空白雷达。把目录拆到大类与方向，每档标出空位、稀少、有竞争或红海，空位最多的方向排在前面，动手前先知道该做什么；同时可浏览整个市场并一键复制安装命令。

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion,…
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与…

description.en: ★ 5 │ Explore usage and estimated costs across sessions, including model trends, heatmaps, quotas, balance reconciliation and CSV export.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 查看跨会话用量与费用估算，提供模型趋势、热力图、配额、余额对账和 CSV 导出。

description.en: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with…
description.zh: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Orchestrate local subagents with task dependencies, execution states, isolated sessions and stage checks.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 在单机上编排子 Agent，管理任务依赖、执行状态、会话隔离和阶段检查。

description.en: Phone push for DeepSeek Harness: hooks the question seam in-process so a pending question reaches your phone through an ntfy relay; an answer sent from the phone is fed back to the agent as a user message, which requires `tool-ask-user` to run in `mode: timed` — with the shipped default (`mode: legacy`) only the notification is delivered.
description.zh: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

description.en: Multi-channel push notification plugin supporting Bark (iOS) and ntfy (Android/iOS/Web/Desktop) for turn completion, approvals, questions, and quota halts.
description.zh: 多渠道推送通知插件，支持 Bark (iOS) 与 ntfy (全平台)，覆盖回合结束、操作授权、交互提问及额度耗尽异常停机。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Before git commit, git push or gh repo sync runs through DSH, scan the content that would be committed or uploaded for keys, private keys, credentials, absolute paths and personal data. Suspicious content requires one-time approval, with global, project and session allow lists and a settings page behind DSH host authentication. Manual terminals outside DSH are not covered.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 执行 git commit、git push 或 gh repo sync 前，只读检查将要提交或上传的密钥、私钥、凭据、绝对路径和个人信息。发现内容时请求一次性授权，支持全局、项目和会话三级放行名单，设置页使用 DSH 宿主认证。不覆盖 DSH 之外的人工终端操作。

description.en: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text…
description.zh: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

description.en: PWA icon: replaces the icon and app name used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop, covering desktop browsers and the iOS home screen. Ships a…
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装 / 添加到桌面时使用的图标与应用名换成自定义内容，覆盖桌面浏览器与 iOS 主屏幕。包内自带开箱即用的图标集，也支持换成自己的图片并覆盖 manifest 字段。

description.en: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running…
description.zh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal…
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: ★ 34 │ dsh-qa QA Workbench: a local software testing workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Project/iteration dual-mode, full-flow requirements / test cases / defects / milestones / reports, native QA preset, settings, release history, kanban and calendar.
description.zh: ★ 34 │ 管理需求、测试用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与版本记录。

description.en: ★ 64 │ DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: 10 testing skills (requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing/review, E2E/API automation, exploratory, regression, bug analysis) + shared core knowledge base — a full QA pipeline as agent skills.
description.zh: ★ 64 │ 提供需求分析、测试策略、用例、自动化、探索与回归测试技能。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.
description.zh: 将 QBoson Kaiwu 的 Ising 矩阵求解能力作为 solve_ising Agent Tool 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents through qing_ prefixed host tools, typeset on a rice-paper panel…
description.zh: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

description.en: AI animated themes, computer control, standalone windows, attachment previews, Git management, session pop-outs and annotations, cross-app file drag-and-drop,…
description.zh: AI 智能动效主题、电脑操控、独立窗口、附件预览、Git 管理、会话分窗与批注、跨应用文件拖拽、AI 提示词。电脑操控需在设置里开启；macOS 上需授予屏幕录制、辅助功能与输入监控权限，Windows 独立窗口需 Edge WebView2 运行时；提示词建议与 AI 主题会额外消耗模型用量。

description.en: Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token…
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权接入启信慧眼 MCP 服务，以单条插件条目把它的工具挂载为 mcp__qixin_insight__*，token 到期前自动刷新，断开时吊销。

description.en: QMS NCR, CAPA and 8D tracking with batch and impact assessment.
description.zh: QMS 不合格品、CAPA 与 8D 闭环跟踪。

description.en: ★ 71 │ Connect domestic and international Qoder model services to DSH.
description.zh: ★ 71 │ 为 DSH 接入 Qoder 国内与国际模型服务。

description.en: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay…
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的移动优先体验优化包：Chrome 式活跃会话标签页（Tab Bar）、全屏侧栏滑动开合、侧栏浮层与折叠态最近会话、切换会话不拉起输入法、viewport/键盘安全区适配、按钮触摸反馈、代码块表格内滚、隐藏权限下拉、设置页全屏重写与页签记忆、合成器线程状态动画、长按拖拽卡死修复——14…

description.en: Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill,…
description.zh: 把 dsh 接到个人 QQ：NapCat 托管与扫码登录、私聊/群聊 AI 回复（含图片理解）与批量节流、本地归档与轮询补漏、群内 @ 与撤回自己刚发的消息、QQ 空间留言，并带左侧栏管理面板。默认任何 QQ 用户私聊该账号（或在群里 @ 它）都会得到 AI 回复；把 access.privateMode /…

description.en: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for…
description.zh: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Connect QQ via NapCat or OneBot 11 to a DSH session, with access controls and QQ tools. Requires a separately configured gateway and Node ^22.19 or >=24; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 NapCat 或 OneBot 11 将 QQ 接入 DSH 会话，提供访问控制和 QQ 工具。需单独配置网关、Node ^22.19 或 >=24；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Bridges a DSH session and QQ over NapCat HTTP, forwarding agent replies to QQ and feeding messages you send in QQ back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat HTTP 把 DSH 会话和 QQ 双向打通：AI 说完自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 里说的话自动转进会话。
把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。
description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: QQ-style alert sounds for DSH: the QQ message tone when a turn finishes and the QQ system tone when approval or an answer is needed, reading your local QQ…
description.zh: 用本机 QQ 的音效提醒 DSH：任务完成响好友消息音，需要审批或回答问题时响系统消息音；Windows 下自动发现 QQ 目录，其它平台回落到内置音效。

description.en: QQ protocol backend for DeepSeek Harness on Linux: boots LinuxQQ and NapCat with the engine (first run installs them, about 250 MB) and exposes a standard…
description.zh: 给 DSH 提供 QQ 协议端（仅 Linux）：随引擎启动 LinuxQQ 与 NapCat（首次运行自动安装，约 250 MB），对外提供标准 OneBot 11 接口。

description.en: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact…
description.zh: 通过 QQ（官方 Bot API v2，仅单聊）远程控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话与工作区：列出/切换工作区、新建会话、压缩历史、切换模型，支持流式输出、Markdown 与审批转发。未做按用户门禁——任何能给该机器人发消息的人都能控制这些会话，消耗你的模型额度与文件权限。

description.en: Add-on layer over the official QQ bot plugin @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot: gates group messages before they reach the agent (probability, debounce with backlog,…
description.zh: 官方 QQ 机器人插件 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 的拓展层：群聊消息进 agent 前先按概率、防抖加积压、无效消息过滤做频控收敛，非管理员附件需管理员回「同意」才读取，私聊按空闲时长主动问候，并补上表情包、TTS/ASR 语音条、绘图与统一设置页。需要先装好官方 QQ…

description.en: Standalone QQ-bot extension pack for DeepSeek Harness — fully independent, no other plugin required. Two-layer SQLite memory with hippocampal recall, a persona…
description.zh: 独立的 QQ 机器人扩展包（DeepSeek Harness 桌面端插件，无需安装其他本体）。提供两层 SQLite 记忆（类海马体召回）、会从日常聊天里成长的人格、群分级、本地小模型代答与单脑仲裁、TTS 发件箱、表情包库、主人审核制的视频流水线，以及四形态桌宠（三套自绘形象 +…

description.en: ★ 0 │ QQ Mail for the DSH right sidebar: read recent mail and send plain text with a confirm gate. Credentials are read only from a private secret.json.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在右侧栏读取 QQ 邮件、查看正文，并在确认后发送纯文本邮件；凭据从私有配置文件读取。

description.en: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed with one command: the bundle installs the settings panel and mounts the engine out of the same package, so…
description.zh: 动手回合前先过第二个模型的质检，一条命令装完：bundle 同时装上设置面板和同一个包里的引擎，两半一起起来。一次独立判官调用按编号判据逐条打 0-10 分，任一条低于 6 分即判不合格并打回重写，默认最多回炉 3 轮。出厂是演习模式，只把判定写进审计日志、不打回，看过日志再在面板里关掉。Web…

description.en: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice.…
description.zh: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable…
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Tracks manufacturing quality issues and 8D improvement projects, analyzes process capability and SPC control charts, and exports reports from a local SQLite…
description.zh: 管理制造质量问题和 8D 改进项目，分析过程能力与 SPC 控制图，并从本地 SQLite 数据库导出报表。

description.en: QUASAR — a space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness: an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk rendered behind the app, with frosted-glass…
description.zh: QUASAR — DeepSeek Harness 的太空主题皮肤：侧栏里一颗墨色黑洞，应用背后实时渲染吸积盘，配合磨砂玻璃面板。动效由 canvas 驱动，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。

description.en: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom…
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: A plugin for dsh: once ask_user_question times out, the content you entered will remain in the UI or model context.
description.zh: dsh提问超时保护插件: 一旦模型提问超时,将你的回答草稿保留在UI或上下文中,而不是直接丢弃。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH. Hover the "Question tree" tab above and a small card pops up with the whole tree — identical to the sidebar, but it frees that…
description.zh: 鼠标放到上方「问题树」时出现问题树小卡片，效果与侧边栏完全一致，主要目的是腾出侧边栏的空间并更快捷地查看；卡片里点「列表 / 图」可切换视图。对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，树上就多一个节点。树有三个入口，共用一份数据：鼠标停到顶部「问题树」标签会浮出小卡片（对话原地不动，最适合边看边点），也可以点开整页视图，或常驻右…

description.en: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows,…
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight…
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Back up the DSH desktop environment to a local Git repository and manage versions from Settings. Windows only; requires PowerShell, Git for Windows and initialization with setup.ps1. Export snapshots or copy a restore command; credentials are excluded by default.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把 DSH 桌面环境备份到本地 Git 仓库，在设置中管理版本、导出快照和复制恢复命令。仅适用于 Windows，需要 PowerShell、Git for Windows，并先用 setup.ps1 初始化备份仓库；凭据默认不备份。

description.en: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com page in the DSH main panel through the desktop app's native browser view, so the login survives restarts, without an…
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板里用桌面端原生浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页，登录可跨重启恢复，不用 iframe、不代理请求；基于 JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat 的 fork，改动见 NOTICE。登录令牌以明文保存在 session.json 中。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one…
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的悬浮便签本，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片和本地持久化。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment…
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找…

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without…
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

description.en: Shortcut buttons in the composer row that send preset text into the current conversation in one click. Button label, size, opacity, shape and payload are…
description.zh: 在输入框一行放一组快捷按钮，点一下把预设文字发进当前对话。每个按钮的名称、大小、透明度、形状与发送内容都可就地编辑；右键拖动整组可在上下文进度左右换位，选择保存在本地。按钮组只占自身宽度，不会挤压上下文进度与用量区域。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Turn conversation Markdown headings into a searchable outline with previews and navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 把会话中的 Markdown 标题整理为可搜索大纲，支持预览与跳转。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog…
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter,…
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: Sidebar video player for DSH: it registers its own right-sidebar tab type, so any video opened through the harness — the Files tab, a chat file reference,…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏视频播放器：注册自己的右侧栏页签类型，因此无论从文件页签、对话里的文件引用，还是其它侧边栏插件的文件树打开视频，都会落到这里。字节走宿主的 HTTP Range 路由流式下发（桌面端另有一条带令牌的回环源，进度条在桌面端也能拖得动），并提供滚轮缩放、拖拽平移、逐帧步进、倍速与音量弹出条，以及覆盖全部控件的…

description.en: Edit Markdown in place in the right sidebar and send inline comments to the agent, which resolves each one it handles.
description.zh: 在右侧栏直接编辑 Markdown，把行内评论发给 Agent，处理完自动标记解决。

description.en: Clears four kinds of idle-only system notices (approval policy, working directory, plan mode, plugin changes) that DeepSeek Harness counts as active work, so…
description.zh: 清除四类被 DeepSeek Harness 误算为“有任务”的空闲系统通知（审批策略、工作目录、计划模式、插件变更），让没有任务运行时退出不再弹出“任务将会中断”的警告。

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet,…
description.zh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

description.en: Shows ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok Bot remaining usage with reset countdowns plus the DeepSeek balance in a compact card above the sidebar account row; thresholds,…
description.zh: 在侧栏登录名上方以紧凑卡片显示 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok Bot 的剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 余额；可配置阈值、刷新间隔与每个 provider 的 HTTP 代理。需事先具备各家登录态：ChatGPT 需 Codex CLI 登录（codex login）、Gemini 需…

description.en: DeepSeek Harness quota dashboard: current-model floating pill, DeepSeek balance and official usage charts, OpenCode Go monthly and per-model quota, and GLM /…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 额度面板：跟随当前会话模型的悬浮胶囊，展示 DeepSeek 余额与官网用量图、OpenCode Go 总额度与分模型额度，以及 GLM / 小米 MiMo 余额。

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows…
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding…

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Selection quoting and anchored annotations across DSH chats and document previews: numbered quote blocks stay visible in the composer and in sent messages and…
description.zh: DSH 会话与文档预览里的划词批注：带编号的引用块在输入框和已发送消息里始终可见、点一下跳回原文；docx / PDF / Markdown / 代码与 Excel 选区批注可攒起来一次性发送；批注框支持语音输入。

description.en: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an agent-callable quote tool and a full AstrBot-style management page (library, statistics,…
description.zh: 本地收藏、检索与随机回放群聊语录，提供 Agent 可调用的 quote 工具和 AstrBot 风格的整页管理后台（语录库、统计、数据可视化、回收站、人物、专题合集、协作维护）。需要 Node.js 22.13+；QQ 采集与回发为可选功能，需要运行中的 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP…

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Quote and reply the way Claude Code does it: select text, answer it in a popover, stack the pairs as blocks above the composer, send them as one message.
description.zh: 选中对话里的文字就地引用回复，问答变成输入框上方的方块，一次发出。

description.en: Connects all seven Qwen Token Plan Harness-entitlement MCP services (enhanced search, web fetch, code interpreter, vertical search, image, TTS, ASR) plus the…
description.zh: 一步接全千问 Token Plan 的 7 个 Harness 权益 MCP 服务（联网搜索、网页解析、代码解释器、垂类搜索、图像生成、语音合成、语音识别）与决策模型（qwen_decide），附逐服务开关与实时状态面板。

description.en: Shows and loads Qwen (qianwen*) skills only when the session runs on the Qwen Token Plan CN provider, and hides and blocks them on any other provider.
description.zh: 仅当会话运行在 Qwen Token Plan CN 供应商上时才展示并加载千问（qianwen*）技能，其它供应商下隐藏并禁止加载。

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the…
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for dsh: signs in through the desktop device flow and then calls the official OpenAI-compatible gateway, so tool calls, image…
description.zh: 把千问办公（QwenWork）接成 dsh 的模型提供方：用桌面端设备码登录，直连官方 OpenAI 兼容网关，工具调用、图片输入和 usage 都能透传；在 qwenwork 下提供套餐里的各档模型，凭据落在本地文件、到期自动刷新写回，并显示账号剩余积分。

description.en: Unofficial QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for DSH, adapted from dsh-magpie-connect and magpie (MIT): device-code sign-in and request signing live inside the…
description.zh: 非官方的千问办公（QwenWork）模型 provider，改编自 dsh-magpie-connect 与 magpie（MIT）：设备码登录与请求签名均在插件内实现，不需要桌面客户端或本地转发进程。需有效的千问办公套餐，DSH 0.2.x。

description.en: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness (repo dsh_qzone_sticker): scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a…
description.zh: QQ 空间发说说插件（仓库 dsh_qzone_sticker）：手机 QQ 扫一次码登录，之后由模型按心情挑表情包发说说，支持每天条数上限，静默 Chrome 不占屏。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Moves the in-car radio from godot_citys into the DSH right sidebar: a three.js in-car view, winding night roads, and radio-browser internet stations (City Pop).
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 将 godot_citys 中的车载电台搬进 DSH 右侧栏：three.js 车内视角、蜿蜒的夜路，以及 radio-browser 网络电台（City Pop）。

description.en: Per-project long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a panel to browse, search and edit what each project knows, and a pointer injected after the first user…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层按项目分类的长期记忆：面板可浏览、检索、编辑每个项目记得什么，并在会话第一句后注入一条「去读 handoff pack」的指针。记忆库本体是同仓库里的本地 MCP server（Python + SQLite）；插件从 npm 安装，之后按 README 克隆仓库并配置…

description.en: Narrow 40px icon rail for the DSH sidebar: panel icons move into a single column so the session list gets the full width, session titles gain a three-level…
description.zh: 把面板图标收进 40px 窄栏、把宽度还给会话列表，会话标题分三级明暗；侧栏底部栏上方常显 DeepSeek 余额，并按余额差值记录今日与累计消费（按数值变色）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add an animated rainbow border to the message composer. Respects reduced-motion preferences; requires the host composer selector and modern CSS support.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为消息输入框添加流动彩虹描边，遵循减弱动态效果设置；依赖宿主输入框选择器和现代 CSS 支持。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog,…
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Read text from PNG and JPEG images locally with the ocr_image tool. OCR models and native runtime are bundled; currently Windows x64 only. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0 and can use substantial memory.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用 ocr_image 工具在本机识别 PNG、JPEG 中的文字，随包提供模型与原生运行库。目前仅支持 Windows x64，需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0，处理大图可能占用较多内存。

description.en: Resident multi-connection download engine for DeepSeek Harness: seven rdm_* agent tools plus a sidebar download panel, with resumable, SHA-256-verified and…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的常驻多连接下载引擎：七个 rdm_* 智能体工具加侧边栏下载面板，支持断点续传、SHA-256 校验与限速，内核或 DSH 重启后仍可续传。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile,…
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI…

description.en: ★ 195 │ Expose REA reverse-engineering tools through MCP. Uses the Harness runtime with a prepared REA 6.4.0 install, or falls back to npx requiring network and npx on PATH. Native tools need separate setup; optional WSL support starts disabled.
description.zh: ★ 195 │ 通过 MCP 接入 REA 逆向工具。优先用宿主运行时启动已准备的 REA 6.4.0，否则回退到 npx，需要网络和可用的 npx。原生工具需另行准备，WSL 扩展默认关闭。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Install a pinned rea-agents release locally, start its MCP service and upgrade through an update control.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 在本地安装指定版本的 rea-agents、启动其 MCP 服务，并通过更新入口升级。

description.en: Folds REA's 207 reverse-engineering tools (Ghidra / Hopper / IDA backends) into 3 commands plus 6 read-only domain entries: about 5 KB of resident tool text…
description.zh: 把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具（Ghidra / Hopper / IDA 后端）折叠成 3 条命令加 6 个只读域入口，常驻约 5 KB。不代装引擎，需自行安装 rea-agents、Ghidra 12.1.x 与 JDK 21。

description.en: Find Android game packages and guide Google Play dependency analysis and modification. Needs Python 3 and the Android tools you pick (JADX/apktool/adb).
description.zh: 查找 Android 游戏安装包，提供 Google Play 依赖分析与修改工作流。需要 Python 3 和你自选的 Android 工具（JADX/apktool/adb）。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from…
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server…
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: Mounts REA's reverse-engineering MCP toolset in DeepSeek Harness behind a composer chip; it is on by default once installed, and switching it off withdraws the…
description.zh: 把 REA 的逆向工程 MCP 工具集接进 DeepSeek Harness，输入框工具条上一个开关，装好即默认开启；关掉后工具全部撤走、MCP 子进程退出，不需要它的会话就不花这份上下文。

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push…
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine,…
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The…
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the…
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context;…
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: ★ 24 │ Read webpages and feeds with encoding detection, pagination and compact text output.
description.zh: ★ 24 │ 识别编码并读取网页与订阅源，处理分页，输出精简正文。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache…
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored…
description.zh: 在侧边栏里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转与书内链接跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答、按章蒸馏，并能导入 Legado 格式书源按章抓取在线书籍，随包还带一个陪读教练 skill。PDF 只支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

description.en: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes…
description.zh: DSH 阅读工作台：封面网格书架 + 单/双页分页阅读器，支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML、EPUB、MOBI、PDF，划线笔记以文本偏移锚定，并提供书目、划线、正文节选三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compose local PNG screenshots into README WebM/GIF and a cover image. Requires a separately installed ffmpeg; rebuilds replace generated artifacts and the output .frames directory.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把本地 PNG 截图合成为 README WebM、GIF 和封面；需自行安装 ffmpeg，重建会覆盖产物并清理输出 .frames 目录。

description.en: AI-assisted reading workspace for DSH with a local TXT/Markdown/EPUB/PDF library, annotations, prompt presets, long notes, memory, export and companion tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 AI 辅助阅读工作区：本地 TXT/Markdown/EPUB/PDF 书库、批注、提示词预设、长笔记、记忆、导出与伴读工具。

description.en: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

description.en: Registers the REA reverse-engineering toolset in DSH and manages its Node and REA runtime, with a global tool switch, a live composer status indicator and…
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向分析工具集接入 DSH，并托管其 Node 与 REA 运行时：提供全局工具开关、输入框状态指示点和就地运行时升级。首次启动会从 nodejs.org 和 npm 下载固定版本的 Node 与 REA 运行时到受管目录，并把 REA 的全部工具注册为 mcp__rea__*；可选的分析器只在你要求时才配…

description.en: A realistic humpback whale desktop pet for Windows: a DSH host bundle that spawns its own Electron overlay above the desktop (not inside the web UI), with…
description.zh: Windows 上的写实座头鲸桌宠：DSH Host bundle 启动独立 Electron 悬浮层（不在网页内），点击触发全屏水波与屏幕折射，自带 20 个本地音效和 121 条离线台词。不调用模型、无遥测；仅在首次启动找不到共享 Electron 运行时时一次性下载，另有只在你点击时才发起的 DeepSeek…

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_*…
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta…

description.en: Reason tree: breaks a conclusion into a bottom-up argument tree, marks each branch as holds, fails or open, and jumps to the source file in Hippocampus.
description.zh: 根源追溯：把结论拆成从下往上的论证树，每一支可标成立、不成立或待拆，并能跳到海马体看原文。

description.en: Gives hand-declared models on custom or relay routes a vendor-matched reasoning-effort picker: detects Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Gemini, Grok,…
description.zh: 为自定义路由或中转站上手动添加的模型提供按厂商匹配的推理等级选择：根据模型 id、显示名或接口域名识别 Claude、GPT、DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi、Qwen、Gemini、Grok、豆包或 MiMo，只填入该厂商接受的档位，并补上对应请求格式所需的 pi-ai compat 字段，再写回 profile…

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings.…
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on…
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never…
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: ★ 126 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin: recall sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them.
description.zh: ★ 126 │ 在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未处理的文字消息。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries…
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Crash-recovery guard for DeepSeek Harness: records plugin install and update recency plus declared compatibility metadata, blocks the offending suspects before…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件崩溃恢复守护：记录插件的安装更新时序与声明的兼容元数据，崩溃后在下一次启动前拦下问题嫌疑插件，稳定后自动恢复。带可交互能力图谱、只观测不行动的预警指标、按项目分区隔离、归档重置与离线救援 CLI。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters,…
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置…

description.en: Adds a Geek level to the Performance & usage setting: a live reading of the newest request in the composer status row (first-token latency, generation speed,…
description.zh: 在「性能与用量」设置里增加极客档：输入区状态行实时显示最新一次请求的首字延迟、生成速度、输出 Token、总用时与折算速度，并可展开抽屉查看最近 10 次请求及一行平均值。输出 Token 取自上游返回的 usage，仅当 usage 缺失时才使用按内容类型标定的字符估算。

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

description.en: ★ 23 │ Search and recommend plugins using a public scoring model and a settings-page ranking.
description.zh: ★ 23 │ 按公开评分模型检索和推荐插件，并在设置页展示排行。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation…
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Replaces identity numbers, phone numbers, bank cards, emails, addresses, customer names and secrets with numbered placeholders before a model request leaves…
description.zh: 在模型请求离开本机前，把身份证、手机号、银行卡、邮箱、地址、客户名与密钥替换成编号占位符，响应回来自动回填；映射表加密存本机，每次替换写入带哈希链的审计日志，可导出 CSV。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Point at an element on a proxied page, adjust it live and send structured visual feedback to the agent. Pages are loaded through a local proxy; drawings are kept in the overlay and the host store, not exposed to the page. Requires Node >=20; no DSH compatibility range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在本地代理打开的网页上指向元素、实时调整，并把结构化视觉反馈发给 Agent。页面经本地代理加载；绘图保存在浮层和宿主存储中，不再暴露给页面。需 Node >=20，未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit…
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Edit and resend or regenerate a message you already sent, including while its answer is still streaming: the plugin stops the running turn through the official…
description.zh: 生成中也能编辑已发送的消息：点「编辑重发」或「重新生成」时，如果这一轮还在跑，先通过官方 Session.cancel 停掉并等会话空闲（上限 8 秒），再按上游 dsh-redo 的方式原地撤回并重发。命令为 /relive，可与 dsh-redo 同时安装。

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery,…
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透），并发可配置；开工前做技能与资源预检；得分按四阶段（信息收集/互联网/边界/内网），上限、权限取高、同服务去重由服务端判定；发现落本机 SQLite 事实库。右侧常驻控制台 9…

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling,…
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: ★ 2 │ Media library for the dsh web UI: browse configured local directories as a grid or list, open images in a viewer, and play videos in a page-fullscreen player with swipe navigation.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 以网格或列表浏览本地媒体目录，查看图片，或全屏播放和滑动切换视频。

description.en: Promo studio panel for DSH plugins: type a plugin name, match it to a case file, and render a 28-second real-UI film plus a poster locally. The V0.1 film…
description.zh: DSH 插件宣传台面板：输入插件名称，匹配案例文件，在本机渲染 28 秒真机界面宣传片与封面。V0.1 真机片用自带的逐帧渲染器在本机 Chrome 上出帧（快门区间多采样得到运动模糊，并对硬切做保护），渲染所需的 comp 素材随包分发，因此 npm 安装后即可出片，不需要 Onetake 运行时。需要…

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged…
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: ★ 27 │ References files, sessions, commands, skills, and historical external AI chats from the DSH @ menu.
description.zh: ★ 27 │ 通过 @ 菜单引用文件、会话、命令、技能，以及其他 AI 工具中的历史对话。

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text)…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found /…

description.en: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.
description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-improved（surface 标记+召回对账）、session-steward（检索语料源切换）、prime-memory（历史投影锚点回填）。支持宿主 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 17 tag 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-reference-session-collector。

description.en: Collects the papers a DeepSeek Harness conversation cited, checks each one against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv and DataCite, and exports the confirmed entries as…
description.zh: 收集对话里引用过的文献，逐条到 Crossref、OpenAlex、arXiv、DataCite 核对，通过核对的导出为 BibTeX 或 RIS。

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and…
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: Learn traceable experience from test-verified Python repairs in one repository. DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web only; learning is off by default. Verification runs repository code, and enabled model sharing sends bounded repair material to the configured provider.
description.zh: 从单仓库中通过测试验证的 Python 修复积累可追溯经验。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web，学习默认关闭；验证会执行仓库代码，启用模型共享后会向所选服务发送有限修复材料。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。
在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话…
description.en: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn…
Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and…
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: In the DSH desktop file preview, click an HTML element (with its source line and column) or lasso part of an image for the vision model to identify, then send…
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端文件预览中点选 HTML 元素（附源码行列），或自由圈选图片区域由视觉模型识别目标，写下修改要求后发送到当前会话；本地 HTML 修改保留记录，支持前后预览、逐行对比与回滚。
给 DSH 插件开发准备三件事：重载文件有改动的插件、重载办不到的改动就重启客户端、模型能自己触发热重载。重载走 DSH 自带的路径，没碰过的插件继续运行。重启从客户端外部发起，所以被替换的正是客户端也能完成，有会话或后台任务在跑时拒绝。轻量：不带参数、不添加上下文、按钮默认不出现。
description.en: Three things for DSH plugin development: reload the plugins whose files changed, restart the client when a reload cannot apply a change, and let the model…
Two buttons in the top-left of the DSH header — reload the UI and restart the app.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个按钮：刷新界面、重启应用。

description.en: ★ 280 │ Connect remote SSH workspaces with file operations, mirror sync, deployment and port forwarding.
description.zh: ★ 280 │ 连接 SSH 远程工作区，使用文件操作、镜像同步、部署与端口转发。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link…
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay…

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet…
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a…
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里提供「手机设置」面板：主列表五张卡（远程访问 / 外网隧道 / 设备 / 回收站 / App…

description.en: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click…
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on…
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Remote development launcher: install dsh on a remote host and use it in your local browser, with credentials staying on this machine.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 在远程主机安装 DSH，通过本机浏览器访问，登录凭据保留在本机。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an…
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any…
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness over an outbound Huawei Cloud DevBridge tunnel: a sidebar seat and a standalone control page start and stop the tunnel and…
description.zh: 把本机 DSH 的 Web 界面经华为云 DevBridge 出站隧道交给远端设备远控：侧边栏席位与独立控制页负责开启、停止隧道，并显示公网链接、二维码与日志。插件自带的鉴权网关只监听 127.0.0.1，转发前校验可轮换的访问令牌或 HMAC 会话 Cookie、限制失败次数并剥离外部身份头，因此不开放任何入站端口。…

description.en: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2…
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

description.en: ★ 50 │ Provide remote access, QR sign-in and connection management over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: ★ 50 │ 通过局域网或 Tailscale 提供远程访问、扫码登录与连接管理。

description.en: ★ 82 │ Access sessions, approvals and files from mobile clients through a token gateway, with server switching and offline chat caching.
description.zh: ★ 82 │ 通过令牌网关从移动客户端访问会话、审批和文件，支持服务器切换及聊天离线缓存。

description.en: Bundles the remote-shell skill for secure SSH, SFTP, Telnet, and WinRM remote operations, with an encrypted credential vault whose login and execution scripts…
description.zh: 打包 remote-shell 技能，提供安全的 SSH、SFTP、Telnet、WinRM 远程操作，内置加密凭证库，登录与执行脚本不接受明文密码。

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and…
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端 / 自建 / 微信机器人三个 tab、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额；微信机器人通道扫码绑定后，把任务完成 / 出错 / 停下推送到微信，需要拍板时回一个数字即可放行或拒绝，回话可直接继续当前任务——微信消息只经腾讯 ilink 与本机 bridge，不经中继。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Hide the DeepSeek Harness sidebar logo, brand name, version and conversation hero fish using empty brand slots and CSS. Author-tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; no compatibility range is declared. This is the renamed package; the old remove-deepseek-logo name is deprecated.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过空品牌插槽与样式隐藏 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏标志、品牌名、版本和对话首页鲸鱼。作者验证 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1；未声明兼容范围。这是更名后的包，旧名 remove-deepseek-logo 已弃用。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and…
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks repair-order settlement arithmetic: confirms that project amounts, parts and labor hours, and the settlement total are internally consistent; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 核对维修工单中的项目金额、配件、工时和结算总额，仅提示算术差异。

description.en: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 手动重置 AgentRouter Responses 旧回放状态，处理旧会话续聊时的上游资源绑定报错，保留聊天历史；支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs…
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Carries a DSH environment between machines through one private GitHub or Gitee repository: third-party plugins (reinstalled from a version, or carried as a…
description.zh: 通过一个私有 GitHub / Gitee 仓库在机器之间搬运 DSH 环境：第三方插件（按版本重装，或携带 tarball / 源码目录）、四个 profile 配置文件、以及文件夹快照。还原时逐文件比对，本机改过的文件不覆盖，被替换的文件先备份，并按绝对路径、已登记的根、或显式确认三级解析落点；逃出根、穿越…

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and…
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

description.en: Standalone rescue for a broken DeepSeek Harness profile: a CLI that runs without DSH diagnoses the crash logs (six classified causes, from real incidents),…
description.zh: 在 DSH 打不开时救回配置：不依赖 DSH 的命令行工具，把崩溃日志归类（六类原因，全部来自真实事故），启动前预检命令名冲突与插件构造期读取的文件，布防安全模式（只加载官方 bundle，启动正常后自动还原），并保留清单快照供回滚。另有一个常驻守护进程，用操作系统文件事件盯着崩溃日志目录——空闲零开销，加载器一死几秒…

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and…
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: ★ 214 │ Bind research claims to snapshots and export versioned reports with verification records.
description.zh: ★ 214 │ 将研究结论绑定到快照，导出带核验记录的版本化报告。

description.en: Research workflow suite that registers 10 domain skills and 15 tools, curates 450 bundled research skills into 103 capability cards with an auditable per-skill…
description.zh: 科研全流程插件：注册 10 个领域技能与 15 个工具，把随包 450 条科研技能整理成 103 张能力卡并附 444 条可审计的判定账本，并通过系统提示段自动接管科研任务。工具覆盖真跑 R/Python（默认关闭，先预览再确认）、数据闸门、图片与 docx 核验、按中文期刊体例生成 .docx、PubMed…

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image…
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.en: One-click plugin updates and restart from the sidebar: see every plugin's current and new version with publish dates, update them through the profile's own…
description.zh: 侧栏一键更新插件与重启：列出各插件的当前与新版本及发布时间，走 profile 自带安装器更新；完全重启后窗口回到上次的位置。仅限 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the…
description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux…

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any…
description.zh: DSH 界面上一小框：一键重启宿主、一键刷新页面。重启会先问「立即 / 30 秒 / 60 秒 / 2 分钟 / 取消」，倒计时可撤回；小框需长按 320ms 才能拖动（避免手一抖就粘住），拖到边缘自动吸附，窗口缩放时跟着走。刷新前会真正确认插件包能加载（文件时间戳 + 取回 bundle +…

description.en: ★ 4 │ Restart the Windows desktop app through a detached helper, with confirmation, delay and executable path settings.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 通过独立助手重启 Windows 桌面端，可设置确认、延时和目标程序路径。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what…
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working…
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories /…
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在…

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork…
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an…
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

description.en: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and…
description.zh: 逆向工程 agent 预设。把 REA（rea-agents）的原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron、托管程序集、归档与安装包分析能力作为 MCP 工具挂载——默认全量 170 个——但只在选择该预设的会话里生效，其它预设零加载。附带安装后环境自检：报告本机已装哪个原生分析引擎（Hopper /…

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the…
description.zh: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to…
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab…
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容…

description.en: ★ 0 │ Review a change set as a relationship graph in the middle column, with every node clickable to the exact source line.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用关系图审阅代码改动，点击节点即可跳转到相应源码行。

description.en: Evidence-gated acceptance for research reports: claims, citations, data scope and method limits each need a tick plus written evidence before a deliverable can…
description.zh: 研究报告的证据门：结论、引用、数据口径、方法限制四项必填检查，勾选之外还要写清证据才能通过；同一成果保留 revision 历史，通过后生成带 SHA-256 的独立验收单，文件被改动后会在验收单里明确提示重新审阅。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one…
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: Publish agent output to Reviso for human review, browse published documents from the sidebar, and find them again from the session that produced them. OAuth is…
description.zh: 把 Agent 产出发布到 Reviso 供人工评审，在侧边栏浏览已发布文档，并在产生这些文档的同一个 DSH 会话中再次找到它们。OAuth 由宿主中转：Reviso token 只保存在 DSH credentials 里，浏览器仅获得短时效的 embed 会话。需要 Reviso 账号或兼容的自建 Reviso…

description.en: Session replay view for DSH conversations: replays a session turn by turn at reading pace for prompts and answers while reasoning and tool output stream past,…
description.zh: DSH 会话回放视图：按轮重放一次会话，用户输入与助手正文保持阅读速度，思考与工具输出高速掠过且每段最多 3.5 秒，每条输入后停顿一秒；可一键把原始请求复刻到一个新会话，也可边回放边录制，把回放录屏导出成 WebM 视频（画布 1280×720，无需系统录屏权限）。

description.en: ★ 262 │ Rewind a conversation in place to any earlier user message and optionally restore the files the agent changed, without creating a branch.
description.zh: ★ 262 │ 在原窗口内把对话回退到任意更早的用户消息，可同时还原 Agent 改过的文件，不新建分支。

description.en: Adds chunked uploads with progress and resume, and native downloads of workspace files and the session log ZIP, to the DSH Web GUI, including sessions reached…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加带进度与续传的分块上传，以及工作区文件与会话日志 ZIP 的原生下载；通过配对远程链接访问的会话同样可用。

description.en: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models.…
description.zh: 白饭钓竿：把控制 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的能力通过 MCP（Streamable HTTP）与 dsh 原生工具暴露出去， 可配置允许使用的模型清单。可通过带审计的通用桥调用宿主长尾端点。默认只监听 127.0.0.1，可选访问令牌。

description.en: Vertical icon rail under the right-sidebar toggle: collapsed it shows three icons, hovering expands every right-sidebar tab, and clicking one opens that tab.
description.zh: 右侧栏快捷导航：在「打开右侧边栏」图标下方常驻一条竖排图标轨，悬停展开全部标签，点击一步直达。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Close right sidebar tabs with middle-click or double-click. Depends on the host dock tab attributes.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过鼠标中键或双击关闭右侧栏标签，依赖宿主 dock 标签属性。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show up to four comet-like bands along the window edge, colored by session model and animated with session state. Reverses the flow while waiting for input. The package declares no DSH compatibility range.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 沿窗口边缘显示最多四条流星光带，按会话模型配色并随会话状态变化，等待输入时反向流动。包内未声明适用的 DSH 版本。

description.en: Local dev panel for the DSH web GUI: follow service logs, start/stop workspace programs, debug Java over JDWP, browse and edit workspace files, and search file…
description.zh: DSH 网页版的本机开发面板：跟随服务日志、启停工作区程序、JDWP 调试 Java、浏览编辑工作区文件与文件名搜索。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高版本；启动或调试 Java 程序需要本机 JDK 与 Maven，启动前端程序需要 Node。

description.en: Local YonBIP/YMS development runtime: resolves project settings, issues platform API tokens, pulls and adapts middleware endpoints, provides internal…
description.zh: YonBIP/YMS 本地开发运行时：解析项目配置、签发平台 API 凭据、拉取并适配中间件端点、通过 SOCKS 转发或直连访问内网数据库/缓存/服务、构建并启停本地 YMS 运行时、生成 IDE 启动/调试配置。不依赖 dsh-ris-ide。需要 JDK 21 与 PATH 中的…

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses,…
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。
