description.en: A DSH context-compaction plugin: when the route supports images, it renders the middle of a session history into locally generated 1-bit bitmap frames for the…
description.zh: DSH 上下文压缩插件：路由支持图片时，把会话历史的中段在本地渲染成单色位图帧交给视觉模型阅读；精确的首尾文本、有上限的精确 token 索引与 FILES 文件索引仍以文字保留。

description.en: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
description.zh: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks 三重一大 decision ledgers against prior research, meeting deliberation and resolution records; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据前置研究、会议审议与决议记录程序，核对“三重一大”决策台账并留痕；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Connects the Solmirror open platform to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools covering image and video generation, a model catalog, cost estimates, reference uploads,…
description.zh: 把瞬镜开放平台的图片、视频生成能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：MCP 工具覆盖模型目录、估价、参考素材上传、文生图/图生图、文生视频/图生视频、结果查询与媒体地址。生成提交为 dsh 原生后台任务，完成自动通知，同一消息内并行执行；对话内视频播放、图片出图墙。设置页配置平台 API…

description.en: DSH-SOLO desktop plugin for its companion app. Pair by QR code to view sessions, send tasks, switch models, transfer attachments and approve operations with…
description.zh: DSH-SOLO 手机远程协作的电脑端插件，搭配 App 扫码连接，查看会话、发送任务、切换模型、传递附件并确认操作审批；支持端到端加密，已配置官方云转发服务，无需自行部署服务器。App 安装包下载：https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/dow…

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML…

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single…
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Adds Soniox speech-to-text and text-to-speech through your own API key. Recordings and text to synthesize are sent to Soniox; generated audio is cached locally under DSH_HOME. Requires a Soniox key and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 使用自己的 API Key 接入 Soniox 语音识别与合成。录音和待朗读文本会发送到 Soniox，生成的音频缓存在本机 DSH_HOME。需要 Soniox Key 和 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of…
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Personalization settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加个性化设置。

description.en: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
description.zh: 管理 soul.md 人设卡与长期记忆，支持按工作区和会话选择人设，并提供读取和更新工具。

description.en: Persona, mood, long-term memory and per-person ledgers for a DSH agent, with a portable soul pack for moving between machines.
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 装上人设、心情、长期记忆和按人账本，并支持把整套灵魂打包迁移到另一台机器。

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable…
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

description.en: Plays a sound when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权时播放提示音，并提供分类开关。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Browse commit graphs and diffs, stage or discard changes, amend commits and create repositories or pull requests through gh.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 查看 Git 提交图和差异，暂存或丢弃改动、修改上次提交，并通过 gh 创建仓库或拉取请求。

description.en: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official…
description.zh: 按住空格录音、松手自动识别并发送，不用先点输入框。按 Esc 可取消，切换窗口自动取消。需先启用官方「语音输入」Bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）并下载好语音模型，否则插件不接管空格。

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT…
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web…

description.en: SPC control-chart and Cpk check against the current GB/T 17989.2—2020 control-chart constants.
description.zh: 按现行 GB/T 17989.2—2020 控制图常数表核对 SPC 控制图控制限与 CPK。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both…
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Point at one window and the AI reads only that window -- text, layout and small print. No full-screen fallback, and it still works when that window is covered…
description.zh: 只读你指定的那一个窗口：读字、看版式、看清小字；被别的窗口盖住也照样能读，绝不回退整屏。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Real-time generation-speed gauge for DSH: a half-circle dial and a flowing trend curve, sampling tok/s 50 times a second for finer, more accurate measurement.
description.zh: DSH 生成速度仪表盘：半圆表盘与流动曲线趋势图，一秒 50 次获取 tok/s，测量更细更精准。

description.en: ★ 16 │ Show two output speeds in the footer: decode speed after the first token, and in parentheses the whole-request speed including first-token latency. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 16 │ 在底栏同时显示两种输出速度：首 token 之后的解码速度，括号内为含首字延迟的整段速度。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: Chrome-style spell check for the dsh composer: the misspelled word under the caret gets a suggestion strip, and Tab accepts it. Local only — no network, no…
description.zh: 给 dsh 输入框做像 Chrome 那样的拼写检查：光标所在的错词上方出现建议条，按 Tab 直接接受；错词下画蓝色波浪线，右键可看完整候选。完全本机运行，不联网、不调用模型。

description.en: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量与费用统计插件：右下角悬浮窗，按模型/按天/按会话多维聚合与预计花费。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Replace the thinking-status text with rotating bilingual phrases and an editable local word pool. Depends on host DOM markers; use it instead of other plugins that replace the same status text.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把思考状态文案换成轮换的双语短句，词池可编辑并保存在浏览器。依赖宿主 DOM 标记，与修改同一状态文案的插件需二选一。

description.en: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the…
description.zh: 页面级启动开屏：彭罗斯三角在等距菱格海面上旋转受光，取景框本身就是进度计，按开屏节奏平滑推进、以真实 DSH 启动完成度为上限；按任意键跳过，主题坞提供 Monument Valley / Geometric Islands 十套色板。开屏结束后三角留在输入框旁，作为一枚反映当前工作状态的小标记。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into…
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Splits the DSH main area into vertical columns, one live conversation per parallel task, with mouse-wheel paging past four columns, draggable dividers, a split…
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区域竖着分成多列，每个并行任务一列实时对话；超过 4 列用鼠标滚轮整页翻，分隔线可拖拽调宽，侧边栏会话行可直接加入或移出分屏，另有只显示进度与当前步骤的极简视图，并可一键取消分屏。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Verify local proxy routing configurations against test cases and cached rule providers, with reports and optional CLI exports. Does not apply router settings or fetch remote rule providers.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 离线读取代理分流配置、规则缓存和用例，生成验收报告；不改路由器、不下载远程规则，支持范围有限。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Split the conversation area into native panes (side by side, stacked, 2×2 or auto grid), each an independent session. Layout is remembered. Desktop profile.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把对话区拆成原生窗格（左右、上下、2×2 或自动网格），每个窗格是独立会话，布局会被记住。适用于桌面版。

description.en: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.
description.zh: 居中全局搜索弹窗：提供类似 Spotlight 与 IntelliJ 的会话及聊天消息实时检索与上下文预览。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query…
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage SSH hosts, SFTP and terminal sessions, with encrypted saved passwords. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理 SSH 主机、SFTP 和终端会话，可加密保存密码。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0。

description.en: ★ 58 │ Drive remote servers from the conversation: interactive terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding and database management.
description.zh: ★ 58 │ 在会话中操作远程服务器，使用终端、SFTP 文件管理、端口转发和数据库工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: SSH remote ops and dev toolkit (run/read/write/edit/glob/grep/push/pull), ControlMaster connection layer, status panel, and host management in Settings.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 SSH 执行远程命令和文件读写、搜索、传输，在设置中管理主机与连接状态。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection…
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Multi-host SSH tunnel and SSHManager tool for DeepSeek Harness, with project-scoped grants.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 管理多台主机的 SSH 隧道，并按项目授予连接权限。

description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the…
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode…
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 窗口的原生侧栏中管理 SSH / WSL / Docker 项目。目录按环境归组，每个项目独立选择全量远程后端或本机 Agent 轻量模式；共享全量连接统一管理，轻量连接独立控制，并可比较、选择性同步本机 Skill。主要面向 Windows 桌面客户端与装有 Python 3、Bash 的…

description.en: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep…
description.zh: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

description.en: Pre-execute hook that denies writes under a read-only result zone of protected roots; every other path passes through.
description.zh: pre-execute 钩子：拒绝写入受保护根下只读的成果区，其余路径放行。

description.en: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the…
description.zh: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able…
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Assess tool-call risks through StartLux. Requires a Bamboo Relay API Key and sends tool arguments and recent context to the configured service. Disabled by default; shadow mode records decisions, and errors allow the call through.
description.zh: 通过 StartLux 评估工具调用风险，需 Bamboo Relay API Key，并向配置的服务发送工具参数和近期上下文。默认关闭；观察模式只记录判断，异常时放行。

description.en: DSH startup animation and background plugin: plays a local video full-screen at launch without blocking startup, plus a persistent background video layer with adjustable opacity and playback controls.
description.zh: 启动时播放本地全屏视频，也可设置常驻动态背景，调整透明度和播放方式。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines…
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
description.zh: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

description.en: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, optional question…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可在通知中显示提问正文、可选的原生 Windows/WSL 通知通道（可越过专注助手），没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

description.en: A cross-session project board for managing projects, plans, tasks, and external document references in the DSH web UI and agent tools. Verified on Windows 11…
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面和 agent 工具中跨会话管理项目、计划、任务和外置文档引用。仅在 Windows 11 x64 上验证过。

description.en: Configurable static launch token for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI across restarts and reverse proxies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 配置固定的静态启动令牌，方便跨服务重启和反向代理访问。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a…
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: ★ 229 │ Turn the DSH Web status line into a 1317-phrase meme machine: phase-aware phrases, typewriter, rainbow gradient, danmaku and 14 theme packs, all editable from the settings page.
description.zh: ★ 229 │ 按运行阶段显示可编辑文案、主题与状态栏动画。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 显示账户额度、Git 状态、上下文、公开 API 参考费用、Subagents 活动和生成速度。

description.en: Reads a few lines of a txt or epub novel inside the sidebar bottom panel, styled to pass for scratch notes; pages with Ctrl+Alt+J/K and keeps progress locally.…
description.zh: 把 txt / epub 小说藏进侧栏底部面板，一屏只显示几行、看着像随手记的草稿；Ctrl+Alt+J/K 翻页，进度存在本地。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 0.26 以上，阅读器只存在于它的底部面板里。

description.en: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for text, images, and files, with read and pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加独立插话栏，支持文字、图片和普通文件，显示读取状态并可在未读取时取消，任务结束时救援未发送草稿。

description.en: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max),…
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一条推理强度滑轨：拖动或用键盘预览并提交当前模型支持的档位（Off 到 Max），滑轨背后由程序实时渲染的微缩宇宙随档位收缩、坍缩成黑洞。档位通过 DSH 自身的模型选择接口提交，显示的是 DSH 确认后的等级；插件只写入 $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/。

description.en: Deterministic step governance for DSH agents: rejects over-budget agent steps and denies risky tool executions before they run, with shadow mode by default and…
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供确定性步数治理，在超预算的 agent 步执行前拒绝、在风险工具调用执行前阻断，默认影子模式，出错时放行不阻断业务。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Pick and preview stickers by emotion and collection. Uses your own image library and catalog; requires Node >=22 and Python 3.10+ or the DSH bundled Python. No DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 按情绪和素材组挑选、预览表情包。需自备素材库与索引，并使用 Node >=22、Python 3.10+ 或 DSH 捆绑 Python；未声明 DSH 兼容范围。

description.en: A sticky-notes panel for DSH with a draggable floating window, a full sidebar page, Markdown preview, pasted images and configurable settings.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 便签面板，支持可拖动悬浮窗、侧栏整页、Markdown 预览、粘贴图片与设置项，数据仅存于浏览器本地。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: Sticky notes on a wall, with five paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of pin, tape or clip.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的便签墙：五种纸面、五种墨色、七种字体、四档字号，图钉或胶带或回形针固定，随手记下自动保存。

description.en: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or…
description.zh: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: Multi-market watchlist and portfolio tracker for DSH: a draggable floating capsule with live price and change percent, grouped watchlists for A-share, HK, US…
description.zh: DSH 多市场盯盘与持仓查看：可拖拽悬浮胶囊显示现价与涨跌幅，A股/港股/美股/加密货币分组自选与拖拽排序，持仓盈亏按币种汇总，目标价触达显示 B/S 标记，分时与日/周/月 K 线；可选与 quota-watch 合并为单枚两段胶囊。数据存 DSH 实例，跨浏览器共享。行情取自东方财富、腾讯财经和 OKX…

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.
description.zh: A 股 / 港股 / 美股与板块自选面板，带分时迷你走势图，并向 agent 提供 stock_quote 工具。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded…
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF…

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove`…
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: ★ 95 │ Adds a conversation minimap, message anchors and a prompt overview to the DSH web interface. Uses the current session export to load history; no DSH version range is declared.
description.zh: ★ 95 │ 为 DSH 网页界面添加会话缩略地图、消息锚点与提问总览，通过当前会话导出加载历史；未声明 DSH 版本范围。

description.en: ★ 27 │ Keep current reasoning visible and fold older thinking and tool output into compact summaries.
description.zh: ★ 27 │ 展示当前思考，将较早的思考与工具输出折叠为简短摘要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Persona mode + structured output for DSH: identity header, three cards and signature rendered by the plugin while the model only submits a persona JSON…
description.zh: DSH 人格模式 + 结构化输出：身份头 / 三卡 / 收尾由插件渲染，模型只交 persona 内容块；人格默认开启、可显式关闭，结构化按会话开关。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks…
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished…
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Learning-mode agent preset for DSH with a topic knowledge base: answers retrieve from your own stored cards and cite the card they came from, mark anything not…
description.zh: 学习模式 agent 预设 + 主题知识库：回答先从你自己存的卡片里检索，命中就标出处，查不到标「未验证」，必须查证才联网；侧边栏面板按主题浏览、搜索、编辑卡片，每张卡可 AI 校验补充、核实、回退和看版本；卡片之间可以用 `[[标题]]` 互链，面板里能看到「它连着谁」和「谁引用了它」；新卡片先出预览，确认后才入库；…

description.en: Fork selected text into contextual learning branches, continue native DSH chat in each session, and navigate the branches in a tree.
description.zh: 划词派生继承上下文的学习分支，在每个会话中继续原生 DSH 聊天，并用树状导航切换分支。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Manage interface and code fonts, sizes, weights, three-color themes and named appearance presets in Settings. Uses fonts available on the client; verified by the author on Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在外观设置统一管理界面与代码字体、字号、字重、三色主题和命名外观方案。使用客户端已有字体；作者实测 Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show account quota, subscription type and daily statistics in the session header, with refresh and error notices.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在会话标题栏显示账号额度、订阅类型与今日统计，支持刷新和异常提示。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool.…
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy…

description.en: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the…
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Sets default models for DSH subagents, with sequential or random assignment across models and cross-vendor failover on connection errors. Shows the current vendor and model in trajectory and conversation views.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 为子 Agent 分配默认模型，支持顺序或随机选择，以及连接失败时切换供应商。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in…
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Run a task in a fresh, isolated DSH runtime (dsh --profile headless) with its own DSH_HOME, session and model routing, and return only the final answer to the parent session through the subagent_dsh tool. Note: the startup handshake timeout does not take effect yet, so a child that never becomes ready can keep the call waiting.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 把任务交给全新、隔离的 DSH 运行时（dsh --profile headless）执行，独立 DSH_HOME、会话与模型路由，只通过 subagent_dsh 工具把最终回答带回父会话。注意：启动握手超时目前不生效，子运行时未就绪时调用可能一直等待。

description.en: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation…
description.zh: 为官方子智能体工具提供具名预设与模型路由白名单：越界的子模型在派发前被拒绝，子会话标题栏显示最近一次请求实际使用的模型。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with…
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide…
description.zh: 在输入框旁的「子代理」胶囊里统一设置委派子代理使用的 provider、模型与思考强度：卡片的「本对话 / 全局默认」两个范围共用同一组控件，胶囊上始终显示当前生效的路由；在每个进程内子代理创建时生效（agent/created + agent.model.select()），不注册设置页、不改 agent…

description.en: One-shot OMP subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness — each delegation spawns the local `omp --print --mode json` CLI running with the user's own ~/.omp…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一次性子代理提供器——每次委派都会启动本地 `omp --print --mode json` CLI，沿用用户自己的 ~/.omp 配置与模型绑定运行，且委派串行执行，单会话本地引擎不会被并发压垮。需本机已安装 OMP（oh-my-pi）CLI，并要求 DSH…

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full…
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token…
description.zh: 给子智能体配命名模型路由：每个别名绑定子智能体代理、模型与可选的思考档位、令牌上限、Agent 预设、标签，并写清「何时使用」供模型选路，委派时只写别名。插件提供委派、查目录、改配置、等后台、释放五个工具，在设置页完成全部配置（两级下拉、逐项校验），在子代理会话头部显示其实际运行的路由，界面元素均可单独停用；配置存于本…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Group subagents by usage batch, delete individual agents or groups with confirmation, and select models from the current catalog. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or later.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 按使用批次分组子代理，支持二次确认后单个或整组删除，并从实时目录选择模型。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 或更高版本。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
description.zh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Shows the balance or quota behind the current conversation's model for DeepSeek, Kimi Code and OpenAI, plus local usage and priced estimates for every provider…
description.zh: 按当前会话模型显示 DeepSeek、Kimi Code 与 OpenAI 的余额或配额，并为 DSH 中配置的每个提供商提供本地用量与价格估算。

description.en: One settings page that lists every subscription sign-in the harness can offer and walks you through it — ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter,…
description.zh: 把所有订阅登录收进一个设置页：列表直接读授权 seam 上注册的流程，引导你走完 ChatGPT (Codex)、Claude、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter、Kimi 与 xAI，并列出已无人认领的旧凭据记录。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ DeepSeek Harness 的统一订阅供应商与用量看板。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Show clickable follow-up suggestions below replies and send a selected suggestion as a user message.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 在回复下方显示可点击的后续建议，选中后作为用户消息发送。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Adds input prediction to the DSH composer: suggests your next message after each turn (Tab to accept), and completes prefixes from session history as you type.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 在每轮结束后建议下一条消息，支持 Tab 采纳，并根据会话历史补全输入。

description.en: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables,…
description.zh: 用原生 UI 卡片代替 Markdown 回答：模型调用 render_ui，答案直接渲染成对话里的卡片——29 种区块（指标、表格、图表、时间线、看板、流程图、可点击按钮）、content 自动排版模式、四种落位（正文内联、过程折叠区、输入框上方看板、回合尾卡）、原生设置表单，以及可选的自动「下一步」卡片。卡片按会话…

description.en: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average…
description.zh: 提供一个更快、更节省、更准确的编码 Agent 预设。在按多维难度规则筛选的 SWE-bench Pro 高难度 100 题评测中，平均耗时减少 36%，平均每题输入 token 减少 17%，正确率提高 5 个百分点。

description.en: Desktop-bundle fork of the DeepSeek Harness team's dsh-superagent research prototype: turns requests from allowed people on GitHub issues or Feishu into…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 团队 dsh-superagent 研究原型的桌面 bundle 分支：把名单内的人在 GitHub issue 或飞书里提出的请求变成工单，交给相互隔离的 DSH 会话处理，面板里管理来源、部署、提示词与运行记录。默认只有来源名单里的人能发起工作。GitHub 来源需要 git…

description.en: Super input suite — model and effort picker, prompt enhancer, follow-up suggestion chips, a full cost engine with daily heatmap and Coding Plan quotas,…
description.zh: 超级输入框套件——模型与推理强度选择器、提示词增强、跟进建议 chips、带每日热力图与 Coding Plan 配额的完整费用引擎、语音输入光效与转写清理（需先启用官方语音输入包）、Prompt 模板库、划选引用与评论 chip、压缩圆环和设置总览。已并入作者原独立插件 dsh-cost、dsh-power-pick…

description.en: ★ 12 │ Register Superpowers development skills and session guidance with the DSH skills and prompt services.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 接入 Superpowers 开发技能，并向会话提示词添加使用引导。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Replace SurfCore 0.8.8 memory-card decay with configurable score lifetimes and daily, long-term and permanent tiers. A companion patcher for the installed desktop-profile SurfCore, with verification, backup and rollback; changes local SurfCore files and requires a restart.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为 SurfCore 0.8.8 的记忆卡替换可调节的分数寿命与日常、长期、永久档位。它是 desktop profile 已安装 SurfCore 的配套补丁，校验后备份、应用并可回滚，会修改本机 SurfCore 文件，需重启。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Let long-running scripts report structured progress that DSH Web shows in a floating panel and a sidebar tab, without waiting for the command to finish.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 长时间运行的脚本可以上报结构化进度，在 DSH Web 的悬浮窗和右侧栏实时显示，不用等命令结束。

description.en: Adds a Task Progress tab to the conversation view, next to the Context tab, with a progress bar for the session's todo list and completed items ordered by…
description.zh: 在会话顶部“上下文”标签右侧增加“任务进度”标签页，用进度条显示已完成与未完成的任务，已完成项按完成顺序排列。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after…
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per…
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a…
description.zh: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

description.en: Organizes task materials and supports session handoffs across workspaces.
description.zh: 整理任务资料，支持跨工作区的会话交接。

description.en: Local-first task workbench for DeepSeek Harness with today, week and all-task views, single-day and multi-day tasks with optional times, a four-state idea…
description.zh: 本地优先的任务工作台：今日/本周/任务总表、当天与跨周期任务（可选时间）、四态想法池，以及日/周/月复盘；复盘正文只能人写，AI 只读。

description.en: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/…
description.zh: 任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。

description.en: ★ 84 │ Track project tasks and run them in sessions with optional per-task Git worktrees.
description.zh: ★ 84 │ 跟踪项目任务并在会话中执行，可为任务配置独立 Git 工作树。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be…
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files…
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: ★ 20 │ Manage character cards, worldbooks, presets, memory and plot options; some features require companion plugins.
description.zh: ★ 20 │ 管理角色卡、世界书、预设、记忆和剧情选项；部分功能需配套插件。

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin…
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real…
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

description.en: Browse and search Tencent ima knowledge bases, read files in an in-panel dock, and add links, files and notes via the ima OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在 Harness 面板中浏览与检索腾讯 ima 知识库，在内置分栏阅读文件，并通过 ima 开放接口添加网页链接、文件与笔记。

description.en: Tencent Agent Mail client: a sidebar panel for inbox and sent browsing, HTML reading in a sandboxed frame with remote images blocked by default,…
description.zh: 腾讯智能体邮箱（Agent Mail）客户端：侧边栏面板浏览收件箱与发件箱，HTML 正文在沙箱内渲染并默认拦截外链图片，支持写信、回复、转发、附件收发、搜索与永久删除，可调字体与界面透明度；另注册 5 个工具（mail_health、mail_list、mail_read、mail_search、mail_send）…

description.en: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.
description.zh: 集成 TencentDB Agent Memory，支持对话捕获、结构化记忆提取、自动召回，以及记忆和对话搜索工具。

description.en: Agent-team orchestration sidecar for DSH: teams with a configurable member cap, real sub-agent members with per-member model routing, task DAGs that dispatch…
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 团队编排 sidecar：成员上限可配，成员是真实的 sub-agent 且可单独指定模型；任务按 DAG 依赖自动派发；fs/exec/net/env 四域权限由 broker 强制；运行过程通过 SSE 在 Web 面板实时查看。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with…
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive…
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel for TeamAI skills, MCP, and prompts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于团队技能、MCP 和提示词管理与同步。

description.en: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 遥控器：在手机上接续正在运行的 Web 会话并回答问题，界面为俄语。hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的俄语分支（MIT）。

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

description.en: Telegram look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — a solid-colour wallpaper with a tinted doodle pattern, a floating chat-list card, session rows with avatars and…
description.zh: 为 DSH 换上 Telegram 的主题——纯色底加染色涂鸦图案的墙纸、浮动的会话列表卡片、带头像和时间的会话行、消息气泡、悬浮输入条，以及经典、玻璃、粉色三套配色

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the…
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a Temporary tasks section above the workspace list, where one click creates a timestamped folder, workspace and session; tasks support search, sort, pin,…
description.zh: 在工作区列表上方增加独立的「临时任务」区：一键创建带时间戳的文件夹、工作区与会话；支持搜索、排序、置顶、重命名与归档，可把任务移入普通工作区，未发过消息的任务会自动回收。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Checks tender-document clause excerpts against the original text, verifying completeness by source and verbatim wording; flags differences only, with no qualitative conclusions.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 依据出处与原文逐字核对招标文件条款摘录的完整性；仅提示差异，不作定性结论。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each…
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Extract dates, deposits and bid requirements from a tender document. Missing matches do not prove absence; supplementary documents need separate review. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0 and Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 从招标主文件提取时间、保证金和投标要求；未匹配不等于不存在，补充文件需另行核对。需 DSH >=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0、Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized…
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Keeps terminology in two-level plain-text glossaries and injects a term's meaning the first time it appears in a session.
description.zh: 把约定俗成的称谓存成两层纯文本字典，某个词第一次出现时自动把它的口径注入上下文；带查／写／体检三条工具与设置面板。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts,…
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js;…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: Installs and runs Android native command-line tools from inside DSH: fetches aarch64 bionic packages from the Termux repository, unpacks them in pure JS and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 内部安装并运行 Android 原生命令行工具：从 Termux 仓库取 aarch64 bionic 包、纯 JS 解包，再经 /system/bin/linker64 执行，无需 root、Shizuku 或外部包管理器。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No…
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm),…
description.zh: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching…
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and…
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
description.zh: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting…
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured…
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: ★ 0 │ A small easter egg when a task finishes, an optional desktop pet, and local water, meal and rest reminders. Works only inside the open web page; sends no system notifications or model requests.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 任务完成时的小彩蛋，可选常驻桌宠，以及本地喝水、吃饭、休息提醒。只在打开的网页里工作，不发系统通知，也不发模型请求。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: Animal Island theme with boarding-pass masthead, cream notebook paper, 118 ThemeRuntime tokens, in-app appearance presets, and starry night mode.
description.zh: 动森风手账主题：渡岛船票品牌区、奶油手账纸、覆盖 118 项 ThemeRuntime token、应用内外观设置与夜岛星空。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: ★ 169 │ A DSH Web theme in the style of the Arknights: Endfield website: cream paper, ink text, signal-yellow accents and square corners, with optional animated backgrounds.
description.zh: ★ 169 │ 参考《明日方舟：终末地》官网风格的 DSH Web 主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、信号黄强调色和直角，可选动态背景。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for…
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: EVA Unit-02 theme with an entry-plug boot cinematic, a context-based sync meter, and configurable dark interface styling.
description.zh: EVA 弐号机主题，提供插入栓启动演出、基于上下文余量的同步率表和可配置的深色界面样式。

description.en: ★ 37 │ Apply a Firefly character theme with wallpaper, colors and an opening animation.
description.zh: ★ 37 │ 应用流萤角色壁纸、主题配色与开场动画。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。

description.en: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness. Each launch starts with an about 5 second mirror-break opening: the key art appears as a glass pane, cracks…

description.en: Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with SVG edge refraction on the composer, bubbles, queue dock, menus and sidebar, translucent token overrides driven by…
