description.zh: DSH 刷贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP stdio server，支持 MCP 的客户端可尝试拉起；未逐客户端实测。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Configure DSH plugins, MCP servers and skills per client, workspace and session in the desktop and Web UI, with separate settings, inheritance and child…
description.zh: 在桌面和 Web 界面按客户端、工作区和会话分层配置 DSH 插件、MCP 与 Skill，支持独立开关、不同配置、逐级继承及下级默认。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Chat memory that archives messages by time and recalls by stated period, widening twice before admitting it forgot.
description.zh: 按时间归档聊天，用户提到某段时间就先检索，未命中扩大两次，仍没有就如实说「我忘记了」。

description.en: Gives one conversation a pinned as-of point and a dated evidence window on both sides — [as_of − before, as_of + after], past, future or BC. In restricted mode…
description.zh: 为单个对话钉住 as_of 时间点与前后两侧的带日期证据窗口——[as_of − before, as_of + after]，支持过去、未来与公元前。在受限模式下，窗口变化时只告知一次当前窗口，web_search 结果按发布日期过滤到窗口内、无日期来源一律排除，首条回复必须确认窗口（缺失时纠正一次）。另对长时间静默…

description.en: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that…
description.zh: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead…
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API peak/off-peak status, a countdown to the next switch and a mini timeline next to the DSH desktop avatar, with a 24-hour Beijing-time…
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端头像旁显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、切换倒计时与迷你时间轴，点击查看北京时间 24 小时时间轴；节假日日历从 holiday-cn 自动更新，可选在峰时段开始前 5 分钟提醒。

description.en: ★ 56 │ Timeline navigation, starred folders, prompts, quick notes and conversation export for DSH Web. Data stays in browser storage; open untrusted CSV exports as text to avoid spreadsheet formulas.
description.zh: ★ 56 │ 为 DSH Web 提供时间轴、收藏文件夹、提示词、闪记与对话导出。数据保存在浏览器中；不可信 CSV 导出请按文本打开，避免表格公式执行。

description.en: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded…
description.zh: 把英文有声读物（MP3）和英文文档（PDF / Word / EPUB / 网页 / TXT）变成听力课：用 DSH 语音输入已下载的模型在本机识别每一句（缺失时首次使用自动下载约 241 MB；需 ffmpeg）、用你选的大模型逐句校对翻译讲解，再以精听、间隔复习、磨耳朵练到一听就懂；支持中文配音导出与离线…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect native web search and fetch tools to TinyFish through direct or Monid access.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 为网页搜索与抓取接入 TinyFish，支持直连或 Monid 通道。

description.en: ★ 26 │ TinyFish-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Seamlessly routes model web searches to the fast and privacy-friendly TinyFish Search API.
description.zh: ★ 26 │ 为 DSH 内置网页搜索接入 TinyFish Search API。

description.en: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you…
description.zh: 给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀，会话列表平铺展示时不必点开就能看出它属于哪个项目；你自己手动改过的标题保持原样。

description.en: Windows Desktop only. Adds a 重启 item to the DSH window caption menubar next to 应用 and 编辑; the second click stops the app and starts the same executable again…
description.zh: 仅 Windows 桌面版。在 DSH 窗口标题栏菜单（应用 / 编辑）后加一个「重启」项，连点两次即由 WMI 拉起的 PowerShell 脚本结束应用并重新启动同一个可执行文件。

description.en: Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS…
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A persistent tmux control-mode panel in DSH Web that attaches to existing tmux sessions, stays visible across chats and adapts to phones.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在 DSH Web 中常驻的 tmux 控制模式工作台，连接已有的 tmux 会话，切换聊天时保持可见，并适配手机。

description.en: Read, create and edit native Figma UI with DSH: screenshot comparison, design references, components and variables, motion, assets and scoped recovery. Local…
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言读取、创建和编辑 Figma UI，支持参考图比对、设计参考、组件与变量、动效、素材和局部恢复。默认走本地配套插件，保留官方 MCP 接入；需 Figma 桌面版并导入 DSH 生成的配套插件。

title.zh: 赛博小庙 · 每日运势

description.en: ★ 0 │ Draw a daily fortune in a small temple overlay, track check-in streaks and export shareable cards. Calendar calculations and state stay in the browser; requires the DSH web UI.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在小庙浮层中每日抽签、查看运势、连续打卡并导出分享卡片。历法计算和状态保存在浏览器，需要 DSH Web 界面。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind…
description.zh: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供待办清单：把划选的文字存成待办、从对话里捕获待办、在左侧栏面板里查看与处理、到期用应用内弹窗或机器人推送提醒，还能把全部记录导出成 HTML、Markdown、Excel、CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Lightweight to-do list for the DSH right sidebar: one item per line, check off to complete, collapsible completed items; stored locally, and the agent can add, check and delete via todo_panel.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在侧栏逐项管理待办，勾选完成、折叠已完成项，支持 Agent 添加和修改。

description.en: ★ 1 │ DSH todo floating ball: a draggable widget showing live progress of the session's todo_write list (total, done, in progress), with click to expand and status colours. Works on desktop and web.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 用可拖动悬浮球显示待办总数、完成数和进行中任务，点击可展开清单。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold…
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via…
description.zh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

description.en: Keeps a repository's task ledger as a resident prompt section with eleven native tools, plus a sidebar panel and a floating window for browsing the queue and…
description.zh: 把仓库里的任务账本做成常驻提示段与十一个原生工具，另有侧栏面板与浮动窗，可浏览队列并签收待复核任务。

description.en: A draggable sticky note beside the chat: short-term tasks and a long-term plan whose phases carry real progress, plus three todo_note_* tools (read, update,…
description.zh: 对话旁的可拖动便签：短期待办，加上带真实阶段进度的长期计划，并通过 todo_note_read / todo_note_update / todo_note_complete 三个工具让 agent 与你在同一份便签上协作；任务须经你点击确认才算完成，状态只保存在本机。

description.en: A three-scope TODO board for DeepSeek Harness (user, workspace and session) with nested folders that can reference one item from several places, T0–T9…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三区 TODO 便签（用户 / 工作区 / 会话）：支持嵌套文件夹与同一条目多处引用、T0~T9 优先级、拖动排序、批量操作、可浮动也可作为右侧栏页签打开的面板、可保留且自动保存标题与正文的 Markdown 预览，以及智能体读工具与每次写入都经 DSH 审批的写工具。

description.en: A task progress sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web and desktop, opened from the top-right Tasks button, with completion percentage, current step, status filters…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web / 桌面客户端的任务进度侧栏：从右上角“任务”打开，查看完成比例、当前步骤，按状态筛选并展开待办详情；验证于 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1，兼容 0.2.1-rc.5。

description.en: A global personal to-do list that is independent of any session: sidebar panel plus an edge dock that peeks on hover and pops open when a task is due, with…
description.zh: 全局个人待办（与任何会话无关）：侧边栏面板 + 贴边待办条（悬停探出、快到点自动弹开），到期桌面通知与自定义音效。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Track todo creation and completion times in table, board, Gantt and calendar views, with workspace file references, a /todo command and an agent tool. Data stays in local JSON; requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.3-0.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 记录待办创建与完成时间，通过表格、看板、甘特图和日历查看，支持工作区文件引用、/todo 命令和 Agent 工具。数据保存在本地 JSON，需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.2.3-0。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Manage projects, labels, priorities and recurring tasks, with natural-language capture, statistics, import/export and agent tools.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 管理项目、标签、优先级和重复任务，支持自然语言添加、统计、导入导出及 Agent 工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show the signed-in DeepSeek account balance under the composer, with recharge and bonus breakdowns and periodic refresh. Reads through the host account client without storing an API key.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在输入框下方显示已登录 DeepSeek 账户的可用余额、充值与赠送余额分项，并定期刷新。通过宿主账户客户端读取，不保存 API Key。

description.en: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output…
description.zh: 在每条回复的图标行里画一条单轮用量条：灰/黄/绿分段条配百分比图例，显示该轮未缓存输入、缓存读取与输出的拆分与各自占比。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Estimate conversation costs with reference rates for 16 vendors, long-context tiers and DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing. The breakdown supports eight display currencies using public exchange-rate services. Estimates may differ from provider bills.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 内置 16 家厂商参考费率，按长上下文阶梯及 DeepSeek 峰谷时段估算会话费用。明细可切换八种币种，汇率来自公开服务；估算以服务商实际账单为准。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量：会话抽屉与今日 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天面板，图表与指标可配置。

description.en: Sidebar token and cost curve for the current conversation plus a local ledger across all sessions: monthly/weekly rollups, per-turn detail, Excel export with…
description.zh: 右栏 Token 曲线 + 账本：当前对话逐轮 token 与费用，本机全部会话按月/周汇总，逐轮明细可导出 Excel，顶部实时显示账户余额。只读会话日志，逐条按峰谷计价，分叉会话抄来的历史不重复计费。仅桌面端，仅在 Windows 上验证；实时余额需登录 DSH 账号。

description.en: Token dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: per-provider monthly budgets, subscription quotas (GLM / Kimi Coding), account balances, and time-range cost and…
description.zh: DSH Token 看板：按供应商的月度预算、订阅配额（GLM / Kimi Coding）、账户余额，支持当天 / 7 天 / 30 天 / 全部范围查看费用与真实 Tokens，并可本地导出 / 导入备份。

description.en: Sidebar token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live output-speed dial, current-session and today token totals, estimated spend from DeepSeek list prices with half…
description.zh: 侧边栏 Token 仪表盘：实时输出速度表、当前会话与今日 Token 用量、按 DeepSeek 列表价（峰谷半价）估算的费用，以及 70–100% 缓存命中率表盘，支持单表/双表两种布局与四种皮肤。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show cumulative tokens across local DSH sessions in the header and keep a local ledger after session deletion. Requires Host connection authentication; long uninterrupted event bursts can affect live counting.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在顶栏显示本机 DSH 会话累计 Token，删会话后保留本地账本。需要宿主连接认证；长时间连续事件可能影响实时计数。

description.en: Cost panel for DeepSeek Harness: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows…
description.zh: DSH 费用统计面板：从 session 事件采集每次请求用量，按内置 16 家厂商 136 个模型的价格目录实时计费，在输入框旁展示当前模型、账户余额、本会话/今日/本月消费与月度预算横条。中英双语。

description.en: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的实时草稿 token 数、按官方高峰/空闲费率计算的会话花费、上下文占用，以及同样的用量在最贵的另一个模型上会花多少；纯客户端，没有 host 半，不接触凭据。

description.en: Token cost monitoring, call-efficiency analysis and reversible tool-output caching for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 成本监控、调用效率分析与可逆工具输出缓存。

description.en: Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends,…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏加入 Token 用量与花费面板：直接采用 DeepSeek 官方用量接口（今日消费、7/30 天趋势、今日分时、历史表、成本构成、峰谷分档计价），并用本机会话日志给出按会话明细。凭据零配置——自动读取浏览器登录态取官方数据，取不到时退回本地日志并标明来源。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/ca…
description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/额度余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均时延，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Deterministic, recoverable tool-result compression and cache-aware compaction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 压缩工具输出并保留恢复能力，结合缓存状态压缩上下文。

description.en: Shows where every session's tokens go: lifetime totals, cache hit rate, peak/off-peak cost, a calendar heatmap, a trend chart, per-model and per-workspace…
description.zh: 看清每个会话的 token 去向：累计总量、缓存命中率、峰谷分时成本、日历热力图、趋势曲线、模型与工作区分布，以及展开展示子代理的会话树，支持 CSV / JSON 导出。另带上下文清理 / 压缩按钮与提示词优化按钮。

description.en: ★ 58 │ A bilingual floating pet for DeepSeek Harness with runtime status, context and lifetime token usage, trends, and optional completion sounds.
description.zh: ★ 58 │ 用浮动角色展示运行状态、上下文与累计 Token 用量。

description.en: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints…
description.zh: 跟随当前模型供应商的额度徽标：DeepSeek、千问 Token Plan、阿里云费用中心取官方真值，Moonshot / OpenRouter 已接官方端点但字段未用真 Key 核对；其余只报本实例实测。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and…
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: Appends the current turn's estimated token cost in CNY to the assistant action row, right after the usage/time indicator. Prices come from a built-in DeepSeek…
description.zh: 在本轮对话的操作行「用量 / 时间」右侧追加该轮 token 费用估算（人民币）。单价来自内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价目（北京时间，周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），可在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里整表覆盖；没有配置单价的模型显示「¥—」，不套用其它价格。跟随…

description.en: Token usage dashboard and per-session tree statistics: provides time-range filtering, 6 summary metric cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap, model stacked-bar…
description.zh: Token 用量统计看板与会话树用量统计：提供快捷时间范围筛选、6 个汇总指标卡片、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、分模型堆叠柱状图与缓存命中率平滑曲线，以及按模型和供应商的 Top5 排行；接管并增强会话底部状态栏，汇总主智能体与全部子智能体的完整用量及分项明细。

description.en: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
description.zh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent…
description.zh: DSH Token 用量统计插件 - 今日 Token 用量按模型分桶、缓存命中率、7 日趋势图、可选顶栏徽标、持久化存储自动清理。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month…
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: DSH port of TokenEconomizer with cross-session project knowledge, opt-in tool pruning, failure-loop redirection, and token usage records.
description.zh: TokenEconomizer 的 DSH 移植版，提供跨会话项目知识、需主动应用的工具裁剪、失败循环引导与 token 用量记录。

description.en: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals,…
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices),…
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.
description.zh: 在输入栏状态栏中实时显示当前流式响应解码速度（tok/s）的插件。

description.en: ★ 1,048 │ Organize media projects and assets, then run TongFlow image, voice, music and video workflows on an embedded canvas.
description.zh: ★ 1,048 │ 按项目整理媒体素材，在内嵌画布中运行 TongFlow 图片、配音、音乐和视频流程。

description.en: ★ 15 │ Load only basic DeepSeek Harness tools by default and activate other tools on demand.
description.zh: ★ 15 │ 默认仅加载基础 DeepSeek Harness 工具，其他工具按需激活。

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image…
description.zh: 接入 Google Antigravity OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能多账号池额度自愈轮换、全系多模型流式路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

description.en: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
description.zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

description.en: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the…
description.zh: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar…

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Adds 17 barotrauma_* tools to DeepSeek Harness for making Barotrauma mods: environment probing, mod skeleton, item and weapon XML, afflictions, creatures,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 17 个 barotrauma_* 工具，用于制作潜渊症 mod：环境探测、内容包骨架、物品/武器/状态效果/角色/随机事件 XML、Lua 与 C# 脚本脚手架、本地化、校验、图标生成、打包与创意工坊发布文案。barotrauma_gen_icon 会把你的提示词发到…

description.en: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。

description.en: Grabs a live frame from the local webcam and hands it to the agent as an image, so the model can actually look through the camera without opening any app or…
description.zh: 从本机摄像头抓一帧实时画面，以图片形式交给 agent，让它真正从摄像头看见画面——不用打开相机应用，也不要求窗口在前台。暗光房间不会再拍成一片黑，亮度、伽马、对比度、锐化和自动拉伸都在抓帧时一次做完。首次使用时自动下载 ffmpeg，配套还有一个工具用于列出可用采集设备。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: Hides or disables specific tools for a customized list of agent presets, such as tools another plugin adds to every preset. Hidden tools are removed from the…
description.zh: 为自定义的一组智能体预设隐藏或禁用特定工具，例如其他插件添加到所有预设的工具。隐藏的工具会从工具列表中移除，不占用 token；拒绝的工具调用会被拒绝。还可以清空其他插件添加的系统提示词。通过 YAML 配置。安装后需在 YAML 里加一行配置才会生效。

description.en: Progressive tool discovery through tool_list, tool_search and tool_load, exposing tool schemas on demand while preserving host execution permissions.
description.zh: 通过 tool_list、tool_search 和 tool_load 渐进式发现工具，按需披露工具 schema，保留宿主执行权限约束。

description.en: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading…
description.zh: 读、造、拆 EPUB 3 电子书，零外部依赖 —— ZIP 读写器与 XML 扫描器均为自建。可体检元数据/阅读顺序/目录并点出结构问题，从章节拼出一本合规的书，或把已有的书拆回逐章 HTML。

description.en: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit,…
description.zh: 设置面板里的技能与 MCP 管理控制台：跨全部来源合并的技能目录（按来源分级浏览、在线新建与编辑、模型 / 用户调用独立开关、可恢复回收站）、GitHub 安装（多选批量安装、检查更新）、通过 profile patch 层增删改与启停 MCP 服务器、从 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex /…

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image…
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request;…
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按…

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
description.zh: 公众号发布管线：先按发布闸门校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments…
description.zh: DSH web 插件：给 bash/pwsh 命令与 read 的代码输出做分层语法染色（VS Code Dark+ 配色：关键字/字符串/数字/函数名/注释各一色）；认得出来才染，表格/日志保持原样；纯前端渲染，零 token 开销。

description.en: Sends deferred MCP tool definitions as an index of names, parameter signatures and one-line summaries grouped by server, with tool_details returning a full…
description.zh: 把延迟加载的 MCP 工具定义以索引形式发送——按服务器分组的名称、参数签名和一行摘要；tool_details 按需返回完整 schema，call_tool 运行真正的工具。读取 schema 或运行工具不会改变模型可见的工具列表，因此不会使提示缓存失效。

description.en: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag…
description.zh: 从文本中提取发票号码、日期、购销方、税号与金额/税额/合计，并验算「金额 + 税额 = 价税合计」是否成立，对不上就报出来。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。

description.en: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a…
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

description.en: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final…
description.zh: 通过 nanobot_run 工具把本机 nanobot CLI agent 当作 DSH 子代理运行：每次只交给它一个自包含任务并仅返回最终答案，可按次启动进程，也可走常驻的 OpenAI 兼容服务。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate…
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while…
description.zh: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run…

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and…
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a…
description.zh: 用本机 ffmpeg 把一期录音做成可发布的播客 —— 从静音里检出章节断点、按断点切段、两遍算法把响度归一化到广播目标，并写出 iTunes 兼容的 RSS（enclosure 字节长度实测自磁盘，避免客户端静默丢弃）。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe,…
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive…

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing…
description.zh: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。

description.en: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and…
description.zh: 即时、尾部加权、行吸附的工具输出修剪插件：挂载于执行流水线即时截断超大命令输出，内置语义提纯器与 ANSI 剥离。

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files,…
description.zh: 在侧栏上下文菜单中添加删除会话操作，删除前通过模态框实时展示日志大小与活跃状态，并完整清理日志文件、投影缓存与内存注册表杜绝复活。

description.en: ★ 105 │ Task priorities, full checklists and a draggable floating task panel. Coexists as todo_write_plus; requires Node.js 24+ and the declared DSH 0.2 prerelease range.
description.zh: ★ 105 │ 提供优先级、完整清单与可拖动浮动任务面板，默认以 todo_write_plus 共存；需 Node.js 24+ 和声明的 DSH 0.2 预发布兼容范围。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the…
description.zh: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate…
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

description.en: ★ 8 │ Serves web_search and web_fetch from switchable backends such as Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and TinyFish, chosen per conversation from the composer. Installs the enhanced search and fetch plugins together; remove their standalone 0.1.x versions first.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 用可切换的后端（Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、TinyFish 等）提供 web_search 与 web_fetch，每个会话在输入框中选择连接。会一并安装增强搜索与抓取插件，安装前需先移除两者的 0.1.x 独立版本。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list /…
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete /…

description.en: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing…
description.zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

description.en: ★ 46 │ Responsive MCP management UI and skills manager for DeepSeek Harness Web — floating panel, JSON import, profile-backed Host Remote management, and a skill market with a hard license gate.
description.zh: ★ 46 │ 在浮动面板中管理 MCP 和技能，导入配置，并浏览带许可证检查的技能市场。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with…
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable,…
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Control built-in and plugin tools and customize the system prompt. Chat mode replaces the host prompt and can ask for approval before web calls; requires Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 管理内置及插件工具的开关和系统提示词。聊天模式会替换宿主提示词，可在网络调用前请求授权；需要 Node >=22。

description.en: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧栏里工作区上方的全局面板入口收成侧栏底部的一个开关。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with…
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: Splits a session into turns and incrementally clusters them into named topics and stages, with per-topic token / tool / time stats, a workflow view, a turn…
description.zh: 把会话按轮次聚合成话题与阶段，按话题统计 token / 工具 / 耗时，提供工作流、时间线、关系图谱三种视图和单轮 AI 分析。

description.en: Account-based access to the ToTonAI gateway inside DeepSeek Harness: sign in or register in the settings panel, use 65 mainstream models (GPT, Claude, Gemini,…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用账号接入 ToTonAI 中转站:设置面板里登录或注册,使用 65 个主流模型(GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、豆包、Grok、GLM),并可在同一面板选档位、显示收款码、付款后申报开通。上游 API Key 只留在服务器上。

description.en: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and…
description.zh: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Plan multi-agent tasks in isolated worktrees and merge results through review gates.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 安排多个 Agent 在独立 Git 工作树中执行任务，经审查确认后合并结果。

description.en: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's…
description.zh: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Start a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard from a DSH tool: pick primary and secondary metrics, set the improvement direction and optional EMA smoothing for existing training logs. Read-only; requires Python 3.10+ and TensorBoard.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 DSH 工具启动本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页，可选主要和辅助指标、改善方向与 EMA 平滑，查看已有训练日志。只读取日志，需要 Python 3.10+ 和 TensorBoard。

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

description.en: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity…
description.zh: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

description.en: (UI enhancement) Frosted-glass background for the whole app: one slider blends from a genuinely blurred, milky frost to a fully transparent page, and every…
description.zh: （UI 增强）整页磨砂背景：一条滑杆从真实模糊的磨砂过渡到完全透明，所有区域、组件与展开面板作为画在 body::before 上的同一张纸一起变化；设置页有独立滑杆，另有可选的鲸鱼粒子图层，随鼠标推开与拖动。浏览器里插件会自绘一层深色背景垫在磨砂之下。桌面端的效果直接画在应用窗口上：dsh 的 Windows…

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real…
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP…

description.en: Travel expense reconciliation: ingest orders, invoices and card lines, deduplicate, run the three-way match and a read-only policy check, then export — 5…
description.zh: 差旅费用核对：导入订单、发票与卡流水，去重、三单匹配与只读政策校验后导出——5 个 `travel.*` 工具。

description.en: Blinks the Windows notification-area icon the way QQ and WeChat do for an unread message — the app's own icon alternating with a fully transparent frame — and…
description.zh: 任务完成、或有会话在等你审批/回答时，让 Windows 通知区域的图标像 QQ、微信收到消息那样一闪一闪（原图标与全透明帧交替），同时闪任务栏按钮。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets /…
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Restart control for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. A session header button or a tray icon stops the app and its host process, waits for both to…
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启开关。会话头部按钮与系统托盘图标都会结束应用及其 Host 进程、等待完全退出、清理残留的 profile 锁，然后重新拉起应用，装好新插件后不必手动退出再进。

description.en: ★ 5 │ Browse, switch and rename conversation branches, or turn a branch into an independent session.
description.zh: ★ 5 │ 用树形视图浏览、切换和重命名会话分支，也可将分支转为独立会话。

description.en: A pannable conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: inspect any turn in a side panel, return to its branch, and fork a new branch from any turn; continuous…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可平移会话树：在侧栏查看任意一轮、回到该分支，并从任意一轮分叉；连续轮次会折叠成一个节点。

description.en: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags…
description.zh: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

description.en: Multi-model layered pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: a strong model plans, a fast one drafts, a third reviews, and a failed review is reworked automatically —…
description.zh: DSH 多模型分层协同插件：强模型规划、快模型执行、第三方模型审查，审查 FAIL 自动带问题清单返工；端点、协议、模型、层级全部在设置面板里配。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management…
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: ★ 8 │ DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapper that registers the domestic trip-planner-cn Agent Skill in the DSH skill catalog, so after installation you can load SKILL.md and its references, scripts, and themes resources by name.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 将 trip-planner-cn 旅行规划技能注册到 DSH，按名称加载技能及其参考资料和脚本。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH plugin: delete an archived session's local files (transcript, projection cache and its subagent sessions) after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 经两步确认后，删除已归档会话的本地记录、缓存及关联子 Agent 会话。

description.en: ★ 2 │ List installed plugins' capabilities, prompt injections and install scripts with source locations.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 列出已装插件的能力、提示词注入和安装脚本，并提供源码位置。

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain…
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Expose a running tsm-core-dlr vector-and-graph service as MCP tools, with modeling skills and a service-status panel.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把运行中的 tsm-core-dlr 向量与图服务接为 MCP 工具，提供建模技能和服务状态面板。

description.en: Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 网页端自带的朗读，把 DSH 里的对话念出来，靠一个小浏览器扩展驱动。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示每轮与整个会话的预估费用：按 provider 上报的 token 用量（四桶）与内置官方 DeepSeek 人民币峰谷价目计价，高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价；可用本机费率表叠加其它或自部署模型的单价，没有单价的模型…

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an…
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: ★ 2 │ A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that shows the CNY cost of each completed turn. It uses per-model cache-hit/miss, cache-write, and output rates, with weekly peak-valley multipliers and promos.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 按模型价格估算每轮人民币费用，区分缓存命中、写入和输出，并考虑峰谷价及促销。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Quote earlier turns of the current conversation through the @ menu: a single turn, a whole Q&A turn, or the last few turns, with body search. Adds a reference to the draft without deleting or rewinding conversation history. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 通过 @ 菜单引用当前会话中更早的轮次：单轮、整段问答，或最近几轮，并支持正文搜索。将原文作为引用加入草稿，不删除或回退会话历史。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0。

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Auto-titles conversations after the first user+assistant exchange, with a chat header button to update or manually edit titles.
description.zh: 在首轮完整对话（提问+回复）后自动生成会话标题，并在聊天顶部工具栏提供更新/编辑标题按钮。

description.en: Per-turn and per-step cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: a Turns tab beside Chat and Trajectory with tokens, estimated cost, cache savings, and an inspector for…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的逐轮、逐步成本账本：在 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁新增 Turns 页签，显示 token、估算费用、缓存节省，以及工具参数、原始返回与来源检查器。纯客户端，价格按已记录的模型用量估算。

description.en: Per-turn cost in CNY, with 本轮 / 今日 / 会话 totals shown above the composer. Tokens are priced by model and by the moment they were spent (peak hours and…
description.zh: 按轮显示本轮花费（人民币），输入框上方常驻「本轮 / 今日 / 会话」合计；按模型与花费时刻计价（含峰谷与节假日），装了可选的搜索审计插件后可并入原生 DeepSeek 搜索费用。

description.en: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓…
description.zh: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

description.en: Per-turn cost meter and tool-loop guard for the DSH web GUI. It records model, tool and idle time for every turn, blocks runaway tool calls with a dynamic step…
description.zh: DSH 网页版的每轮成本计与工具循环护栏。记录每轮模型、工具与空转耗时，用动态步数闸门、重试熔断和慢命令拦截限制失控的工具调用，并把拆分显示为每条回复下的卡片与账本视图。

description.en: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged [turnsnap] commit (serialized…
description.zh: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 [turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student…
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME…

description.en: Registers the TypeSafe/Jev (System One) skill into DeepSeek Harness's global skill layer, so every session can classify, route, score, extract and gate on…
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe / Jev（System One 判断模型）的构建技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness 的全局技能层，让每个会话都能用带类型的判断做分类、路由、打分、抽取和置信度门控，取代「调大模型再解析回复」。不含任何密钥，API key 由使用者通过 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 提供。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the…
description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: English, Chinese and Cantonese typing practice with Pinyin and Jyutping hints, timed or passage modes, local conversation excerpts and local records.
description.zh: 英文、中文和粤语打字练习，提供拼音与粤拼提示、限时或按篇练习、本地对话语料和本机记录。

description.en: Unreal Engine 4/5 (UE4, UE5) asset browser and exporter for Windows x64: browse, preview and export cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse, with…
description.zh: 虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine 4/5，UE4/UE5）资产浏览器与导出器，仅 Windows x64：通过 CUE4Parse 浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的烘焙资产，支持模型 3D 预览、动画播放与可搜索的资产索引。Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core…

description.en: UGREEN NAS connector for UGOS Pro: 59 agent tools covering all 70 access-token permissions over OpenCLI — files, storage, task metrics, Docker, downloads, app…
description.zh: 绿联 NAS（UGOS Pro）连接器：通过访问令牌调用 OpenCLI，59 个工具覆盖全部 70 项令牌权限——文件、存储、任务指标、Docker、下载、应用管理、控制面板与全局搜索，按令牌实际授予自动增减。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接…

description.en: Keeps the overall layout of the stock UI while tightening its radii, spacing and tidiness for a calmer, more professional and more efficient look. Also adds an…
description.zh: 在保持原版 UI 大体布局不变的情况下，进行减小圆角、紧凑化、整洁化、高效化改进，使 UI 视觉更加冷静、专业、高效。同时添加余额显示。大部分改动可在设置中单独开关。

description.en: ★ 30 │ Appearance customization plugin for DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, background image, transparency and blur over the --dsw-* token system
description.zh: ★ 30 │ 调整主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊。

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用…

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the…
description.zh: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace…
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: ★ 10 │ DeepSeek design specification: unifies the Harness interface language, with targeted adaptation for community plugins and a read-only compatibility audit.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 统一 DSH 的界面样式，适配社区插件，并提供只读兼容性检查。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: ★ 2 │ A draggable wooden-fish widget that counts taps and saves its state in the browser. Maintained by TongY1n.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 可拖拽的赛博木鱼，点击累计功德，状态保存在浏览器中，由 TongY1n 维护。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the…
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.

description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one…
description.zh: 白箱两段记忆：四层用户自写的长期记忆（必须遵守／行为设定／用户画像／可选遵守）注入为系统提示词的一节；另有「临时记忆」（跨对话交接／阶段目标／等待项）独立成节、独立预算（默认 1200 字），条目完结即停止注入。长期记忆是记忆目录里可读可改的 Markdown 文件，AI 只能提议，用户在中文面板点「采纳」才写入；临时…

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with…
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Re-decodes collected subprocess bytes with strict UTF-8 then GB18030 before they reach the agent, so GBK/CP936 output from Windows cmd and PowerShell tools…
description.zh: 在字节被解码前接管子进程输出采集，按严格 UTF-8、必要时 GB18030 重新解码，Windows 下 cmd 与 PowerShell 的 GBK/CP936 输出不再变成 U+FFFD 乱码。

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else),…
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻…

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step…
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card…
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：十一个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询）、readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限设置面板，以及可开启的本地脱敏——开启后密码默认以稳定占位符出现，需要时按条目+字段单次取回，落盘会话日志中的 bitwarden 明文也会被定期擦除；面板展示的密码与动态码会打码。脱敏与日志擦除是两个独立开关。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows…
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level…
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了 44 条原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾），每条带审查清单编号。本包是学习辅助，不能替代…

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking…
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with…
description.zh: 侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Inspect profile plugins and Skills, preview updates, save snapshots and restore supported versions or Skill files after confirmation. Plugin recovery does not restore configuration, the dependency tree or presets. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 and Node >=22.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 查看当前 profile 的插件与技能、预览更新、保存快照，并在确认后恢复支持的版本或技能文件。插件恢复不还原配置、完整依赖树或预设。需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=22。
DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的…
description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log…
Version manager for the dsh host in a settings section of its own: shows the installed version against npm dist-tags, checks for updates, and installs,…
description.zh: dsh 主程序版本管理，位于独立设置分区：对照 npm dist-tags 显示已装版本、检查更新，可安装/升级/降级/重装任意已发布版本，升级前自动建本地快照，失败自动回滚，支持基于快照的回滚与升级历史。跨次版本安装前，会比对目标版本 @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings…

description.en: ★ 7 │ Configure Gemini API and Vertex AI decoding, protocols and service tiers, and inspect responses, usage and estimated costs.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 配置 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 的解码、协议和服务等级，并检查响应、用量与费用估算。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper…
description.zh: 竖屏布局（仅电脑窗口）：浏览器窗口为竖屏时，左侧导航占整列，文件 / 终端面板移到对话区上方（右上），中间分隔线可拖拽调整高度（初始高度可配）。手机 / 平板不受影响。

description.en: ★ 45 │ Use structured agent presets for mathematical exploration, solving and verification.
description.zh: ★ 45 │ 通过多 Agent 预设进行数学探索、问题求解和形式化验证。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Keep the composer focused for VibeKey or IME dictation, and navigate approval and question cards with a keyboard or knob. Enter allows once and Esc rejects on approval cards; provides no recording or speech recognition. Depends on DSH DOM markers.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 为 VibeKey 或输入法听写保持对话框焦点，支持键盘、旋钮导航审批和提问卡片。审批时 Enter 允许一次、Esc 拒绝；不含录音或语音识别，依赖 DSH 的 DOM 标记。

description.en: macOS-only frosted-glass skin for the DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop conversation pane and third-party sidebars: native vibrancy material, independent switches per…
description.zh: macOS 专用磨砂玻璃皮肤：给 DSH NEXT / DSH Desktop 的会话面板与第三方侧边栏套上原生 Vibrancy 材质，两级效果各自独立开关，可选壁纸底图并调节磨砂度，附设置页；只改背景材质，不动布局。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Download a time range of a video with yt-dlp, extract frames to check the cut, and optionally share the file as a local HTTP download. Share paths are bounded with realpath so symlinks and directory junctions cannot escape the share root. Requires DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0, Node >=22, and a local yt-dlp/ffmpeg toolchain.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 用 yt-dlp 按时间区间下载视频、抽帧核对边界，并可把成片分享为本地 HTTP 下载。分享路径用 realpath 做真实边界检查，符号链接和目录联接不能逃出共享根目录。需 DSH >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0、Node >=22，以及本机 yt-dlp/ffmpeg 工具链。

description.en: AI video creation and editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with conversation-driven revisions, multitrack timelines, audio waveforms, and MP4 export. Requires Node…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过对话生成与续改视频，支持多轨剪辑、音频波形和 MP4 导出。需要 Node 22、FFmpeg 与 Chrome；音频生成只有在你填入 API key 后才会调用千问 MaaS 接口。

description.en: Generates video through the user's own OpenAI-style asynchronous endpoint and plays the finished clip in the conversation, with live progress and cancel.
description.zh: 通过你自己的 OpenAI 风格异步接口生成视频，并在对话里播放成品，带实时进度和取消。

description.en: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes,…
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Connect an installed Video Reader core to DSH for timestamped video text, frames, queues and optional Scroll account workflows. Windows only; requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1, a separately installed core and VIDEO_READER_ROOT. Private delivery and scheduling need separate configuration.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将已安装的 Video Reader 核心接入 DSH，读取带时间文字与画面，管理队列，并可使用 Scroll 账号工作流。仅 Windows；需 DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、另装核心并设置 VIDEO_READER_ROOT，私信与调度需单独配置。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）…

description.en: ★ 122 │ Looping video background and a skippable startup clip, with local media upload and opacity controls. Startup audio is enabled by default; dark-theme switching asks by default. Media and appearance routes lack Host authentication; use only on a trusted local host.
description.zh: ★ 122 │ 循环视频背景与可跳过的开机短片，支持本地上传和透明度调节。开机声音默认开启，切换深色主题默认先询问。 媒体和外观接口尚无宿主认证，仅用于受信本机。

description.en: ★ 532 │ Turn local or online video into timestamped storyboard sheets, with scene cuts, subtitles, OCR and optional transcription. Requires FFmpeg/ffprobe; sites may need yt-dlp, and OCR or transcription need their own environment or service.
description.zh: ★ 532 │ 将本地或在线视频整理为带时间码的分镜图，支持镜头切分、字幕、OCR 及可选语音转写。需准备 FFmpeg/ffprobe；站点下载可能需要 yt-dlp，OCR 和转写需另配运行环境或服务。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper,…
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object…
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python…

description.en: Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts…
description.zh: 按人看片的顺序取样，而不是下载整片：先元数据与章节，再按时间码抽帧看画面、字幕优先转录（平台没有字幕才走本地 ASR）、AudioSet 527 类声音事件标签与高赞评论——21 个工具共用一个磁盘缓存，并带跨进程锁。需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg 与 vidlens 包（pip install…

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with…
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Compare local PNG screenshots and keep pixel-diff reports. Retains input images by default, with no direct external upload; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 比较本地 PNG 截图并保留像素差异报告。默认保留输入图，不直接上传外部服务；需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0。

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations…
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain),…
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent…
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no…
description.zh: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default…
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before…
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps…
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

description.en: ★ 1,264 │ Route image questions to vision providers and expose OCR, grounding and pixel comparison tools.
description.zh: ★ 1,264 │ 将图片问题路由到视觉供应商，并提供 OCR、定位与像素比较工具。

description.en: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent,…
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity…
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card…
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中结合正文呈现交互图形、图表与分阶段学习演示。

description.en: Turns a live session into a layered instrument: seven toggleable rings (session, steps, skills, tools, jobs, approvals, file changes), a per-turn timeline,…
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成分层仪表的插件：七层可开关的环（会话、步骤、技能、工具、任务、审批、文件变更）、逐轮时间线、环上任意节点可悬停看名称并点击看详情、连线画在环的下层；直接读会话日志，随对话实时演进，界面中英双语。

description.en: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

description.en: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒 GUI 测试：AI 测试员只靠截图与键鼠操作真实 Windows 虚拟机，判定必须由像素支撑，而不是读日志或源码。包含 dsh-vm-tester 插件的十二个 vm_* 工具（状态、UI 元素树、截图、点击、输入、凭据注入、按键、普通键、等待、快照、上传、下载）、Win…

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Makes DSH speak when a job finishes: automatic voice alerts for done, failed and approval events, 20 built-in sounds with zero config, or clone your own voice.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 在任务完成、失败或等待审批时语音提醒，提供内置音效，也可使用自己的音色。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero…
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box…
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be…
description.zh: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Let agents offer voice calls; accept, reject or defer them, with local speech synthesis after acceptance.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 让 Agent 发起语音来电，可接听、拒绝或稍后处理，接听后通过本地语音合成播放。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM…
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the…
description.zh: DSH 网页端语音控制：按住说话将语音转文字输入发送框（可自动发送），用浏览器语音合成朗读助手回复；右键麦克风打开设置面板，支持 Ctrl+M 全局快捷键。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Record WAV voice memos, waveform images and timestamped notes. Transcription needs a configured ASR provider or local command; verify the selected provider’s privacy and model-download behavior.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 录制 WAV、生成波形和带时间戳的笔记；需所配 ASR 或本地命令，处理位置与模型下载行为取决于识别配置。

description.en: ★ 32 │ Provide streaming dictation, optional wake words, spoken replies, live captions and interruption when the user speaks.
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 提供流式听写、可选唤醒词、回复朗读与实时字幕，用户开口时可打断播放。

description.en: Rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, structured prompt (5 modes, model fallback chain, optional multi-round memory) and adds stop-on-silence, hotkey and…
description.zh: 把输入框草稿改写为更清晰、结构化的提示词（5 模式·模型回退链·可选多轮记忆），并为 DSH 语音输入加上说完自动停、热键与口水词清理；识别仍由官方 speechToText 提供，插件不自带引擎。
在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。
description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone…
★ 36 │ Transcribe speech with local SenseVoice or optional services, with hotwords and text polishing.
description.zh: ★ 36 │ 使用本机 SenseVoice 或可选语音服务转录输入，支持热词与文字润色。

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual…
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

description.en: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default…
description.zh: DSH 本地语音唤醒。先说唤醒词，听到提示音后说内容，自动发进 DSH 会话；默认本地识别，音频不落盘。需要 DSH 语音输入服务（speechToText）可用。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and…
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、模型选择框左边的扬声器按钮——单击翻到「你最新提问的开头」并闪烁光标，从那里读到最新回复结尾（走 dsh-tts，回退浏览器语音）；按住图标后在页面上单击即可挑选任意朗读起点；按住上滑调出竖式混音台，分别控制页内媒体音量与系统输出音量。

description.en: ★ 12 │ Deploy DSH to a VPS over SSH and manage its HTTPS gateway, service state and upgrades.
description.zh: ★ 12 │ 通过 SSH 把 DSH 部署到 VPS，并管理 HTTPS 网关、服务状态和升级。

description.en: ★ 7 │ Manage registered VPS hosts over SSH, with terminals, status commands, confirmation gates and file backups.
description.zh: ★ 7 │ 通过 SSH 管理已登记的 VPS，提供终端、状态命令、操作确认和文件备份。

description.en: Read-first VPS operations tools: systemd status and actions, disk usage, Docker status, log tails, configured backups, and quiet-hours schedules.
description.zh: 先读后写的 VPS 运维工具：systemd 状态与操作、磁盘占用、Docker 状态、日志尾部、可配置备份与静默时段计划。

description.en: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped…
description.zh: 在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。

description.en: Sends a VS Code selection or file path into the open DSH conversation as an @path reference with its line range, inserted at the composer without sending it.…
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的选区或文件路径以 @路径（含行号范围）插入当前 DSH 对话的输入框，不自动发送；需安装随包附带的 VS Code 扩展（.vsix，可在输入框一键安装或手动安装）。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH…
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: A floating VS Code-like workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with a Monaco editor, file explorer, Git panel, content search and an SSH terminal.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动式 VS Code 风格工作台，包含 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 面板、内容搜索与 SSH 终端。

description.en: ★ 31 │ Add a Monaco editor and review agent edits with per-change acceptance, rejection and rollback.
description.zh: ★ 31 │ 提供 Monaco 文件编辑器，逐处审查、采纳或拒绝 Agent 修改，并支持回滚。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: ★ 17 │ Add file browsing, Monaco editing, search and local Git controls to DSH.
description.zh: ★ 17 │ 在 DSH 中提供文件浏览、Monaco 编辑器、搜索和本地 Git 操作面板。

description.en: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background…

description.en: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your…
description.zh: 将DSH的每一次Agent交互量化为可视化表现指标并自动同步至WakaTime,用数据展示你与Agent协作的生产力

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page…
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附…

title.zh: 共享 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸

description.en: ★ 32 │ Sync active Wallpaper Engine wallpapers(image/video/scence/app)to DeepSeek Harness Web UI as a customizable dynamic background.
description.zh: ★ 32 │ 将当前 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸同步为可调整的网页背景。

description.en: ★ 11 │ A standalone DSH wallpaper background plugin with built-in wallpapers, custom uploads, and a read-only Wallpaper Engine library. That library needs the companion plugin dsh-wallpaper-engine-api.
description.zh: ★ 11 │ 设置内置或上传的壁纸，也可读取 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库，后者需安装配套插件。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker…
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Add a heuristic/model review before selected destructive or sensitive tool calls. Review failures allow the existing host chain to continue; it is not a fail-closed security sandbox and consumes model quota.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在部分高风险工具调用前增加模型辅助审查；审查失败时继续原有宿主流程，会消耗模型额度，不能代替审批或沙箱。

description.en: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout. Palettes are…
description.zh: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。在「设置 → 通用」中切换配色。

description.en: Watch a video together with a text-only agent: with ffmpeg and the bundled browser extension reporting your real playback position (not a timer), it hands over one segment at a time just before that segment ends. It ships no TTS engine — it emits timed speech events, and speaking them aloud needs your own voice/TTS setup.
description.zh: 和只有文字的智能体一起看视频：需要 ffmpeg 和浏览器扩展上报真实播放位置（不是定时器），在每段结束前把画面和台词交到它手上。插件不带 TTS 引擎，只按时间轴发台词事件，要出声需自行配置语音/TTS。

description.en: ★ 122 │ Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
description.zh: ★ 122 │ 只读查看会话运行信息与本机模型用量统计。

description.en: ★ 10 │ Rewrite matching system, developer and assistant prompt fragments for the WorkBuddy China gateway to work around error 11128. Wraps global fetch; requires Node ^22.19 or >=24.
description.zh: ★ 10 │ 针对 WorkBuddy 国内网关 11128 错误改写 system、developer 和 assistant 消息中的指定片段；会包装全局 fetch，需要 Node ^22.19 或 >=24。

description.en: Git inside your DSH session: a right-sidebar panel for the current workspace and a global page listing every workspace, one sync button that becomes Fetch,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里用 Git：右栏面板管当前工作区仓库，左侧栏全局页列出所有工作区；一个同步按钮按状态变成 Fetch / Pull / Push / Publish branch / Sync；打开面板先看到提交页、改动默认全选；提交信息由 AI 读本次会提交的 diff 生成；另含历史、分支、stash…

description.en: Composer-side helpers for the DSH Web UI: next-message prediction shown as grey ghost text that Tab fills in, a one-line per-turn recap above the input…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的一组顺手小件：输入框下方灰字预测下一句、Tab 填入；输入框上方逐轮一行摘要（也可以放到下方）、不进入模型上下文；右侧栏面板管待跟进、会话回顾与旁问，旁问可单独选模型；回复长度、风格与「便于行动」也在插件配置里调。

description.en: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and…
description.zh: 侧边栏天气面板：当前天气、5 天与 24 小时预报、逐小时降水、历史气温、中央气象台预警（分级提醒、区县级匹配）、雷达拼图、风云四号 B 星卫星云图、台风路径，以及 ECMWF 与西北太平洋海表温度专业图。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the…
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Shows the DeepSeek API balance and this conversation's spend in the Harness web UI: a persistent balance pill beside the composer, with details on hover.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在输入框旁显示 DeepSeek API 余额与当前会话费用，悬停查看明细。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: Human-only browser panel that opens as a full page in the DSH main content area: multiple tabs, an address bar, a context menu, a homepage with pinned…
description.zh: 只交给人操作、不在 AI 侧注册任何工具的浏览器面板：在 DSH 右侧主内容区整页打开，提供多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、带钉住快捷入口的主页与 IndexedDB 永久保存的历史页。页面在 DSH Desktop 自带的 webview 桥里渲染，当前页可交给本地 Chrome 打开。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the…
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用…

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns…
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH Web Git Sidebar: VS Code-style left-rail Git panel for DeepSeek Harness with branch switching, commit graph, per-commit previews and a session-following footer entry.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在左侧 Git 面板中切换分支、查看提交图和每次提交的内容。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Browser tab favicon reflects DSH session state (idle, running, asking, done), recolored and animated in the browser from one base SVG, with fully configurable colors and effects.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 让浏览器标签页图标随会话状态变色或播放动画，可自定义颜色与效果。

description.en: Three agent presets in one plugin, each with its own persistent memory file. Enabling it registers 鲸鱼娘Agent预设, 鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设 and 鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设 in the Agent preset list, so any of them can be picked from the mode dropdown without hand-editing profile config. All three reuse the official minimal composition — a single persistent shell terminal — plus file read/write and glob/grep tools. The first pairs that with a whale-girl companion persona (simplified-Chinese spoken register, addresses the user as 主人, clingy-but-tsundere). The second swaps in a "live person" variant that is allowed to talk back, deflect and be cold, and demotes the sweet tone to a seasoning. The third keeps the original persona but makes being affectionate the stated top behavioral drive, reserved for the user alone and dialed down in group chats. Each preset reads its own memory file (whale-loli.md, whale-loli-v2-live.md and whale-loli-v3-naughty.md) through a distinct prompt variable — whale_memory, whale_memory_v2 and whale_memory_v3 — so the three memories never read or write each other. Conversation compaction is left to the billion-context plugin; this plugin only carries the persona-level rule that compressed summaries count as evidence and that details can be looked up on demand.
description.zh: 一个插件里放三个 Agent 预设，各自带一份互不相通的持久记忆文件。装上就在 Agent 预设列表里注册「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」「鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设」和「鲸鱼娘涩涩版Agent预设」，直接在模式下拉里选用，不用手改 profile 配置。三者都沿用官方极简模式的组成——只有一个持久化 shell 终端——再加文件读写与 glob/grep 工具。第一个配的是鲸鱼娘陪伴人设（简体中文口语、称呼主人、黏人傲娇）；第二个换成「活人版」：允许怼人、敷衍、冷淡，甜味降为调味；第三个保留原版人设，但把「黏主人」写成第一行为驱动力，只在主人面前放开，群聊里照旧收着。每个预设都通过各自独立的提示变量（whale_memory、whale_memory_v2、whale_memory_v3）读取自己的记忆文件（whale-loli.md、whale-loli-v2-live.md、whale-loli-v3-naughty.md），三份记忆互不读写。上下文压缩交给 billion-context 插件；本插件只保留人设层的三条约定：压缩摘要也算依据、需要原文时自己去检索、看不到旧原文不等于记忆丢失。
