description.zh: ★ 0 │ 组合提供删除会话、重新生成、/teammate、跨会话提醒和自动命名，各项可独立开关。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x…
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows…

description.en: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their…
description.zh: 微信工作助理：把你交代的事记进 SQLite 任务账本，按紧急度排序，到点提醒，从笔记里抽取人物与关系，并把任务分派给独立的助手会话。自带微信机器人通道（扫码登录，仅私聊）与整页仪表盘。

description.en: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: Shared runtime for the Personal Workbench: local SQLite, domain registration, agent tool, HTTP/SSE and opt-in cloud sync for the Tasks, Tags, Sites and Storage…
description.zh: 个人工作台共享宿主：本地 SQLite、业务域注册、agent 工具、HTTP/SSE，以及任务/标签/站点/物品插件的可选云端同步。

description.en: Site bookmark manager for DSH: a folder tree, multiple links per site, tags and filtering, with per-folder views.
description.zh: DSH 站点收藏：目录树、每个站点多条链接、标签与筛选，支持按目录浏览。

description.en: Storage records for DSH: names, brands, locations, units, stock text and tags with local SQLite and optional metadata sync.
description.zh: DSH 储物：记录名称、品牌、位置、单位、库存文本与标签，本地 SQLite 保存，可选元数据同步。

description.en: Tag manager for DSH: create, search and delete tags, with soft-delete and per-item mappings used by the workbench task, site and storage plugins.
description.zh: DSH 标签管理：创建、搜索、删除标签，支持软删除与条目映射，供任务、站点与储物插件使用。

description.en: Task manager for DSH: a task tree, eight views, priorities, due dates, timeline/restart chains, batch merge and table moves.
description.zh: DSH 任务管理：任务树、八个视图、优先级、截止日、时间线/重启链、批量归并与迁表。

description.en: ★ 38 │ Automatically connects models included in the WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: ★ 38 │ 自动接入本机 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Community WorkBuddy provider with account status, cost readings and manual effort probes for domestic and international clients. Needs a signed-in local WorkBuddy installation; probes may use quota. Account and control routes require the host owner.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 社区维护的 WorkBuddy 模型渠道，提供国内/国际版账号状态、费用读数与手动探测。需本机已登录 WorkBuddy，探测可能消耗额度；账号和控制接口要求宿主所有者身份。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Connect WorkBuddy desktop models through the Functy fork, with a dashboard, account rotation and quota display.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 通过 Functy 分支接入 WorkBuddy 桌面模型，提供仪表盘、账号轮换和额度显示。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in…
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历…

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups.…
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy /…

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

description.en: Recolours and re-lays-out the DSH Web GUI as Tencent WorkBuddy desktop does: mint brand #00c29a, gray sidebar, 24px composer with a single hairline border,…
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 改成腾讯 WorkBuddy 桌面的样子：薄荷绿品牌色 #00c29a、灰阶侧栏、24px 圆角输入框配单层细描边、对话栏 848px。取值逐项取自 WorkBuddy v5.0.2 安装包里的设计令牌，不是照着照片调；只做浅色，纯 CSS，移除注入的样式即还原。

description.en: Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model…
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and…
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

description.en: ★ 1 │ A visual project workspace for goals, source material, module conversations, revisions and versioned deliverables, with bundled Python for document processing. For Windows x64 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; model work uses the account configured in DSH.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 把目标、资料、模块会话、修订和版本化成果放进同一画布，并内置 Python 处理文档。适用于 Windows x64 和 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5；模型任务使用 DSH 中已配置的账号。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Show the current conversation as a step map with progress sources, tools and file types. Queue a prompt for the next step of a running agent and revoke it before consumption.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 将当前会话显示为分步地图，标注进度来源、工具和文件类型；可向运行中的 Agent 下一步追加提示，并在取用前撤回。

description.en: ★ 1 │ Show workflow stages and subagents on a timeline, configure model and concurrency for each stage, and reopen subagent conversations from the panel. Run names and stage settings persist under ~/.dsh; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 在时间线中查看工作流阶段和子代理，为每个阶段配置模型与并发，并从面板打开子代理对话。运行名称与阶段设置保存在 ~/.dsh，需要 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: ★ 668 │ Show a live status line while the agent works: current phase, the tool actually running, elapsed time and a summary when the turn ends. Works in the TUI, Web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: ★ 668 │ Agent 工作时显示一行实时状态：当前阶段、正在运行的工具、已用时间和回合结束摘要，终端、网页和桌面端通用。

description.en: ★ 0 │ Show uncommitted changes and the local commit history of one or more Git repositories in the current DSH workspace, with per-file line counts and unified diffs. Read-only; uses a temporary Git index and does not stage, commit or push.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 显示当前 DSH 工作区中一个或多个 Git 仓库的未提交改动和本地提交历史，支持逐文件增删行数与统一差异。只读；使用临时 Git 索引，不执行 stage、commit 或 push。

description.en: Turns DSH session logs into Markdown work reports for a day, an ISO week or a month, grouped by working directory. Each session lists its requests, changed…
description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话日志还原成 Markdown 工作台账：日报、周报（ISO 周）或月报，按工作目录分组。每个会话列出需求、改动文件、工具用量与中断次数，末尾附「产物」清单：改动最多的文件、新生成的文档、关键命令。提供 /worklog 命令、worklog_generate…

description.en: Durable task-decomposition plans for DeepSeek Harness with a self-learning loop: every department subtask runs in three ordered phases (plan, execute, verify), the verify phase must submit a retrospective of problems, detours and resolutions, and that retrospective is written to a permanent lessons file, ranked against the new subtask and injected into later dispatches so the same mistake is not repeated. Adds a read-only dsh_workplan_lessons tool (11 model tools in total), a progress panel drawn as a ring, a stacked bar and per-stage steps, and a public ISO/IEC 15408:2026 security self-assessment with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化任务分解计划，并加入自我学习闭环：每个部门子任务按「计划→执行→验证」三阶段推进，验证阶段必须提交问题、弯路与解决方式的复盘，写入永久教训记忆文件，下次派发时按部门与关键词排序注入，避免重犯。新增只读 dsh_workplan_lessons 工具（共 11 个模型工具）、环形图/四段构成条/逐阶段步进条进度面板，以及按 ISO/IEC 15408:2026 结构编写的公开安全自评估——每条声明都可被读者核对，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared…
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from…
description.zh: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，会话行可归档 / 取消归档（运行中的会话走官方同款「停止并归档」确认）并配隐藏 / 含归档 / 仅归档三态筛选，行内按钮悬停有应用自带样式的提示，…

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with…
description.zh: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a…
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: A sidebar panel that moves, rebuilds, merges, renames and deletes whole workspaces: a move re-publishes each session log with the new directory in its header,…
description.zh: 侧栏里的工作区面板：迁移、重建、合并、重命名、删除整个工作区——迁移会用新目录的 header 重新发布会话日志，修复工作区归属并刷新标题缓存，每张卡片标明会话是在运行还是仅被打开。

description.en: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.
description.zh: 把添加工作区的目录对话框换成路径输入、盘符快捷和系统文件夹选择。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

description.en: ★ 4 │ Browse workspaces and sessions as draggable bubbles, with search, filters, saved browser layouts and native rename, new-session, archive and restore actions. Dragging changes layout only. Tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web.
description.zh: ★ 4 │ 用可拖动气泡浏览工作区与会话，支持搜索筛选、浏览器本地布局保存，以及重命名、新建会话、归档和恢复。拖拽只调整图谱布局，已测试 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web。

description.en: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
description.zh: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

description.en: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and…
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit,…
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go…

description.en: A VS Code-like workspace panel with a JetBrains-inspired editor: lazy file tree, TypeScript code viewer with syntax highlighting, soft-wrap, find & replace,…
description.zh: 类 VS Code 的工作区面板，编辑器对照 JetBrains 打磨：懒加载文件树、带语法高亮的 TypeScript 代码视图与软换行、文件内查找替换、Quick Open、多标签草稿、括号匹配/自动配对，全工作区文本搜索、Git 状态/历史与彩色 diff、六套 VS Code 配色并支持跟随 DSH…

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds…
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_…

description.en: ★ 1 │ Move DSH workspaces, conversations and selected project files between computers, with import previews and rollback of items created during this run. Migration bundles can contain private project data; keep a backup.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 将 DSH 工作区、对话和选定项目文件迁到另一台电脑，支持导入预览及回滚本次新建的项目。迁移包可能含私密资料，操作前请备份。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after…
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Sidebar workspace tree: create nested sub-workspaces at any level, start a session on any level, and pin a session to the top of its nearest folder.
description.zh: 侧边栏工作区多级树：任意一级都能新建子工作区与会话，会话可置顶到所属的最近一级文件夹，刷新不丢。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the…
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last…
description.zh: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID,…
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」与导航之间的可拖动分隔条，上拖把高度让给会话列表，双击恢复默认。

description.en: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a…
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: Four filter chips on their own row at the foot of the sidebar, each carrying its match count beside the label: running sessions, sessions waiting for your…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部独占一行的四个筛选 chip，命中数量跟在按钮文字后面：正在运行、在等你确认（审批、计划审阅、待回答）、有未读内容（跑完没看，或最近有更新但没打开过）、以及本地零点之后有更新的今日会话。点开就在上方按工作区分组列出命中会话，点行直接打开。同一行行尾还有一颗 DeepSeek…

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse…
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

title.zh: 工作区状态与置顶通知

description.en: ★ 1 │ Workspace activity marks, a pinned-conversation section grouped by workspace, and notifications for pinned sessions. In-app notices are on and sound is off by default; OS notifications require permission and may show session titles. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 and Node >=22.18.
description.zh: ★ 1 │ 显示工作区活动状态、按工作区分组的置顶会话及置顶状态通知。默认开启站内提示、关闭声音；系统通知需要授权，可能显示会话标题。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Node >=22.18。

description.en: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row…
description.zh: 为每个工作区分配稳定的暖到冷色调，把工作区名设为分组标题并把会话缩进其下，同时在会话完成未读时整行染绿。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: ★ 9 │ Worktree Space gives each task its own space across one or more Git repos, with a worktree per repo on one task branch. It merges back to each target branch and can hand conflicts to an agent.
description.zh: ★ 9 │ 为每个任务建立独立的 Git 工作树，支持跨仓库执行、合并回目标分支，并把冲突交给 Agent 处理。

description.en: Adds a one-click Worktree switch beside the composer that moves an empty session into a new git worktree, and removes worktrees idle for three days.
description.zh: 在输入框分支标记旁提供一键 Worktree 开关，让空会话进入新的 git worktree；三天无活动的 worktree 自动清理。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only…
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use…
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default,…
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn…
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: ★ 0 │ An optional writing mode with a right-sidebar panel for title, characters, world, style, length, chapters and branches, plus a cross-chapter context pack. /api/writer-studio/* is registered only when the host connection service is available, and every request goes through connection.requestRejection(). Git pin at v0.4.2. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 可选写作模式，右侧栏管理书名、角色、世界观、文风、字数、章节与分支，并提供跨章上下文包。仅在宿主 connection 服务可用时注册 /api/writer-studio/*，每条请求先走 connection.requestRejection()。Git 固定在 v0.4.2。MIT 许可。

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph…
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as…
description.zh: writing-anything 工作区的只读写作面板：作品总览卡片、单元树、YAML 产物的语义卡片与源码高亮视图、素材清单与决策／复核清单，以及面板内单元审阅（反馈经 wa-cli 写回）。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: Sidebar session management for DeepSeek Harness: workspace groups sorted by latest activity, history folded behind one control, a global pinned section, running/unread/follow-up marks, delete into a restorable trash whose panel also manages archived sessions, per-session token statistics split by tool (arguments vs results), moving a session to another workspace, and a scan that re-attaches sessions missing from every workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序，过期历史折叠成一个「展开历史」控件，所有置顶会话汇总到顶部置顶区，运行中/未读/需跟进三色标记，删除会话移入可恢复的回收站（面板同时管理已归档会话），按工具拆分、参数与结果分开的 token 消耗统计，把会话移动到另一个工作区，以及一键把游离会话重新挂回工作区。

description.en: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that…
description.zh: 在当前 WSL 发行版里运行持久 bash 以及 Linux 路径的文件与搜索工具。新建对话选中 WSL 后，从该发行版的文件夹里指定工作区，且不会在发行版内安装任何东西。

description.en: ★ 0 │ DSH Desktop WSL execution environment: add a WSL workspace and run every tool inside the distribution.
description.zh: ★ 0 │ 在 DSH 桌面端添加 WSL 工作区，让工具在指定发行版中执行。

description.en: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and…
description.zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows.…
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as…
description.zh: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes…
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness. A sidebar W button lists installed distros and registers a Linux folder as a host workspace addressed by a UNC path, and…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 WSL 工作区：侧栏 W 按钮列出发行版并把 Linux 目录注册为宿主工作区（以 UNC 路径表示），WSL 会话的侧栏终端在发行版内打开真实 Linux pty。发行版内常驻一个零依赖 agent，通过 JSON-lines 管道响应文件、shell…

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI…
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与…

description.en: ★ 119 │ Run a session's shell and file tools inside a selected WSL distribution.
description.zh: ★ 119 │ 在选定的 WSL 发行版中运行会话命令与文件工具。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path…
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic…
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
description.zh: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

description.en: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers…
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app…

description.en: ★ 502 │ Aggregate accounts and provider models, inspect usage, and configure routing and a local gateway.
description.zh: ★ 502 │ 汇总多个账号和供应商的模型，查看用量、设置路由，并提供本机模型网关。

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition…
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

description.en: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free…
description.zh: 鲸鱼正太 × 女仆装 × 二次元的桌面桌宠：四种表情跟随对话状态，可拖拽、点击切换；右下角立牌每轮显示 token 消耗与思考时间，点击有 q 弹与独立余额气泡；另附聊天壁纸、液态玻璃输入框；人格自称小D，称呼你为主人并带喵~ 等语气词；设置里可一键开关，还能自定义称呼。

description.en: ★ 57 │ Read replies with Xiaomi MiMo TTS or the browser's local speech engine.
description.zh: ★ 57 │ 使用 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 或浏览器本地语音朗读回复。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task…
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Local task board with secretary, CEO and historian roles. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3; role conversations use the configured model.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 本地任务看板，包含秘书、CEO 和史官角色；需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，角色对话使用已配置模型。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next,…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让…

description.en: Turns an organised memory archive into a browsable star map — one star per memory, the diary as an outer timeline, plus a chapter view, a day view, and a picking task that files each day's raw conversation into the archive.
description.zh: 把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张能点的星图——一条记忆一颗星，日记在外圈排成时间星带，另有星册、星历，以及把每天的原始对话收进档案的「拾星」。

description.en: Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a blue taskbar sidebar, Luna title bars, translucent conversation and plugin windows with adjustable…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤：蓝色任务栏侧栏、Luna 标题栏、可调节不透明度与模糊的半透明对话及插件窗口，以及可导入壁纸的设置页。仅浅色模式：宿主切到深色时皮肤自动移除。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection,…
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair…
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote,…
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Freezes a six-step repair chain into callable tools — freeze the facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable A/B, a judge that must say OK,…
description.zh: 把排障六步固化成可调用的链：冻结事实→量真形状→最小复现→单变量对照→判定器（没说 OK 不许说修好）→交活闸；另带零依赖开机自检（安装路径漂移、配方缺件、版本三处一致、崩溃日志新鲜度）、逐项说明的微调设置，以及每个动作都留备份的退回账本。

description.en: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
description.zh: 控制、组织、诊断、设计、个性化 Yeelight 智能家居，解答产品知识问题，由本地 yeelight-home 运行时驱动。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step…
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide…
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default,…

description.en: ★ 162 │ Superpowers for the DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers
description.zh: ★ 162 │ 为 DSH 接入测试驱动开发、调试、规划与协作技能。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.
description.zh: 通过机器可读检查点与乐观锁，在 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy、Claude Code 和 Codex 之间交接持久任务状态。

description.en: Agent-team task workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar board and requirement view track tasks across backlog, execution, review and done, dispatch work to…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体团队任务工作台：侧栏看板与需求视图跟踪任务从待办、执行、评审到完成，把工作派发给编码智能体，并用本地 SQLite 承载多角色团队编排。

description.en: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

description.en: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
description.zh: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

description.en: Fetches Tsinghua MadModel API tokens and renews them from the saved SSO session on a 20-minute timer in a windowless browser, writes the token into the DSH…
description.zh: 获取清华 MadModel 的 API token，按每 20 分钟在无窗口浏览器里用已保存的 SSO 会话续期，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点一次 Get 就通过校内登录窗口捕获该会话。

description.en: Tracks token usage and estimated costs for every model call, with daily charts, session and workspace names, provider balances, budgets, and secret-free…
description.zh: 统计本机每次模型调用的 token 用量与预估费用，提供每日图表、会话/工作区名称、账户余额、预算与无凭据 CSV/JSON 导出。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: ★ 8 │ A travel-planning mode that brings the Travel Story app (map, timeline, playback) into the DSH page, with the chat as a floating window and 18 agent tools for place search, weather, routes and itinerary editing. Place search needs your own Gaode (AMap) or LocationIQ key. Git pin at 3854a65; Node >=18. MIT.
description.zh: ★ 8 │ 旅行规划模式：把 Travel Story 应用（地图、时间线、播放）整页带进 DSH，对话变为浮窗，提供 18 个 agent 工具覆盖地点搜索、天气、路线与行程编辑。地点搜索需自备高德或 LocationIQ Key。Git 固定在 3854a65；需 Node >=18。MIT 许可。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and…
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version,…
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Use plugins from ecosystems such as Claude Code and Codex in DSH: add Git plugin sources and marketplaces, upload plugins and skills, add MCP servers,…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles…
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of…
description.zh: 让 DSH 开口说话：每轮回答先改写成自然口语再朗读，代码、表格与 Markdown 自动处理；系统 TTS 开箱即用，豆包（第三方 API）提供方言与情感演绎，本地 Kokoro 引擎离线运行、内容不出本机；支持 DSH 桌面版与 dsh web。另附工作／完成／提问三种会话状态提示音——会话在跑、跑完了、等你回答各…

description.en: Transforms the local Wallpaper Engine library into a live background for DSH, with video and web wallpapers playing for real. An adaptive veil adjusts with…
description.zh: 将本地 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库化为 DSH 界面的动态背景,视频与网页壁纸真实播放。自适应遮罩根据画面亮度智能调节,保持文字清晰可读;壁纸生效时,悬浮组件呈现液态玻璃。内置中英双语设置面板,提供画面取景、轮播管理、搜索与实时资源监控。不支持场景与应用类壁纸。

description.en: ★ 3 │ Weir: an orchestrator-centric DSH agent preset with an intent gate, category delegation, a todo driver, pull-based background jobs, auto-compaction, and hashline editing.
description.zh: ★ 3 │ 提供 Weir Agent 预设，统筹任务确认、分类委派、待办执行、后台任务和上下文压缩。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to…
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: ★ 407 │ Add an interactive companion character to the DSH web interface.
description.zh: ★ 407 │ 在 DSH 网页界面添加可互动的角色伙伴。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report…
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character…
description.zh: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI…

description.en: Registers a read-only tool that lets a parent agent read what each subagent is actually doing, not just whether it is running: the progress notes the child…
description.zh: 注册一个只读工具，让父代理读到每个子代理实际在做什么，而不只是它有没有在跑：子代理自己写下的进度旁白，时间早的在前，按序号向前翻页，给出距上次查看已过去多少步，并在连续五步以上没有新旁白时给出沉默计数。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Control Windows apps through window targets, UI Automation, screenshots and verified input, with an isolated Chromium option.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过窗口定位、UI Automation、截图和输入检查操作 Windows 应用，可使用独立 Chromium 实例。

description.en: Monitors WorkBuddy credit usage and the free-tier 24-hour window quota (local estimate) in real time, with composer badges, a settings panel, multi-account…
description.zh: 实时监控 WorkBuddy 积分用量与免费用户的 24h 窗口额度（本机估算）：输入框徽标 + 设置面板，支持多账号轮换与免费/付费识别。

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through…
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: ★ 2 │ Exposes DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web capabilities to the Xiaozhi voice assistant over MCP, as a self-contained bundle that registers DSH as an MCP tool provider and supports multiple devices.
description.zh: ★ 2 │ 通过 MCP 将 DSH 工具接给小智语音助手，支持多个设备。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and…
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git…

description.en: A Chinese-thinking plugin built for Chinese users: registers a system prompt section at order -900 so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 适合中国宝宝的中文思考插件：在系统提示词 order -900 注册段落，让 Agent 用简体中文思考。
